Job Title: Field Service Engineer-II

Location: U.S. Remote - prefer Central Midwest region

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:

The Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer plays a critical role in supporting, integrating, and optimizing Precision Fastening Tools, Controllers, and Connected Manufacturing solutions within customer production environments. This position serves as the technical liaison between customers, service teams, and engineering organizations, ensuring reliable operation, seamless system integration, and exceptional customer satisfaction.

The engineer will be responsible for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, and support of fastening systems and related manufacturing technologies. This includes integration with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), PLCs, industrial networks, and digital I/O interfaces.

Through direct customer engagement and hands-on technical expertise, the Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer helps drive operational excellence, product reliability, and continuous improvement while supporting Ingersoll Rand's commitment to making life better through innovative manufacturing solutions.

Responsibilities

Field Service & Customer Support

  • Travel to customer facilities to install, commission, maintain, and troubleshoot precision fastening systems, controllers, and software solutions.
  • Provide onsite and remote technical support for customers, distributors, and internal service teams.
  • Diagnose and resolve software, hardware, networking, and process-related issues in production environments.
  • Conduct equipment assessments and recommend corrective actions to improve system performance and uptime.
  • Deliver customer training on product operation, software functionality, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • Support production launch activities and ensure successful implementation of connected manufacturing solutions.
Connected Manufacturing & Systems Integration

  • Ensure reliable wired & wireless communication between fastening tools and controllers.
  • Support integration & troubleshooting of communication between IR products and plant MES systems using open protocols like Power Focus Open Protocol (PFOP) and ToolsNet, and proprietary protocols for Ford, Volkswagen, Toyota, Stellantis and more.
  • Verify traceability, production reporting, recipe management, and quality data collection requirements.
  • Collaborate with customer automation, IT, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure reliable system performance.
  • Support Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory initiatives through deployment of connected manufacturing solutions.
Digital I/O & Automation Support

About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview: 
The Maintenance Techincian is responsible for the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of the CNC machines and manuafcturing machines. This role will deal with CNC Machines and working with PLC and Electronic Compents of our manufacturing machines.

Responsibilities:

  • Makes major electrical, mechanical, and construction repairs and installation involving schematics and/or blueprint interpretation.
  • Troubleshoots drive related issues to component level for Fanuc, Siemens, Allen Bradley and other brands of controllers.
  • Determines root cause of failures and recommends preventive actions.  Communicates same through work order system comments/history.
  • Communicates consistently with internal customers regarding status of equipment in shop.
  • Advises supervisor of needs for outside services and works with service representatives on equipment and controls repair and installation. Shows competency in several crafts and performs handyman aspects in all trades.
  • Constructs sketches of mechanical or construction alterations/installations and electrical circuitry.
  • Prepares bills of material on jobs requiring major material use and initiates purchase requisitions.
  • Makes day to day work-related decisions.
  • Uses various material handling equipment such as hoists, carts, lifts, fork trucks and hand trucks in moving light to heavy weight material. 
  • Uses a variety of lock-out/tag-out devices as required per plant LOTO Plan. 

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 2+ years of experience in Electronic Manufacturing Maintenance or industrial Maintenance

Key Competencies:

  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Exhibits team work skills
  • Ability to stand and walk up to 8 hours continuously during a shift.
  • Ability to lift up to 35 lbs alone, or 70 lbs with assistance, repeatedly over an 8 hour shift
  • Ability to push or pull up to 35 lbs.
  • Ability to see or have vision corrected with glasses/contacts to an evaluated level of no worse than 20/35.

Preferences:

  • Associates degree or higher in Electronic Technology or must show enrollment into course work for associates degree within 12 months of employment
  • Ability to troubleshoot and repair pneumatic, hydraulic, electrical, electronic, CNC machines and controls. 
  • Ability to work with concepts when detailed prints, drawings, and specifications are not available.
  • Ability to maintain technical documentation for equipment and processes.
  • Ability to maintain mechanical machine tools to include lathes, grinders, mills, drills, machining centers, and other similar equipment.
  • Ability to interpret schematics and blueprints.
 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position will be based at our site in Mocksville, NC, with no anticipated travel.

Job Overview:

The Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer plays a critical role in supporting, integrating, and optimizing Precision Fastening Tools, Controllers, and Connected Manufacturing solutions within customer production environments. This position serves as the technical liaison between customers, service teams, and engineering organizations, ensuring reliable operation, seamless system integration, and exceptional customer satisfaction.

The engineer will be responsible for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, and support of fastening systems and related manufacturing technologies. This includes integration with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), PLCs, industrial networks, and digital I/O interfaces.

Through direct customer engagement and hands-on technical expertise, the Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer helps drive operational excellence, product reliability, and continuous improvement while supporting Ingersoll Rand's commitment to making life better through innovative manufacturing solutions.

Responsibilities

Field Service & Customer Support

  • Travel to customer facilities to install, commission, maintain, and troubleshoot precision fastening systems, controllers, and software solutions.
  • Provide onsite and remote technical support for customers, distributors, and internal service teams.
  • Diagnose and resolve software, hardware, networking, and process-related issues in production environments.
  • Conduct equipment assessments and recommend corrective actions to improve system performance and uptime.
  • Deliver customer training on product operation, software functionality, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • Support production launch activities and ensure successful implementation of connected manufacturing solutions.
Connected Manufacturing & Systems Integration

  • Ensure reliable wired & wireless communication between fastening tools and controllers.
  • Support integration & troubleshooting of communication between IR products and plant MES systems using open protocols like Power Focus Open Protocol (PFOP) and ToolsNet, and proprietary protocols for Ford, Volkswagen, Toyota, Stellantis and more.
  • Verify traceability, production reporting, recipe management, and quality data collection requirements.
  • Collaborate with customer automation, IT, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure reliable system performance.
  • Support Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory initiatives through deployment of connected manufacturing solutions.
Digital I/O & Automation Support

  • Configure and troubleshoot digital I/O communications between fastening controllers, PLCs, conveyors, robots, and automation equipment.
  • Verify machine interlocks, cycle complete signals, fault outputs, part-present inputs, and process control functions.
  • Support industrial communication protocols including Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC-UA.
  • Assist with factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), and production startup support.
Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring field issues and provide feedback to engineering and product management teams.
  • Support the development of service procedures, technical documentation, and best practices.
  • Stay current on manufacturing technology trends, industrial automation, and connected factory solutions.
  • Mentor service technicians and junior engineers as needed.
Qualifications:

  • 5+ Years of experience with MES with power tools communicating with PFOP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Digital I/O configuration and troubleshooting
  • 5+ Years of experience with Fieldbus communications with Profinet or EthernetIP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Software installation and validation
  • 5+ Years of experience with Configuring devices for Wi-Fi communications & troubleshooting
Core Competencies: 

  • Strong customer-facing communication skills
  • Ability to characterize, diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Effective collaboration across engineering, service, and customer teams
  • Willingness to travel extensively to support customer operations
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Joints, fasteners, power tools
  • Must be very comfortable with customer interaction! Will have a sales incentive bonus.
  • Exposure to industrial automation with OPC-UA, MES and Fieldbus protocols
  • Experience with devices communicating over Zigbee or 802.15.4
  • Experience with mobile app communications with devices over BLE or USB
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 
  • Regular Travel by car and plane to our customer sites in the US and Canada. Must have a valid passport or ability to get one. You will be provided with a company vehicle. 
Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is Min - 97000 - Max - 125000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Title: Maintenance Technician
Location: Mocksville, NC (Onsite) (338 Valley Rd. Mocksville, NC 27028) 
Shift: 3rd shift, 630pm to 630am working 4 on and 4 off (Rotating Schedule) - Direct Hire - Full time role

About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Job Overview: 
The Maintenance Techincian is responsible for the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of the CNC machines and manuafcturing machines. This role will deal with CNC Machines and working with PLC and Electronic Compents of our manufacturing machines.

Responsibilities:

  • Makes major electrical, mechanical, and construction repairs and installation involving schematics and/or blueprint interpretation.
  • Troubleshoots drive related issues to component level for Fanuc, Siemens, Allen Bradley and other brands of controllers.
  • Determines root cause of failures and recommends preventive actions.  Communicates same through work order system comments/history.
  • Communicates consistently with internal customers regarding status of equipment in shop.
  • Advises supervisor of needs for outside services and works with service representatives on equipment and controls repair and installation. Shows competency in several crafts and performs handyman aspects in all trades.
  • Constructs sketches of mechanical or construction alterations/installations and electrical circuitry.
  • Prepares bills of material on jobs requiring major material use and initiates purchase requisitions.
  • Makes day to day work-related decisions.
  • Uses various material handling equipment such as hoists, carts, lifts, fork trucks and hand trucks in moving light to heavy weight material. 
  • Uses a variety of lock-out/tag-out devices as required per plant LOTO Plan. 

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 2+ years of experience in Electronic Manufacturing Maintenance or industrial Maintenance

Key Competencies:

  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Exhibits team work skills
  • Ability to stand and walk up to 8 hours continuously during a shift.
  • Ability to lift up to 35 lbs alone, or 70 lbs with assistance, repeatedly over an 8 hour shift
  • Ability to push or pull up to 35 lbs.
  • Ability to see or have vision corrected with glasses/contacts to an evaluated level of no worse than 20/35.

Preferences:

  • Associates degree or higher in Electronic Technology or must show enrollment into course work for associates degree within 12 months of employment
  • Ability to troubleshoot and repair pneumatic, hydraulic, electrical, electronic, CNC machines and controls. 
  • Ability to work with concepts when detailed prints, drawings, and specifications are not available.
  • Ability to maintain technical documentation for equipment and processes.
  • Ability to maintain mechanical machine tools to include lathes, grinders, mills, drills, machining centers, and other similar equipment.
  • Ability to interpret schematics and blueprints.
 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position will be based at our site in Mocksville, NC, with no anticipated travel.

Cyber Security Engineer

Location:

Remote

Job Overview

Ingersoll Rand is seeking a highly skilled Cyber Security Engineer to join our Security Operations team. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and enhancing cybersecurity technologies that protect enterprise IT systems and industrial OT/ICS environments across our global operations. The successful candidate will work closely with infrastructure, cloud, application, and manufacturing teams to strengthen security controls, improve threat detection capabilities, automate operational processes, and support the organization's evolving cybersecurity strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support security technologies across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, email, and data protection environments.
  • Develop and optimize threat detection content, correlation rules, and alerting capabilities within SIEM, MDR, and related security platforms.
  • Build and maintain security automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and accelerate incident response activities.
  • Support cybersecurity incident investigations, containment efforts, forensic analysis, and root cause determination.
  • Conduct security architecture reviews for applications, cloud platforms, integrations, and newly acquired businesses.
  • Lead vulnerability management and security hardening initiatives, including risk assessments, remediation planning, and configuration management.
  • Develop scripts, dashboards, API integrations, and reporting capabilities that improve security visibility and monitoring.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and security runbooks while supporting knowledge sharing across teams.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, or infrastructure security within a complex enterprise environment.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise security technologies such as EDR/XDR, SIEM, Identity and Access Management (IAM), email security, secure web gateways, or SASE platforms.
  • Experience developing automation using Python and/or PowerShell, including integrations through REST APIs.
  • Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK Framework and its use in threat detection, threat hunting, and security validation.
  • Knowledge of networking, operating systems, cloud security (Azure and/or AWS), and identity security concepts.
  • Experience developing and implementing security controls within enterprise environments.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex security challenges.
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to manage projects independently from design through implementation.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering secure, high-quality solutions.
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • High degree of professionalism, integrity, and accountability.

Preferences

  • Experience supporting cybersecurity programs within manufacturing, industrial, or OT/ICS environments.
  • Hands-on experience with CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, Zscaler, or SOAR platforms.
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, and cybersecurity integration initiatives.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GDAT, GCED, GICSP, or cloud security certifications.
  • Experience performing security architecture reviews and security assessments.
  • Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity frameworks and manufacturing technology environments.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • Remote position.
  • Approximately 10-15% travel required.
  • Travel may include visits to manufacturing facilities, corporate offices, and acquisition sites to support security initiatives, assessments, and integration activities.

Job Title: Quality Engineer
Location: Monroe, LA

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
At Ingersoll Rand’s Monroe, Louisiana facility, precision-engineered products play a critical role in equipment customers depend on every day. The site manufactures and services THOMAS air compressor and vacuum pump products within an OEM portfolio serving medical, laboratory, environmental, and industrial markets. In this hands-on manufacturing environment, quality is measured not just by what leaves the line, but by how reliably the product performs for the customer—creating a meaningful opportunity to strengthen processes, systems, and overall plant performance.

We’re seeking a Quality Engineer who is a hands-on individual contributor focused on strengthening quality performance across the Monroe facility by turning quality challenges into sustainable process improvements. Rather than simply reacting to defects, this engineer will look at quality through the customer’s eyes—identifying trends, uncovering root causes, and building the processes, standards, controls, and corrective actions that prevent issues from recurring. Partnering closely with Engineering, Operations, Production, Customer Service, and Supply Chain, this role will apply proven manufacturing quality practices—including process controls, quality metrics, and customer-focused problem solving—to improve process capability, reduce cost of poor quality, address customer complaints and returns, and strengthen overall product performance.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing quality experience, can quickly understand the operation, and is comfortable taking ownership and driving improvements with a high degree of independence. This is an opportunity for a builder—not simply a maintainer: someone energized by improving what exists, creating what is missing, and helping establish stronger, more sustainable quality practices as the operation continues to grow.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead investigations of customer complaints, warranty issues, and internal concfomromances using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, and PFMEA, implementing effective corrective and preventative actions.
  • Support and continuously improve the site's Quality Management System, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable company quality standards.
  • Conduct internal process audits, support customer and certification audits, and drive timely resolution of findings.
  • Analyze quality, manufacturing, inspection, and warranty data to identify trends, reduce defects, minimize scrap and rework, and improve operational performance.
  • Develop and maintain quality planning and validation documentation, including PPAPs, Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, Measurement System Analyses (MSA), and Process Capability Studies.
  • Support process validation and qualification activities, including IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols where applicable.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to develop process controls, improve product quality, and ensure customer requirements are met.
  • Provide quality-related training and guidance, promote continuous improvement initiatives, and participate in Kaizen and operational excellence activities.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in manufacturing quality, quality engineering, or a related technical role within a manufacturing environment.
  • 3+ years of experience applying root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies to investigate and resolve manufacturing or product quality issues.
  • 2+ years of experience working within an ISO 9001 quality management system, including internal audits, corrective actions, or quality-system compliance activities.
  • 3+ years of experience analyzing manufacturing or quality data to identify trends, process issues, or improvement opportunities and communicating findings and recommended actions to manufacturing, engineering, or operations teams.


Core Competencies

  • Continuous Improvement Mindset – Looks beyond immediate fixes to identify opportunities for sustainable process, product, and quality improvement.
  • Analytical Problem Solving – Uses data, quality metrics, root cause analysis, and sound judgment to identify issues, evaluate trends, and develop effective solutions.
  • Customer Focus – Evaluates quality through the customer’s perspective and takes action to improve product performance, reliability, and overall customer satisfaction.
  • Ownership & Follow-Through – Takes personal accountability for commitments, respects deadlines, drives actions to completion, and operates effectively without constant direction.
  • Collaboration & Influence – Builds productive relationships across Engineering, Operations, Production, Supply Chain, and other functions to resolve issues and advance quality initiatives.
  • Quality & Compliance Excellence – Maintains high standards for quality, process discipline, documentation, and compliance while supporting effective quality management systems.


Preferences:

  • Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or similar quality certification.
  • Experience with PPAP, PFMEA, MSA, SPC, and Process Capability Studies.
  • Experience supporting ISO 9001 certified manufacturing environments.
  • Working knowledge of GD&T, blueprint reading, and metrology systems.
  • Experience in machining, assembly, pump manufacturing, or other industrial manufacturing environments.


Travel & Work Arrangements

  • This position is fully site-based at the Monroe, Louisiana manufacturing facility.
  • Occasional travel may be required to support customer audits, supplier visits, training, or other business needs.

What We Offer
Our benefits –At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Job Title: Quality Engineer                
Location:  Monroe, LA
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
At Ingersoll Rand’s Monroe, Louisiana facility, precision-engineered products play a critical role in equipment customers depend on every day. The site manufactures and services THOMAS air compressor and vacuum pump products within an OEM portfolio serving medical, laboratory, environmental, and industrial markets. In this hands-on manufacturing environment, quality is measured not just by what leaves the line, but by how reliably the product performs for the customer—creating a meaningful opportunity to strengthen processes, systems, and overall plant performance.

We’re seeking a Quality Engineer who is a hands-on individual contributor focused on strengthening quality performance across the Monroe facility by turning quality challenges into sustainable process improvements. Rather than simply reacting to defects, this engineer will look at quality through the customer’s eyes—identifying trends, uncovering root causes, and building the processes, standards, controls, and corrective actions that prevent issues from recurring.  Partnering closely with Engineering, Operations, Production, Customer Service, and Supply Chain, this role will apply proven manufacturing quality practices—including process controls, quality metrics, and customer-focused problem solving—to improve process capability, reduce cost of poor quality, address customer complaints and returns, and strengthen overall product performance.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing quality experience, can quickly understand the operation, and is comfortable taking ownership and driving improvements with a high degree of independence. This is an opportunity for a builder—not simply a maintainer: someone energized by improving what exists, creating what is missing, and helping establish stronger, more sustainable quality practices as the operation continues to grow.

Responsibilities:
  • Lead investigations of customer complaints, warranty issues, and internal concfomromances using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, and PFMEA, implementing effective corrective and preventative actions. 
  • Support and continuously improve the site's Quality Management System, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable company quality standards.
  • Conduct internal process audits, support customer and certification audits, and drive timely resolution of findings.
  • Analyze quality, manufacturing, inspection, and warranty data to identify trends, reduce defects, minimize scrap and rework, and improve operational performance.
  • Develop and maintain quality planning and validation documentation, including PPAPs, Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, Measurement System Analyses (MSA), and Process Capability Studies.
  • Support process validation and qualification activities, including IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols where applicable.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to develop process controls, improve product quality, and ensure customer requirements are met.
  • Provide quality-related training and guidance, promote continuous improvement initiatives, and participate in Kaizen and operational excellence activities.

Requirements: 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in manufacturing quality, quality engineering, or a related technical role within a manufacturing environment.
  • 3+ years of experience applying root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies to investigate and resolve manufacturing or product quality issues.
  • 2+ years of experience working within an ISO 9001 quality management system, including internal audits, corrective actions, or quality-system compliance activities.
  • 3+ years of experience analyzing manufacturing or quality data to identify trends, process issues, or improvement opportunities and communicating findings and recommended actions to manufacturing, engineering, or operations teams.

Core Competencies 
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset – Looks beyond immediate fixes to identify opportunities for sustainable process, product, and quality improvement. 
  • Analytical Problem Solving – Uses data, quality metrics, root cause analysis, and sound judgment to identify issues, evaluate trends, and develop effective solutions. 
  • Customer Focus – Evaluates quality through the customer’s perspective and takes action to improve product performance, reliability, and overall customer satisfaction.
  • Ownership & Follow-Through – Takes personal accountability for commitments, respects deadlines, drives actions to completion, and operates effectively without constant direction.
  • Collaboration & Influence – Builds productive relationships across Engineering, Operations, Production, Supply Chain, and other functions to resolve issues and advance quality initiatives.
  • Quality & Compliance Excellence – Maintains high standards for quality, process discipline, documentation, and compliance while supporting effective quality management systems.

Preferences: 
  • Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or similar quality certification.
  • Experience with PPAP, PFMEA, MSA, SPC, and Process Capability Studies.
  • Experience supporting ISO 9001 certified manufacturing environments.
  • Working knowledge of GD&T, blueprint reading, and metrology systems.
  • Experience in machining, assembly, pump manufacturing, or other industrial manufacturing environments.

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • This position is fully site-based at the Monroe, Louisiana manufacturing facility. 
  • Occasional travel may be required to support customer audits, supplier visits, training, or other business needs.

What We Offer 
Our benefits –At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

Job Title: Field Service Engineer-II

Location: U.S. Remote - prefer Central Midwest region

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:

The Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer plays a critical role in supporting, integrating, and optimizing Precision Fastening Tools, Controllers, and Connected Manufacturing solutions within customer production environments. This position serves as the technical liaison between customers, service teams, and engineering organizations, ensuring reliable operation, seamless system integration, and exceptional customer satisfaction.

The engineer will be responsible for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, and support of fastening systems and related manufacturing technologies. This includes integration with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), PLCs, industrial networks, and digital I/O interfaces.

Through direct customer engagement and hands-on technical expertise, the Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer helps drive operational excellence, product reliability, and continuous improvement while supporting Ingersoll Rand's commitment to making life better through innovative manufacturing solutions.

Responsibilities

Field Service & Customer Support

  • Travel to customer facilities to install, commission, maintain, and troubleshoot precision fastening systems, controllers, and software solutions.
  • Provide onsite and remote technical support for customers, distributors, and internal service teams.
  • Diagnose and resolve software, hardware, networking, and process-related issues in production environments.
  • Conduct equipment assessments and recommend corrective actions to improve system performance and uptime.
  • Deliver customer training on product operation, software functionality, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • Support production launch activities and ensure successful implementation of connected manufacturing solutions.
Connected Manufacturing & Systems Integration

  • Ensure reliable wired & wireless communication between fastening tools and controllers.
  • Support integration & troubleshooting of communication between IR products and plant MES systems using open protocols like Power Focus Open Protocol (PFOP) and ToolsNet, and proprietary protocols for Ford, Volkswagen, Toyota, Stellantis and more.
  • Verify traceability, production reporting, recipe management, and quality data collection requirements.
  • Collaborate with customer automation, IT, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure reliable system performance.
  • Support Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory initiatives through deployment of connected manufacturing solutions.
Digital I/O & Automation Support

  • Configure and troubleshoot digital I/O communications between fastening controllers, PLCs, conveyors, robots, and automation equipment.
  • Verify machine interlocks, cycle complete signals, fault outputs, part-present inputs, and process control functions.
  • Support industrial communication protocols including Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC-UA.
  • Assist with factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), and production startup support.
Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring field issues and provide feedback to engineering and product management teams.
  • Support the development of service procedures, technical documentation, and best practices.
  • Stay current on manufacturing technology trends, industrial automation, and connected factory solutions.
  • Mentor service technicians and junior engineers as needed.
Qualifications:

  • 5+ Years of experience with MES with power tools communicating with PFOP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Digital I/O configuration and troubleshooting
  • 5+ Years of experience with Fieldbus communications with Profinet or EthernetIP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Software installation and validation
  • 5+ Years of experience with Configuring devices for Wi-Fi communications & troubleshooting
Core Competencies: 

  • Strong customer-facing communication skills
  • Ability to characterize, diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Effective collaboration across engineering, service, and customer teams
  • Willingness to travel extensively to support customer operations
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Joints, fasteners, power tools
  • Must be very comfortable with customer interaction! Will have a sales incentive bonus.
  • Exposure to industrial automation with OPC-UA, MES and Fieldbus protocols
  • Experience with devices communicating over Zigbee or 802.15.4
  • Experience with mobile app communications with devices over BLE or USB
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 
  • Regular Travel by car and plane to our customer sites in the US and Canada. Must have a valid passport or ability to get one. You will be provided with a company vehicle. 
Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is Min - 97000 - Max - 125000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Acheson, Alberta, Canada (Site-Based)

Job Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Production Supervisor to lead daily manufacturing and shop operations at our Acheson facility. This role is responsible for supervising production personnel, coordinating workflow, driving operational efficiency, maintaining inventory accuracy, supporting customer commitments, and ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and company standards. The ideal candidate is a strong people leader with experience in manufacturing operations, production planning, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of production employees, including mechanics, machinists, welders, and general labor personnel.
  • Coordinate daily production schedules, work orders, and shop activities to ensure on-time delivery and operational efficiency.
  • Promote a culture of safety by supporting EHS initiatives, reporting requirements, and compliance with site safety standards.
  • Review repair estimates, production requirements, and work order progress to support customer commitments.
  • Manage inventory accuracy, material planning, cycle counts, and supply chain coordination.
  • Monitor production performance, analyze variances, and implement process improvements to enhance operational effectiveness.
  • Support supplier relationships, onboarding activities, and procurement coordination as needed.
  • Oversee shipping, receiving, quality standards, equipment utilization, and facility operational performance.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of leadership or supervisory experience in a manufacturing, industrial, or service shop environment.
  • Experience managing production teams consisting of skilled trades and manufacturing personnel.
  • Knowledge of production planning, inventory management, and operational workflows.
  • Experience utilizing ERP systems; Oracle experience is considered an asset.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality, safety, and customer service expectations.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across departments.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership and team development.
  • Operational planning and execution.
  • Decision-making and problem-solving.
  • Safety and quality focus.
  • Customer service orientation.
  • Effective communication and collaboration.
  • Continuous improvement mindset.

Preferences

  • Degree or diploma in Manufacturing Technology, Industrial Maintenance, Logistics and Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience within the blower, rotating equipment, industrial service, or manufacturing industries.
  • Familiarity with workforce management systems such as Kronos or similar timekeeping platforms.
  • Experience with forecasting, backlog management, and production reporting.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing or Continuous Improvement methodologies.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • Fully site-based role located in Acheson, Alberta.
  • Regular presence in shop and manufacturing environments is required.
  • Minimal travel anticipated.

Job Title:

Lead Quality Engineer

Location:

Frederica, DE (Site-Based)

About Us

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview

ILC Dover, an Ingersoll Rand business, is seeking a Lead Quality Engineer to provide technical leadership and drive quality excellence across manufacturing operations supporting spacesuits, space systems, defense products, and other engineered solutions. This role partners closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Program teams to ensure products consistently meet customer, regulatory, and internal quality requirements while promoting operational excellence, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Lead quality engineering activities and provide mentoring, guidance, and technical leadership to Quality Engineers and Quality Technicians.
  • Develop and maintain quality plans, quality standards, and compliance processes supporting customer and program requirements.
  • Monitor quality performance metrics and communicate results to leadership while driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead root cause investigations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and resolution of customer complaints and quality escapes.
  • Facilitate risk assessments, PFMEA/FMEA activities, and implementation of controls that prevent recurring defects.
  • Support AS9100/ISO9001 quality management systems, audits, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Review and approve manufacturing instructions, drawing changes, test procedures, and product acceptance documentation.
  • Collaborate across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Program teams to ensure quality standards are achieved and maintained.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Must qualify as a U.S. Person in accordance with applicable U.S. export control regulations.
  • Minimum 5 years of progressive Quality Engineering or Quality Assurance experience within a manufacturing environment.
  • Minimum 5 years supporting AS9100, ISO9001, or similar Quality Management Systems.
  • Experience conducting root cause analysis, corrective actions, and quality investigations.
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, and approving First Article Inspection Reports (FAIRs).
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing quality systems, process control methodologies, and quality compliance requirements.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrated leadership ability with experience mentoring, coaching, and developing team members.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization capabilities.
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with customers, auditors, leadership, engineering, and manufacturing teams.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality, compliance, and customer satisfaction.

Preferences

  • ASQ, Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, or other quality-related certifications.
  • Experience within aerospace, space systems, defense, medical device, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Working knowledge of aerospace customer, regulatory, and quality requirements.
  • Experience utilizing ERP/MRP systems and electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS).
  • Experience applying Statistical Process Control (SPC) methodologies and data-driven quality improvement practices.
  • Experience leading cross-functional quality improvement initiatives and customer-facing quality activities.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This position is fully site-based.
  • Regular interaction with manufacturing and production operations is required.
  • Minimal travel anticipated based on business needs.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Job Overview:

The Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer plays a critical role in supporting, integrating, and optimizing Precision Fastening Tools, Controllers, and Connected Manufacturing solutions within customer production environments. This position serves as the technical liaison between customers, service teams, and engineering organizations, ensuring reliable operation, seamless system integration, and exceptional customer satisfaction.

The engineer will be responsible for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, and support of fastening systems and related manufacturing technologies. This includes integration with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), PLCs, industrial networks, and digital I/O interfaces.

Through direct customer engagement and hands-on technical expertise, the Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer helps drive operational excellence, product reliability, and continuous improvement while supporting Ingersoll Rand's commitment to making life better through innovative manufacturing solutions.

Responsibilities

Field Service & Customer Support

  • Travel to customer facilities to install, commission, maintain, and troubleshoot precision fastening systems, controllers, and software solutions.
  • Provide onsite and remote technical support for customers, distributors, and internal service teams.
  • Diagnose and resolve software, hardware, networking, and process-related issues in production environments.
  • Conduct equipment assessments and recommend corrective actions to improve system performance and uptime.
  • Deliver customer training on product operation, software functionality, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • Support production launch activities and ensure successful implementation of connected manufacturing solutions.
Connected Manufacturing & Systems Integration

  • Ensure reliable wired & wireless communication between fastening tools and controllers.
  • Support integration & troubleshooting of communication between IR products and plant MES systems using open protocols like Power Focus Open Protocol (PFOP) and ToolsNet, and proprietary protocols for Ford, Volkswagen, Toyota, Stellantis and more.
  • Verify traceability, production reporting, recipe management, and quality data collection requirements.
  • Collaborate with customer automation, IT, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure reliable system performance.
  • Support Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory initiatives through deployment of connected manufacturing solutions.
Digital I/O & Automation Support

  • Configure and troubleshoot digital I/O communications between fastening controllers, PLCs, conveyors, robots, and automation equipment.
  • Verify machine interlocks, cycle complete signals, fault outputs, part-present inputs, and process control functions.
  • Support industrial communication protocols including Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC-UA.
  • Assist with factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), and production startup support.
Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring field issues and provide feedback to engineering and product management teams.
  • Support the development of service procedures, technical documentation, and best practices.
  • Stay current on manufacturing technology trends, industrial automation, and connected factory solutions.
  • Mentor service technicians and junior engineers as needed.
Qualifications:

  • 5+ Years of experience with MES with power tools communicating with PFOP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Digital I/O configuration and troubleshooting
  • 5+ Years of experience with Fieldbus communications with Profinet or EthernetIP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Software installation and validation
  • 5+ Years of experience with Configuring devices for Wi-Fi communications & troubleshooting
Core Competencies: 

  • Strong customer-facing communication skills
  • Ability to characterize, diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Effective collaboration across engineering, service, and customer teams
  • Willingness to travel extensively to support customer operations
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Joints, fasteners, power tools
  • Must be very comfortable with customer interaction! Will have a sales incentive bonus.
  • Exposure to industrial automation with OPC-UA, MES and Fieldbus protocols
  • Experience with devices communicating over Zigbee or 802.15.4
  • Experience with mobile app communications with devices over BLE or USB
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 
  • Regular Travel by car and plane to our customer sites in the US and Canada. Must have a valid passport or ability to get one. You will be provided with a company vehicle.

You can manage competing priorities, remain professional during challenging conversations, and work both independently and collaboratively to find solutions.   • 2+ years' experience in customer facing role.

  • Demonstrates the ability to identify the most important elements that influence a problem and the ability to work through a series of operations to determine a logical solution.
  • Uses rigorous logic and methods to solve difficult problems with effective solutions. Probes all fruitful sources for answers and doesn't stop at the first answers.
  • Questions accepted practices, develops creative approaches, mitigates resistance to change and encourages others to do the same to promote progress through change. Previous experience conducting training is an advantage.
  • Cultivates strong, mutually beneficial customer relationships and works to earn the trust of the customer by ensuring that the company delivers value and acquires customer-driven insights to effectively address issues, needs and opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strategic relationships within various levels of customer’s organization.
  • Understands and communicates technical information. Writes and speaks clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
  • Practices attentive and active listening; has the patience to hear people out; can accurately restate the opinions of others even when he/she disagrees.
  • Knowledgeable about how organizations work; knows how to get things done both through formal channels and the informal network; understands the origin and reasoning behind key policies, practices, and procedures; understands the cultures of organizations.


Preferences:

  • Experience in or exposure to bookkeeping or other financial processes is preferred.
  • Understanding of operations and the supply demand flow is beneficial.

Job Overview: 
The Maintenance Techincian is responsible for the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of the CNC machines and manuafcturing machines. This role will deal with CNC Machines and working with PLC and Electronic Compents of our manufacturing machines.

Responsibilities:

  • Makes major electrical, mechanical, and construction repairs and installation involving schematics and/or blueprint interpretation.
  • Troubleshoots drive related issues to component level for Fanuc, Siemens, Allen Bradley and other brands of controllers.
  • Determines root cause of failures and recommends preventive actions.  Communicates same through work order system comments/history.
  • Communicates consistently with internal customers regarding status of equipment in shop.
  • Advises supervisor of needs for outside services and works with service representatives on equipment and controls repair and installation. Shows competency in several crafts and performs handyman aspects in all trades.
  • Constructs sketches of mechanical or construction alterations/installations and electrical circuitry.
  • Prepares bills of material on jobs requiring major material use and initiates purchase requisitions.
  • Makes day to day work-related decisions.
  • Uses various material handling equipment such as hoists, carts, lifts, fork trucks and hand trucks in moving light to heavy weight material. 
  • Uses a variety of lock-out/tag-out devices as required per plant LOTO Plan. 

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 2+ years of experience in Electronic Manufacturing Maintenance or industrial Maintenance

Key Competencies:

  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Exhibits team work skills
  • Ability to stand and walk up to 8 hours continuously during a shift.
  • Ability to lift up to 35 lbs alone, or 70 lbs with assistance, repeatedly over an 8 hour shift
  • Ability to push or pull up to 35 lbs.
  • Ability to see or have vision corrected with glasses/contacts to an evaluated level of no worse than 20/35.

Preferences:

  • Associates degree or higher in Electronic Technology or must show enrollment into course work for associates degree within 12 months of employment
  • Ability to troubleshoot and repair pneumatic, hydraulic, electrical, electronic, CNC machines and controls. 
  • Ability to work with concepts when detailed prints, drawings, and specifications are not available.
  • Ability to maintain technical documentation for equipment and processes.
  • Ability to maintain mechanical machine tools to include lathes, grinders, mills, drills, machining centers, and other similar equipment.
  • Ability to interpret schematics and blueprints.
 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position will be based at our site in Mocksville, NC, with no anticipated travel.

Job Title: Quality Engineer                
Location:  Monroe, LA
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
At Ingersoll Rand’s Monroe, Louisiana facility, precision-engineered products play a critical role in equipment customers depend on every day. The site manufactures and services THOMAS air compressor and vacuum pump products within an OEM portfolio serving medical, laboratory, environmental, and industrial markets. In this hands-on manufacturing environment, quality is measured not just by what leaves the line, but by how reliably the product performs for the customer—creating a meaningful opportunity to strengthen processes, systems, and overall plant performance.

We’re seeking a Quality Engineer who is a hands-on individual contributor focused on strengthening quality performance across the Monroe facility by turning quality challenges into sustainable process improvements. Rather than simply reacting to defects, this engineer will look at quality through the customer’s eyes—identifying trends, uncovering root causes, and building the processes, standards, controls, and corrective actions that prevent issues from recurring.  Partnering closely with Engineering, Operations, Production, Customer Service, and Supply Chain, this role will apply proven manufacturing quality practices—including process controls, quality metrics, and customer-focused problem solving—to improve process capability, reduce cost of poor quality, address customer complaints and returns, and strengthen overall product performance.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing quality experience, can quickly understand the operation, and is comfortable taking ownership and driving improvements with a high degree of independence. This is an opportunity for a builder—not simply a maintainer: someone energized by improving what exists, creating what is missing, and helping establish stronger, more sustainable quality practices as the operation continues to grow.

Responsibilities:
  • Lead investigations of customer complaints, warranty issues, and internal concfomromances using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, and PFMEA, implementing effective corrective and preventative actions. 
  • Support and continuously improve the site's Quality Management System, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable company quality standards.
  • Conduct internal process audits, support customer and certification audits, and drive timely resolution of findings.
  • Analyze quality, manufacturing, inspection, and warranty data to identify trends, reduce defects, minimize scrap and rework, and improve operational performance.
  • Develop and maintain quality planning and validation documentation, including PPAPs, Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEAs, Control Plans, Measurement System Analyses (MSA), and Process Capability Studies.
  • Support process validation and qualification activities, including IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols where applicable.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to develop process controls, improve product quality, and ensure customer requirements are met.
  • Provide quality-related training and guidance, promote continuous improvement initiatives, and participate in Kaizen and operational excellence activities.

Requirements: 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in manufacturing quality, quality engineering, or a related technical role within a manufacturing environment.
  • 3+ years of experience applying root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies to investigate and resolve manufacturing or product quality issues.
  • 2+ years of experience working within an ISO 9001 quality management system, including internal audits, corrective actions, or quality-system compliance activities.
  • 3+ years of experience analyzing manufacturing or quality data to identify trends, process issues, or improvement opportunities and communicating findings and recommended actions to manufacturing, engineering, or operations teams.

Core Competencies 
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset – Looks beyond immediate fixes to identify opportunities for sustainable process, product, and quality improvement. 
  • Analytical Problem Solving – Uses data, quality metrics, root cause analysis, and sound judgment to identify issues, evaluate trends, and develop effective solutions.

Job Overview:

The Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer plays a critical role in supporting, integrating, and optimizing Precision Fastening Tools, Controllers, and Connected Manufacturing solutions within customer production environments. This position serves as the technical liaison between customers, service teams, and engineering organizations, ensuring reliable operation, seamless system integration, and exceptional customer satisfaction.

The engineer will be responsible for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, and support of fastening systems and related manufacturing technologies. This includes integration with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), PLCs, industrial networks, and digital I/O interfaces.

Through direct customer engagement and hands-on technical expertise, the Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer helps drive operational excellence, product reliability, and continuous improvement while supporting Ingersoll Rand's commitment to making life better through innovative manufacturing solutions.

Responsibilities

Field Service & Customer Support

  • Travel to customer facilities to install, commission, maintain, and troubleshoot precision fastening systems, controllers, and software solutions.
  • Provide onsite and remote technical support for customers, distributors, and internal service teams.
  • Diagnose and resolve software, hardware, networking, and process-related issues in production environments.
  • Conduct equipment assessments and recommend corrective actions to improve system performance and uptime.
  • Deliver customer training on product operation, software functionality, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • Support production launch activities and ensure successful implementation of connected manufacturing solutions.
Connected Manufacturing & Systems Integration

  • Ensure reliable wired & wireless communication between fastening tools and controllers.
  • Support integration & troubleshooting of communication between IR products and plant MES systems using open protocols like Power Focus Open Protocol (PFOP) and ToolsNet, and proprietary protocols for Ford, Volkswagen, Toyota, Stellantis and more.
  • Verify traceability, production reporting, recipe management, and quality data collection requirements.
  • Collaborate with customer automation, IT, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure reliable system performance.
  • Support Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory initiatives through deployment of connected manufacturing solutions.
Digital I/O & Automation Support

  • Configure and troubleshoot digital I/O communications between fastening controllers, PLCs, conveyors, robots, and automation equipment.
  • Verify machine interlocks, cycle complete signals, fault outputs, part-present inputs, and process control functions.
  • Support industrial communication protocols including Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC-UA.
  • Assist with factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), and production startup support.
Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring field issues and provide feedback to engineering and product management teams.
  • Support the development of service procedures, technical documentation, and best practices.
  • Stay current on manufacturing technology trends, industrial automation, and connected factory solutions.
  • Mentor service technicians and junior engineers as needed.
Qualifications:

  • 5+ Years of experience with MES with power tools communicating with PFOP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Digital I/O configuration and troubleshooting
  • 5+ Years of experience with Fieldbus communications with Profinet or EthernetIP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Software installation and validation
  • 5+ Years of experience with Configuring devices for Wi-Fi communications & troubleshooting
Core Competencies: 

  • Strong customer-facing communication skills
  • Ability to characterize, diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Effective collaboration across engineering, service, and customer teams
  • Willingness to travel extensively to support customer operations
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Joints, fasteners, power tools
  • Must be very comfortable with customer interaction! Will have a sales incentive bonus.
  • Exposure to industrial automation with OPC-UA, MES and Fieldbus protocols
  • Experience with devices communicating over Zigbee or 802.15.4
  • Experience with mobile app communications with devices over BLE or USB
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 
  • Regular Travel by car and plane to our customer sites in the US and Canada. Must have a valid passport or ability to get one. You will be provided with a company vehicle. 
Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is Min - 97000 - Max - 125000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

job.description:
Ingersoll Rand is committed to achieving workforce diversity reflective of our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer. Service Technician  

Location: Multiple positions located at or near our East Customer Center Locations - Allentown, PA; Aston, PA; Edison, NJ; Marlborough, MA; Scarsborough, ME; Shrewsbury, PA; Richmond, VA; Greensboro, NC; Charlotte, NC. This role is typically not eligible for relocation. If a position is not currently open in an area that you are seeking employment, we will reach out to qualified candidates once an opening is available. 

 

About Us  

Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems.? 

? 

Job Summary? 

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
    ? 

Responsibilities? 

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location.? 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment.? 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.? 

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility.??? 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.? 

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner.? 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers.? 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.? 

? 

Basic Qualifications? 

  • Desired applicants will have 2-5 years’ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus.? While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply.? 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.?? 

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus.???Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.? 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).? 

 

Physical Requirements 

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 

  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 

? 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements? 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training.  1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%).? 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.  

? 

Key Competencies? 

  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.? Working proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.? 

  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc.? 

  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 

  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 

?

These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.?

The disclosed pay range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.
