Job Title: Project Engineer

Location: Buffalo, NY

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.


Job Overview:

The Project Engineer is a key member of the project management team and the primary technical point of contact for customers during execution of complex ETO centrifugal compressors. This role turns contractual and customer requirements into a clear, executable technical plan while coordinating engineering, manufacturing, quality, sourcing, vendors, and project management.

Success in this position requires strong technical judgment, disciplined follow-through, commercial awareness, and the ability to communicate complex information clearly. The Project Engineer maintains visibility to scope, schedule, documentation, risk, change, and project financial health throughout the contract lifecycle.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Lead technical project execution:

· Review purchase orders, customer specifications, clarifications, deviations, and internal order documentation to confirm that contract requirements are complete, accurate, and understood before execution.

· Own the technical handoff from order acceptance through shipment, helping the project team translate scope into deliverables, decisions, actions, and milestones.

· Monitor technical execution against the project schedule, identify risks or slippage early, and coordinate recovery actions with the Project Manager and functional teams.

Serve as the customer technical liaison:

· Act as the primary technical contact for assigned projects and provide clear, timely communication on requirements, submittals, open items, decisions, and status.

· Lead technical discussions to resolve questions, align expectations, and document decisions while maintaining awareness of contractual commitments.

· Issue customer-facing technical documentation and provide regular schedule updates in coordination with the Project Manager.

Manage scope, change, and project risk:

· Monitor scope throughout execution, including customer comments, specification changes, and drawing markups; identify potential scope growth and escalate it promptly.

· Partner with the Project Manager to evaluate the technical, cost, and schedule impacts of customer change requests and support development of change orders.

· Maintain accurate action, risk, and decision records so accountability and due dates remain clear.

Drive documentation, quality, and delivery readiness:

· Coordinate the preparation, review, and transmittal of contract documents, including drawings, data sheets, test reports, manuals, and project-specific technical documentation.

· Create and maintain the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP), coordinate customer witness and hold points, and support inspections and performance testing.

· Partner with Quality on pre-shipment inspection and customer coordination.

· Support revenue-recognition activities by helping confirm completion of applicable technical and contractual milestones.

Provide technical product support:

· Apply working knowledge of centrifugal compressors and associated systems, including gearboxes, lubrication systems, intercoolers, controls, motors or drivers, and auxiliary equipment.

· Review major buyout and supplier documentation for alignment with project requirements.

· Provide technical support for proposals, field questions, troubleshooting, and post-shipment activities when needed.


Required Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering.

· 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial, manufacturing, or engineered-to-order environment.

 

Core Competencies:

· Understanding of engineering, manufacturing, inspection, testing, and supplier processes. General knowledge of centrifugal compressor systems is strongly preferred.

· Ability to manage multiple deliverables, priorities, interfaces, and deadlines in a technical project environment.

· Clear written and verbal communication with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams; able to build trusted working relationships.

· Accountable, organized, proactive, collaborative, and detail-oriented, with sound judgment and a commitment to quality.

 

Tools and systems:

· Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications. Experience with scheduling, spreadsheet, collaboration, and document-control tools is expected.

· Experience with ERP and business systems such as SAP or Oracle is preferred.

· Experience reading engineering drawings and specifications is required; 3D modeling or drafting experience is a plus.

 

How success is demonstrated:

· Contract requirements are translated into complete, accurate, and actionable technical direction.

· Customers and internal stakeholders receive timely, clear, and consistent communication.

· Risks, scope changes, and schedule impacts are identified early and managed with documented ownership.

· Project documentation, inspections, testing, and shipment activities are completed in alignment with contractual requirements.

· Cross-functional teams can rely on the Project Engineer for technical leadership, follow-through, and informed decision support.


Travel Requirement:

· 10% domestic and international travel.

Pay Range
The pay range for this role is Min - 80000 - Max - 95000 . The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

What We Offer

Job Title: Regional Sales Manager - Elmo Rietschle
Location: Remote in Territory: NM, TX, KS, OK, MO, AR, LA, MS, W. TN, KY, S. IL, IN, S. OH, WV, AL, FL, GA

About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) will be responsible for increasing revenue and achieving sales targets in the assigned geographic territory. The RSM will work closely with the distribution network to identify the addressable market and generate opportunities within the territory. RSM will maintain regular communication and constructive relationships with senior leadership, Customers, Channel Partners, End Users and other internal and external stakeholders. A strong understanding of the selling process, a technical acumen and outstanding written and verbal communication skills are essential in this role. RSM must have the skill sets defined below to competently discuss, share knowledge, train and troubleshoot our products to a variety of stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and Develop Channel Partners: Build, manage, and develop a robust network of Channel Partners to drive the sale of Elmo Rietschle products. Assess partner competencies to identify strengths and areas of improvement, develop action plans, and appoint new partners in underperforming areas to meet business goals.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders to Drive Strategy: Work closely with Channel Partner Principals, Product Champions, and the National Sales Manager to develop and execute territory strategies that align with revenue, margin, and growth targets.
  • Lead Sales Activities and Pipeline Development: Identify, qualify, and pursue opportunities through cold calls, market research, and maintain a network of industry contacts. Drive sales activity through Channel Partners to achieve measurable outcomes and maintain a documented pipeline via Salesforce.
  • Provide Technical and Product Support: Offer product education and technical assistance to customers, including troubleshooting, installation guidance, and identifying causes of product malfunctions to maintain the high-quality image of Elmo Rietschle products.
  • Engage in Sales Cycle and Account Management: Actively participate in all stages of the sales cycle, including quoting, account management, and assisting with collections. Establish measurable goals for targeted accounts and provide regular updates on progress and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work with internal teams such as Engineering, Product Management, Business Development, and Operations to ensure seamless implementation, new product commercialization, and effective account growth.
  • Lead Customer Engagement and Presentations: Schedule, facilitate, and lead presentations to customers while attending industry trade shows and conferences to establish contacts, identify trends, and proactively develop leads.
  • Oversee Channel Partner Network: Supervise a large network of Channel Partner organizations across multiple states, ensuring alignment with Elmo Rietschle’s standards and objectives.


Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or related field.
  • 3+ years of sales experience in industrial Sales with Blowers, Vacuums or Rotating equipment.


Core Competencies:

  • Channel Sales Expertise: Strong understanding of channel sales strategies, including managing partner networks, driving revenue growth, and achieving measurable results through collaboration.
  • Product and Market Knowledge: Expertise in dry and lubricated vacuum technologies, booster blowers, and other rotating equipment, with the ability to articulate the value proposition of Elmo Rietschle products in customer terms.
  • Strategic Thinking and Planning: Ability to assess market opportunities, develop actionable strategies, and set specific, measurable goals to drive growth and profitability.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: Skilled at building strong relationships, understanding customer needs, and providing tailored solutions to ensure high satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in providing technical support, troubleshooting product issues, and guiding customers through product selection, installation, and maintenance.
  • Strong Communication and Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and persuasion skills to foster positive relationships with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Time and Task Management: Highly organized with strong time management skills, ensuring timely execution of tasks while balancing multiple priorities effectively.
  • Business Acumen: High level of business and financial acumen, enabling informed decision-making and alignment with organizational goals.
  • Self-Motivation and Discipline: Demonstrates intrinsic motivation, a disciplined work style, and the ability to work independently while contributing as part of a team.
  • Technology Proficiency: Skilled in using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook) and CRM tools like Salesforce to document and manage sales opportunities.


Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in: Engineering, Business, or Business degree with strong hydraulic/pneumatic systems experience demonstrated.
  • Candidates must demonstrate strong experience with positive displacement, blower systems, vacuums, or rotating equipment.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and SAP


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
Up to 50%+ overnight travel is expected. This is a remote based position that is to be located near a major airport in the Northeast U.S.

The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $110,000 - $125,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Job Title: Materials Planner (Buyer)
Location: Charlotte, NC

Job Overview:
The Materials Planner (Buyer) plays a critical role in ensuring a reliable, on-time flow of materials that keeps our customers, production lines, and service operations running seamlessly. In this dynamic distribution environment, you’ll manage the full lifecycle of material planning—placing and maintaining purchase orders, optimizing supply, and partnering closely with suppliers to deliver quality materials when they’re needed most. You will also drive engineering change coordination, enabling smooth, cost-effective transitions between parts while eliminating waste and minimizing operational disruption. Success in this role requires sharp analytical skills, proactive communication, and the ability to stay composed and decisive in a fast-paced setting. Working cross-functionally, you’ll help solve supply chain challenges, enhance planning efficiency, and contribute to strategic initiatives such as global SAP implementation. This role provides meaningful visibility across the organization and the opportunity to make a tangible, lasting impact on our global operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Plan and manage purchased parts and service parts requirements to meet production schedules and variable customer demand.
  • Place, maintain, and adjust purchase orders for raw materials, ensure accurate data in the ERP system and timely updates to quantities, due dates, and order status.
  • Monitor inventory levels and material flow, making proactive decisions to release, cancel, or defer work based on demand, capacity, and production objectives.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to ensure on-time delivery, expedite or deter shipments as needed, and resolve issues impacting material supply.
  • Facilitate engineering changes (ECNs) by coordinating effectivity dates, updating bills of material, and managing inventory transitions to minimize scrap and cost impact.
  • Support cross-functional problem-solving, including Accounts Payable discrepancies, pricing issues, and supplier-related challenges.
  • Analyze and report planning data, preparing monthly and management reports to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
  • Represent Production Planning in meetings, communicating updates and ensuring alignment across operations, engineering, and supply chain teams.


Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 3+ years’ experience working in a production / manufacturing environment
  • 3+ years of purchasing experience and managing suppliers
  • 3+ years of experience in negotiating capabilities suppliers
  • 2+ years of experience in hitting cost reduction targets and project implementation
  • 2+ years of experience with MRP/ERP, JIT, or Kanban [AP1]


Core Competencies:

  • Solid understanding of purchasing, planning, operations, and quality control processes that drive supply chain performance.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple suppliers while maintaining accuracy and oversight across large SKU and part number portfolios.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook to analyze data, build reports, and communicate effectively.
  • Strong capability in monitoring inventory health—identifying shortages, preventing stockouts, and ensuring operational and aftermarket readiness.
  • Experience owning key performance metrics, including FPSL (First Pass Service Level), PDBL (Past Due Backlog), and OTS (On-Time Shipments).
  • Strong mathematical skills are paired with clear, effective written and verbal communication.


Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience with SAP
  • Purchasing or Material Certifications and/or membership
  • Manufacturing or distribution experience


Travel and Work Arrangements

  • This position is fully on site in Charlotte, NC

Job Title: Inventory Control Coordinator

Department: Inventory Control

Reports To: Team Lead/ Supervisor

Location: Southern Pines, NC

FLSA Status: Hourly/Non-exempt

POSITION SUMMARY: Position focuses on the systematic receiving, movement, and verification of all parts and materials used in assembly or machining operations. Inventory Control Clerks will perform data entry into the MRP system, conduct/verify cycle counts, and perform audits. In addition to these duties, they are also capable of performing any of the functions associated with the physical completion of work orders and sales orders.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The responsibilities of the Inventory Control Clerk include the following job duties. The responsibilities are not limited to these tasks. Other job duties may be assigned.

  • Monitor all departments as appropriate to ensure inventory transactions and location movements are turned in a timely manner as per schedule.
  • Perform data entry, as required, to ensure all transactions are entered.
  • Perform audits on cycle counts, inbound receipt, and outbound transactions.
  • Investigate missing items and report losses and trends to management.
  • Ensure proper resolution of consignment sales and returns.
  • Prepare the paperwork for the justification of planned and unplanned transactions
  • Use of a computer and/or barcode scanner to perform cycle counting of parts.
  • Coordinate inventory tasks to include transfers, sell off orders, and price changes.
  • Ensure appropriate management levels are aware of inventory problems, and that corrective measures are implemented as directed.
  • Reads work order or follows oral instructions to determine materials transactions, releasing or moving stock to release or change part locations.
  • Operates forklift, hand truck, and/or other material handling equipment to assist with performing job duties as needed.
  • Assists with inventory management of packing materials, maintaining an organized work area, and the management of waste streams including cardboard recycling.
  • Follows all ISO procedures and safety rules, including wearing personal protective equipment.
  • Cross train in and work for other departments as needed.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.

  • Prior experience in cycle counting or material handling desirable.
  • Mathematical skills: add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.
  • Able to work overtime when necessary.
  • Language skills – English proficiency required; able to read and comprehend documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals, short correspondence, and memos. Able to effectively present information in one on one and small group situations. Able to write legibly.
  • Able to become certified on forklift and other material handling devices.
  • Able to use computer and/or barcode scanner to learn business computer systems such as MFG-Pro.
  • Good interpersonal skills and able to interact positively and work cooperatively in a team environment.
  • Analytical skills to identify issues, trends and proper solution to resolve any inventory issues.
  • Self-motivated and willing to change priorities as needed.
  • Willing to participate in continuous learning opportunities for personal and job development.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required.
  • 3 years of warehouse experience.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a retail or warehouse inventory control or receiving function, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
  • APICS (American Production and Inventory Control Society) certification a plus.

Lead operations for Flexan’s Lincolnshire manufacturing facility. This individual will ensure that approved products are manufactured and supplied on schedule meeting quality standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive the development and execution of short- and long-term operational strategies aligned with corporate goals, while establishing and tracking KPIs to measure safety, quality, delivery, cost, and People (SQDCP)
  • Ensure a safe and clean work environment as per OSHA 2201-08R by educating and directing personnel on the use of all control points, equipment, and resources to protect all employees from injuries.

  • Leading a culture of Continuous Improvement, Ownership and Accountability every day in everything we do.

  • Assist in the development of site Annual Operating Plans and Multi-Year Make Life Better (MLB) Plans for the site.
  • Lead and deploy objectives specifically to support Cost Improvement and competitive manufacturing operating costs and driving its organization to eliminate any cost of quality.
  • Capacity planning and understanding of the customer programs (new and existing) and status to ensure compliance with short- and long-term launch projects a.k.a. NPIs.
  • Identify, develop and reward the talent and expertise of manufacturing staff team, by supporting sound processes for staff selection and development, pay administration, coaching and mentoring.
  • Forecast capital CAPEX for facility and equipment improvements, replacement and/or modification.

  • Work closely with the Sales and Business Development team to grow the operation while ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Promote an atmosphere of inclusion, open communication and trust, to foster team development and associate engagement.
  • Monitor the alignment of products demands with production schedule (MPS) and material planning to meet production goals.
  • Provide leadership to associates in all areas including hiring, performance management, coaching, counseling and corrective actions.
  • Partner with all factories within Flexan to improve the profitability of the corporation and look for ways to improve Gross Margin.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance and makes recommendations for the improvement of policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrates, embodies and teaches all of Ingersoll Rand’s Corporate Values.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • 10+ years of management/manufacturing experience with direct P&L oversight and strong financial acumen
  • Proven management capabilities: prior leadership experience in a manufacturing environment (experience with LEAN manufacturing practices desired); able to be firm and hold people accountable; excellent clear communication skills; able to motivate supervisors and peers


Preferences

  • Strategic thinking: ability to establish priorities, processes, and standards. A decisive individual who possesses a “big picture” perspective
  • Problem Solving: proactive in identifying potential problems or opportunities to increase productivity and quality, decrease waste and improve morale
  • Works well under pressure and operates effectively in a fast-paced team environment
  • Demonstrates excellent communication skills and can bring together different personalities around common goals; excellent at listening, identifying root causes of concerns and mediating differences
  • Proven ability to organize, prioritize and manage multiple tasks; must be highly self-motivated and able to operate autonomously or on a team in a dynamic environment

Service Technician  

Location: Multiple positions located at or near our East Customer Center Locations - Allentown, PA; Aston, PA; Edison, NJ; Marlborough, MA; Scarsborough, ME; Shrewsbury, PA; Richmond, VA; Greensboro, NC; Charlotte, NC. This role is typically not eligible for relocation. If a position is not currently open in an area that you are seeking employment, we will reach out to qualified candidates once an opening is available. 

 

About Us  

Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems.? 

? 

Job Summary? 

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
    ? 

Responsibilities? 

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location.? 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment.? 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.? 

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility.??? 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.? 

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner.? 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers.? 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.? 

? 

Basic Qualifications? 

  • Desired applicants will have 2-5 years’ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus.? While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply.? 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.?? 

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus.???Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.? 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).? 

 

Physical Requirements

?

?

  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.? Working proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.?

?

Title: Restore Assembler
Location: Sidney, OH Facility (LeRoi - 211 E Russell Rd. Sidney, OH 45365)
Shift: 1st Shift (Monday-Friday 6am-2:30pm)
Pay: Starting rate at $23.00-$28.00 per hour

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Assembler to perform a variety of tasks associated with the rebuilding and assembly of Gas End compressors. This position is responsible for ensuring all parts fit correctly, meet quality standards, and are suitable for the final product.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge, excellent manual dexterity, and the ability to interpret and follow instructions from manuals, drawings, blueprints, and schematics with precision. This role also requires the use of computer systems to record safety test data, inspection reports, and production-related information. Assignments may vary based on business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Disassemble, clean, inspect, and rebuild Gas End compressors using a combination of new and reusable parts.
  • Read, understand, and follow method sheets, assembly diagrams, blueprints, and technical drawings.
  • Identify quality defects and unsafe conditions.
  • Follow all applicable safety rules, policies, and procedures.
  • Interpret print drawings to determine dimensions, design specifications, and required materials.
  • Safely operate pneumatic, power, and hand tools required to perform job duties.
  • Use measuring devices such as tape measures, levels, and other inspection tools.
  • Maintain and inspect tools and equipment and create work orders for necessary repairs.
  • Load and unload materials using conveyors, carts, forklifts, hoists, and other material-handling equipment.
  • Collaborate with team members and support other departments as needed.
  • Suggest process improvements that enhance safety, quality, and productivity.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment.
  • Monitor inventory levels and assist with material replenishment and receiving activities.
  • Assemble components and subassemblies by examining connections for proper fit and fastening parts securely.
  • Perform general housekeeping duties within the work area.
  • Complete production-related tasks, including but not limited to pipe bending, sledging, operating presses, hanging and unhanging parts, and conducting quality inspections and tests.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Supervisor or Team Leader.

Requirements

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Fully trained and qualified to train others on multiple products in accordance with the company training matrix.
  • Ability to participate in 5 Why root cause analyses and implement corrective actions for process and product-related issues.

Core Competencies

  • Commitment to following all company policies, procedures, and safety guidelines.
  • Ability to use sound judgment and prior experience to plan and accomplish assigned tasks.
  • Ability to learn and safely operate equipment associated with the role, including power hand tools, forklifts, skyjacks, cranes, and measuring devices.
  • Ability to identify routine issues, determine root causes, and implement corrective actions.
  • Working knowledge of standard work instructions and manufacturing processes.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a manufacturing environment.
  • Detail-oriented and self-motivated with a strong work ethic.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multitasking environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a LeRoi manufacturing environment preferred; equivalent experience with compressor or air recovery product assembly will also be considered.
  • Proficient in the use of hand tools, including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, steel banding tools, pipe benders, saws, and threading equipment.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and understanding of manufacturing processes.
  • Experience using power tools safely and effectively.
  • Proficiency with computer systems and material management processes.

Equal Employment Opportunity

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. Job Overview:

The Project Engineer is a key member of the project management team and the primary technical point of contact for customers during execution of complex ETO centrifugal compressors. This role turns contractual and customer requirements into a clear, executable technical plan while coordinating engineering, manufacturing, quality, sourcing, vendors, and project management.

Success in this position requires strong technical judgment, disciplined follow-through, commercial awareness, and the ability to communicate complex information clearly. The Project Engineer maintains visibility to scope, schedule, documentation, risk, change, and project financial health throughout the contract lifecycle.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Lead technical project execution:

· Review purchase orders, customer specifications, clarifications, deviations, and internal order documentation to confirm that contract requirements are complete, accurate, and understood before execution.

· Own the technical handoff from order acceptance through shipment, helping the project team translate scope into deliverables, decisions, actions, and milestones.

· Monitor technical execution against the project schedule, identify risks or slippage early, and coordinate recovery actions with the Project Manager and functional teams.

Serve as the customer technical liaison:

· Act as the primary technical contact for assigned projects and provide clear, timely communication on requirements, submittals, open items, decisions, and status.

· Lead technical discussions to resolve questions, align expectations, and document decisions while maintaining awareness of contractual commitments.

· Issue customer-facing technical documentation and provide regular schedule updates in coordination with the Project Manager.

Manage scope, change, and project risk:

· Monitor scope throughout execution, including customer comments, specification changes, and drawing markups; identify potential scope growth and escalate it promptly.

· Partner with the Project Manager to evaluate the technical, cost, and schedule impacts of customer change requests and support development of change orders.

· Maintain accurate action, risk, and decision records so accountability and due dates remain clear.

Drive documentation, quality, and delivery readiness:

· Coordinate the preparation, review, and transmittal of contract documents, including drawings, data sheets, test reports, manuals, and project-specific technical documentation.

· Create and maintain the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP), coordinate customer witness and hold points, and support inspections and performance testing.

· Partner with Quality on pre-shipment inspection and customer coordination.

· Support revenue-recognition activities by helping confirm completion of applicable technical and contractual milestones.

Provide technical product support:

· Apply working knowledge of centrifugal compressors and associated systems, including gearboxes, lubrication systems, intercoolers, controls, motors or drivers, and auxiliary equipment.

· Review major buyout and supplier documentation for alignment with project requirements.

· Provide technical support for proposals, field questions, troubleshooting, and post-shipment activities when needed.


Required Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering.

· 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial, manufacturing, or engineered-to-order environment.

 

Core Competencies:

· Understanding of engineering, manufacturing, inspection, testing, and supplier processes. General knowledge of centrifugal compressor systems is strongly preferred.

· Ability to manage multiple deliverables, priorities, interfaces, and deadlines in a technical project environment.

· Clear written and verbal communication with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams; able to build trusted working relationships.

· Accountable, organized, proactive, collaborative, and detail-oriented, with sound judgment and a commitment to quality.

 

Tools and systems:

· Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications. Experience with scheduling, spreadsheet, collaboration, and document-control tools is expected.

· Experience with ERP and business systems such as SAP or Oracle is preferred.

· Experience reading engineering drawings and specifications is required; 3D modeling or drafting experience is a plus.

 

How success is demonstrated:

· Contract requirements are translated into complete, accurate, and actionable technical direction.

· Customers and internal stakeholders receive timely, clear, and consistent communication.

· Risks, scope changes, and schedule impacts are identified early and managed with documented ownership.

· Project documentation, inspections, testing, and shipment activities are completed in alignment with contractual requirements.

· Cross-functional teams can rely on the Project Engineer for technical leadership, follow-through, and informed decision support.


Travel Requirement:

· 10% domestic and international travel.

Pay Range
The pay range for this role is Min - 80000 - Max - 95000 . The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

What We Offer 
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Job Summary:

Ingersoll Rand’s Compression Systems and Services Customer Center is hiring a General Line Account Manager to join their team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the Customer Center equipment sales and service activity for a specific territory: San Bernardino/Riverside. Traveling in a defined geographic area, this includes quoting, strategizing, prospecting, and developing relationships to achieve revenue targets, maximize profits, increase market share and maintain customer loyalty while achieving organizational goals. The position is a unique blend of supporting a major distributor and selling direct to customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Generate Revenue - Responsible for generating sales of equipment, service contracts, and service offerings with our direct end users and partners selling to a defined customer base within a geographic area. Develop existing customer base and secure new, competitive accounts to expand IR presence in the market. Provide and design compressed air solutions to fulfil industrial customer needs. Products include compressed air equipment, accessories, turnkey installations, service contracts, parts, service, rental equipment and energy audits. Keep current with all product knowledge, industry standards and training needed. Execute strategy for continuous improvement and exceeding customer satisfaction. Achieve all assigned sales targets.
  • Develop People Capabilities - Provide selling skills and product/services training for dealer sales personnel (as required) as well as personnel within the Customer Center. Partner with services team to best understand products and services and satisfy and anticipate customer’s needs.
  • Manage Cash - Ensure that all orders obtained are error-free with correct customer documentation. Ensure resolution of all customer disputes. Manage all costs associated with selling efforts, including travel and entertainment expenditures.
  • Ensure adherence to safety rules (vehicle safety, customer site safety) in the field, as well as in the Customer Center.
  • Earn customer loyalty by collaborating cross functionally. Leverage best support for customers by partnering with service team to help troubleshoot customer issues or offer unique solutions.
  • Maintain Customer Relationship Management database including face-to-face customer interactions, assets, agreements, contacts, and opportunities in order management system. Record order follow-up activities (e.g. delivery), reporting requirements (email) and database requirements. Provide feedback on market conditions. Responsible for driving and tracking sales pipeline of all account activity and daily reporting.


Requirements:

  • High School Diploma
  • 2+ years’ experience in an industrial sales business setting or successful completion of the Ingersoll Rand Sales Development Program (SDP).


Core Competencies:

  • Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills, including verbal, written and presentation communication skills.
  • Establishes and builds solid relationships with customers, key institutions and team members
  • Honest, self-motivated and team oriented.
  • Able to work within a team environment and independently.
  • Ability to assess customer needs, analyze and interpret, perform basic equipment performance calculations, and to recommend technical solutions
  • Proven business and sales acumen, including the ability to prospect accounts, effectively navigate within a customer organization, value sell, and win competitive accounts


Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, business or equivalent
  • Knowledge of Salesforce. Tech savvy; knowledge of Salesforce or other CRM software is preferred
  • Mechanical and electrical expertise required.


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Regional travel to customer sites is required within assigned geographic territory.

Job Title: Quality Inspector

Position Summary:

We are seeking a Mechanical Inspector to join our team! This individual will be responsible for dimensional, visual, and surface finish, inspections of machined parts and assemblies, consisting of first article, in process, and final inspection. Must be detailed orientated in recording all inspections performed accurately and timely, as well as assuring all non-conformance reports are recorded.

Responsibilities:

  • Self-motivated, organized individual with ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
  • Positive attitude with the ability to work with a sense of urgency.
  • Ability to multi-task
  • Time management skills.
  • Demonstrates a strong work ethic, integrity and personal accountability.
  • Must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Interacts with all departments to assure product is correct and on schedule.
  • Commercial Standard Practices apply.
  • First Article, In-Process, and Final Inspection of complex parts and assemblies.
  • Dimensional, visual and surface finish inspection of assemblies, sub-assemblies, finished and semi-finished components, identifying any and all issues with material, workmanship, or process.
  • Mechanical inspection using digital calipers, micrometers, height and depth gages, microscopes, Starrett vision machine, and typical shop gaging. Familiar with the tools and equipment and shall have demonstrated proficiency in their use.
  • Must be able to understand and interpret geometric tolerance.
  • Identify and document non-conforming parts using our ERP system
  • Additional duties as assigned.
  • Programming experience with a Starrett Coordinate Measuring machine a plus.
  • Experience working with revision-controlled drawings.
  • Adherence to safety procedures/guidelines at all times.
  • Capable of determining the calibration status of inspection and measuring equipment is in proper condition for use, and that inspection, examination and test procedures are approved.
  • ERP system usage/knowledge a plus.
  • Ability to evaluate and troubleshoot the process and trends of machined parts and offer suggestions/solutions to continue quality of product.
  • Maintain a clean and safe work environment

  • Lifting/pushing/pulling/carrying up to
  • 05 lbs. constantly
  • 35 lbs. frequently
  • 50 lbs. occasionally

  • Regular exposure to heat, dirt, grease and fumes.
  • Regular exposure to noise levels exceeding 85 db. (hearing protection required when exposure exceeds 85db)

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or General Equivalent Diploma (GED), required
  • 3 or more years’ experience in a manufacturing quality-controlled environment conducting mechanical inspections to Commercial Standards.
  • Experience using various hand, pneumatic, and power tools, such as screwdrivers, wrenches, drills, and presses
  • Ability to read and understand the bill of materials and work order instructions, blueprints, or technical drawings
  • Demonstrated time management skills, strategic thinking, and adaptability
  • General computer knowledge (i.e. log on credentials, Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word and Excel)
  • Ability to lift up to 35lbs

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirement

  • Fully site based

Key Competencies

  • Communication
  • Efficiency
  • Productivity
  • Accuracy
  • Teamwork
  • Integrity
  • Problem Solving
  • Detail Oriented
  • Gauges and Instruments
  • Blueprints

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Job Overview

The Production Line Plumber Brazer assembles industrial piping systems used in industrial refrigeration equipment. This position requires strong mechanical aptitude, careful workmanship, and a consistent commitment to safety, quality, and accurate installation.

Responsibilities

  • Assemble copper and steel piping systems for industrial refrigeration equipment.
  • Measure, cut, fit, and prepare tubing and pipe according to specifications.
  • Braze refrigeration piping using proper techniques and established safety procedures.
  • Install valves, fittings, compressors, heat exchangers, and related components.
  • Read and follow mechanical drawings, piping layouts, and Bills of Material (BOMs).
  • Inspect completed work for leaks, accuracy, and proper installation.
  • Maintain a clean, organized work area and support continuous improvement activities.
  • Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and quality standards.

Requirements

The portfolio includes single-use containment systems that help protect people and products during pharmaceutical production.

The Regional Sales Manager will develop account strategies, manage customer relationships, and coordinate technical and commercial resources throughout the sales process. Working closely with Field Application Specialists and other internal teams, this role helps customers identify solutions that meet application requirements and support operational and business objectives.

Responsibilities

• Develop and execute territory and account strategies that support profitable sales growth, customer retention, and new-business development.
• Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers and influencers across pharmaceutical, BioPharma, life sciences, and related customer organizations.
• Identify customer applications, operational challenges, and purchasing priorities, and coordinate technical resources to recommend appropriate solutions.

• Prospect and develop new accounts through targeted outreach, customer visits, relationship development, and value-based selling.
• Conduct joint customer visits with Field Application Specialists and other team members to support technical discussions and opportunity development.
• Partner with Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, Logistics, Customer Service, and other internal teams to address customer requirements and resolve issues.
• Develop quotations and negotiate pricing, contracts, renewals, terms and conditions, nondisclosure agreements, and commercial programs within established approval processes.

• Prepare regular reports on account activity, pipeline opportunities, revenue performance, customer priorities, and competitive trends.
• Maintain and support distributor and channel relationships, including coordination of aftermarket service support as appropriate.
• Follow established account management processes and applicable company and customer-site safety requirements.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Marketing, or Engineering, or comparable relevant job experience.
• 5+ years of direct sales experience.

Core Competencies

• Business Development: Ability to identify opportunities, prospect new customers, reach decision-makers, and win competitive accounts.
• Consultative Selling: Ability to assess customer needs, communicate technical and commercial value, and recommend appropriate solutions.
• Customer Account Management: Ability to build trusted relationships, develop account strategies, and support long-term customer growth.
• Technical Aptitude: Ability to learn pharmaceutical and BioPharma product applications, interpret customer requirements, and work effectively with technical specialists.
• Communication: Clear verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage customers and internal stakeholders professionally.

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. 
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

Pay Range: 
•The pay range for this role is $25.00 - $40.00. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Title: Master Scheduler
Location: Mocksville, NC

About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Job Overview:
Turn Demand into a Plan That Delivers. At Ingersoll Rand, the Master Scheduler connects customer demand with what the factory can deliver—helping ensure the right products move through production at the right time. Your decisions will influence delivery reliability, inventory levels, and how effectively the plant uses its people, materials, and equipment. In this role, you’ll turn business forecasts into a realistic production plan, anticipate bottlenecks, and guide trade-offs as priorities change. You’ll work across Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer Service to balance immediate customer needs with longer-term manufacturing capacity, bringing clarity to competing demands and helping teams act before constraints become disruptions.

This opportunity is ideal for an analytical manufacturing professional who enjoys solving complex problems and influencing decisions across teams. You’ll take ownership of the production plan, work independently, and use data, manufacturing knowledge, and sound judgment to strengthen production flow, improve planning accuracy, and help the factory deliver on its commitments.

Responsibilities:

  • Translate the monthly SIOP consensus plan by product family to a detailed weekly master production schedule (MPS) with a 12-18 month planning horizon into the ERP for weekly MRP generation
  • Incorporate inter-company demand and backlog into SIOP supply planning process to ensure capacity and resources are available to meet demand requirements.
  • Monitor and drive resolution of MRP processing errors.
  • Support customer service with exception request analysis and expediting resolution.
  • Create and publish daily/weekly/monthly factory schedule adherence, capacity, and inventory reports.
  • Serve as a factory subject matter expert (SME) for ERP production planning and scheduling modules.
  • Identification and resolution of Constraints - Capacity, Resource & Material.
  • Facilitates long term capacity assessment (RCCP) and development of countermeasure/action plans.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in business or engineering discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in analyzing data relating to product forecasting, master scheduling, or shipment forecasting.
  • Experience with rate-based or flow line (non-MRP) and job shop manufacturing environments.
  • Experience in operations, inventory management, MRP and lean manufacturing processes.


Core Competencies:

  • Ability to effectively make complex decisions with limited time and information and can determine decision making criteria based on priorities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple disciplines with internal and external resources.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, with a basic understanding of statistical analysis techniques.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, independent problem resolution, proven leadership ability, and the ability to manage the requirement of others.
  • Comfortable leading discussion and debate both within peer group and with matrix business partners, operational partners and leaders.


Preferences:

  • APICS Certification in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM) required or hiring commitment to obtain in first 18 months of employment.
  • Experience with visual management systems.
  • Working knowledge of ERP system.
  • Data access/retrieval skills with extensive experience in data analysis, data manipulation using MS Excel and/or other tools as provided.


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Onsite.

Location: Chicago, IL- Onsite

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.


Job Overview:
The Site Supply Chain Lead is an individual contributor role accountable for end-to-end supply chain planning across demand, supply, and production execution. This role owns production scheduling, capacity planning, and NPI readiness to ensure alignment with customer demand, operational constraints, and business objectives. This position serves as a central integrator across Sales, Operations, Engineering, and Procurement, driving data-based decisions, improving planning processes, and ensuring optimal service, cost, and inventory performance across multi-line manufacturing operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and manage the master production schedule (MPS) aligned to demand plans and capacity constraints
  • Ensure finite scheduling and sequence optimization to maximize throughput and minimize changeover and delays. Influence cross-functional stakeholders to align on priorities, resolve constraints, and drive execution against the plan.
  • Manage production work orders and maintain ERP/MRP accuracy for inventory, BOMs, planning parameters, and product lifecycle updates.
  • Review new customer orders to confirm capacity (labor, machines), materials, and design availability to meet customer dates. Monitor and manage past due orders, backlog, and service risk.
  • Lead and execute the monthly Supply Agreement process, including demand/supply balancing, scenario modeling, and risk identification
  • Develop and evaluate supply-demand scenarios resulting in actionable supply plans clearly articulating trade-offs across service, cost, and inventory to support decision-making.
  • Lead capacity planning for labor, machines, and materials across product lines; provide future capacity reports highlighting risks.
  • Collaborate with Purchasing to align raw material supply plans with inventory strategies and policies (e.g., safety stock, segmentation, reorder parameters) aligned to business objectives.
  • Support NPIs by integrating launch timelines into production planning and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management or related field of study; comparable combination of education and years of experience will be considered
  • 7+ years of work experience in Supply Chain or Production Planning/ Scheduling
  • 3+ years of experience with ERP/MRP systems, such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms.
  • 1+ years of experience and extensive knowledge of the flow of data through entire manufacturing process – from design conception to shipment of product
  • Must be able to work on government contracts directly or access shared data resources (U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident of the U.S.)


Preferences:

  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish preferred.
  • APICS CPIM or CSCP certification preferred
  • Proficiency in Excel and other data analysis tools.
  • Experience in a regulated, lot-controlled manufacturing environment or clean room environment preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively work in cross-functional teams in a lead capacity or as a participant
  • Experience or training with Lean and Visual Factory manufacturing tools
  • Demonstrated strong, analytical skills, problem solving and learning ability
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with all levels of team membership
  • Ability to work within defined process and identify process improvements, drive improvements and sustain improvements; Ability to get results through process
  • Demonstrated comprehension and experience with various business models and their effect on supply chain structure, planning and execution


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • Fully site base in Chicago, IL


Pay Range:
The pay range for this role is Min - $103,000 -$120,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.?

Job title: Service Technician
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM - 4:30 PM
Hourly Range: $25.00 - $40.00, weekly pay, based on experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, Ingersoll Rand offers a comprehensive benefits package, career development opportunities, and company-sponsored training.

Locations:
Kokomo, IN
Noblesville, IN
Fort Wayne, IN
Plymouth, IN
Muncie, IN
Lafayette, IN
Plainfield, IN
Avon, IN

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns.
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems. Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

Pay Range:
•The pay range for this role is $25.00 - $40.00. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

What We Offer
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at

Job Title: Mechanical Inside Sales Support Specialist
Location: Lincolnshire, IL - 500 Bond St. Lincolnshire, IL 60069

About Us:

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gases, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Join us to own your future.

Job Overview:

Welch Vacuum, a subsidiary of Ingersoll Rand since 1996, is a global leader with over a century of history in high-performance vacuum technologies. We specialize in vacuum pumps, systems, and components for laboratories, life sciences, and industrial manufacturing. Operating within Ingersoll Rand's medical and laboratory division, we combine the engineering strengths of US-based Welch Vacuum Technology and Germany's Ilmvac GmbH. The Mechanical Inside Sales Support Specialist provides technical, commercial, and operational support for vacuum pump products and systems. This role serves as a trusted advisor to customers, distribution partners, and internal sales teams by delivering application expertise, product recommendations, troubleshooting assistance, and sales enablement activities that drive customer satisfaction, customer retention, and profitable growth. The position combines strong technical knowledge of mechanical systems and vacuum pump technologies with exceptional customer service and commercial acumen.

Responsibilities:

  • The Mechanical Inside Sales Support Specialist will diagnose and resolve product, installation, operational, service, and warranty-related issues, primarily through phone and Microsoft Teams interactions.
  • You will apply strong problem-solving skills, collaborate effectively across internal teams, and deliver a best-in-class customer experience throughout the post-sales lifecycle.
  • Provide technical guidance, application support, and troubleshooting assistance for customers, distribution partners, and internal sales teams, primarily via phone and Microsoft Teams. 
  • Diagnose product and system issues, identify root causes, and coordinate corrective actions to ensure timely and effective resolution. 
  • Support customers with equipment setup, operation, maintenance, service, warranty claims, and other post-sales technical inquiries. 
  • Serve as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, including Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Product Management, and Customer Service, to ensure prompt resolution of customer concerns. 
  • Prepare accurate quotations, product specifications, technical recommendations. 
  • Identify and develop cross-sell, upsell, replacement, and new application opportunities through customer interactions and technical consultations. 
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships that enhance customer loyalty and satisfaction. 
  • Partner with distribution channels to provide product training, technical support, and application expertise that drives business growth. 
  • Maintain current knowledge of vacuum technologies, product offerings, competitive solutions, and industry trends. 
  • Document and communicate customer feedback, technical issues, and market intelligence to support continuous product and process improvement to engineering and product management.  
  • Acts as backup to customer Service reps by supporting order management activities, including order tracking, issue resolution, and customer communication. 
  • Demonstrate strategic agility by performing additional duties and responsibilities as assigned to support evolving business priorities. 

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma
  • 3+ years of experience troubleshooting and resolving mechanical equipment issues in an industrial or technical environment; ability to analyze mechanical problems, identify root causes, and implement effective corrective actions.
  • 3+ years of experience working with customers to reslove issues

Core Competencies:

  • Strong mechanical troubleshooting and diagnostic skills. 
  • Working knowledge of electrical systems, controls, and industrial equipment. 
  • Ability to evaluate customer applications, interpret technical requirements, perform basic equipment performance calculations, and recommend effective solutions. 
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills. 
  • Ability to establish credibility and develop strong relationships with customers, channel partners, and internal stakeholders. 
  • Demonstrated business and sales acumen, including opportunity identification, account development, value-based selling, and competitive account conversion. 
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service and support.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges. 
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and organizational levels. 
  • Able to work independently while contributing positively within a team environment. 
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and accountability. 
  • Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills with strong attention to detail. 
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects and customer requests in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Strong follow-through and commitment to delivering timely, accurate results. 
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented professional with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. 

Preferences:

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Industrial Technology, Mechanical Technology, or a related technical discipline; equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered. 
  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving mechanical equipment issues in an industrial or technical environment. 
  • Experience with vacuum pump technologies, vacuum systems, or related industrial equipment preferred. 
  • Electrical troubleshooting experience is a plus. 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and CRM systems; Salesforce experience preferred

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position has little to no travel for the. if travel there will be 10%

Pay Range:
The pay range for this role is $70,000 - $80,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  

What We Offer:
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond. 
 
Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

Description du poste: Électromécanicien (Machines rotatives)

Emplacement du bureau: 190 Av. du Voyageur #100, Pointe-Claire, Québec H9R 6A

À propos de nous

Ingersoll Rand est une entreprise Fortune 500 passionnée par l'amélioration de la vie. Nous y parvenons en incarnant nos valeurs, en nous concentrant sans relâche sur la réussite de nos clients et en collaborant avec nos employés pour penser et agir comme des propriétaires. Nous croyons en la durabilité grâce au développement et à la distribution d'une large gamme de marques mondiales conçues pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients de manière efficace et responsable. Ingersoll Rand valorise un environnement diversifié et inclusif. Pour plus d'informations, visitez : www.irco.com.

Aperçu du poste
L’Électromécanicien spécialisé en machines rotatives est responsable de l’installation, l’entretien, la réparation et le diagnostic d’équipements tels que moteurs électriques, soufflantes, pompes, ventilateurs, compresseurs et autres systèmes rotatifs industriels.

Il effectue également la maintenance préventive et corrective, l’analyse vibratoire et contribue à l’amélioration de la fiabilité des équipements.

Responsabilités :

  • Installer, inspecter et réparer les équipements électromécaniques.
  • Effectuer l’entretien préventif et correctif des machines rotatives.
  • Effectuer des diagnostics de défaillance mécaniques, électriques, hydrauliques et pneumatiques.
  • Réaliser l’alignement laser ou au comparateur.
  • Lire et interpréter des plans mécaniques et schémas électriques.
  • Assurer les tests de fonctionnement après réparation.
  • Rédiger des rapports de maintenance et de service.
  • Respecter les normes de santé et de sécurité au travail.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de production et d’ingénierie.
  • Utiliser des équipements de levage pour manipuler des pièces lourdes.

Compétences et exigences:

  • DEP en électromécanique, Mécanique industrielle, ou diplôme équivalent.
  • 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en maintenance industrielle (atout).
  • Excellentes compétences en dépannage mécanique et électrique.
