Job title: Electromechanic / Electromechanical Technician – Rotating Machinery

Location: 190 Av. du Voyageur #100, Pointe-Claire, Québec H9R 6A

About Us

Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Ingersoll Rand is a diverse and inclusive environment. For more information visit: www.irco.com.

Job Overview:

The Electromechanic specializing in rotating machinery is responsible for installing, maintaining, repairing, and diagnosing industrial equipment such as electric motors, blowers, pumps, fans, compressors, and other rotating systems.

The role also includes performing preventive and corrective maintenance, vibration analysis, troubleshooting, and contributing to equipment reliability improvements.

Responsibilities:

• Install, inspect, and repair electromechanical equipment.
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on rotating machinery.
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic failures.
• Perform laser alignment or dial?indicator alignment.
• Read and interpret mechanical drawings and electrical schematics.
• Conduct operational tests after repairs.
• Prepare maintenance and service reports.
• Comply with workplace health and safety standards.
• Collaborate with production and engineering teams.
• Use lifting and handling equipment to move heavy parts.

Skills/Requirements:

  • Diploma in Electromechanics, Industrial Mechanics, or an equivalent field
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in industrial maintenance (an asset).
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
  • Proficiency with tools such as a multimeter, vibration analyzer, and tachometer.
  • Experience with laser alignment (an asset).
  • Good physical condition.
  • computer skills (Microsoft Office).
  • mechanically inclined, self-motivated and able to work without supervision.
  • Additional job training on the assembly of blowers may be required upon request.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, PLC diagrams, work instructions, safety instructions, operates forklift and overhead crane.
  • Have demonstrated crane and rigging experience, knowledge of rigging and lifting equipment as well as parts that do not have a center of gravity that are easily identified.

EDUCATION/TRAINING REQUIRED:

  • High School Diploma, or equivalent.
  • courses completed (Mechanical, Pneumatics, PLC, Hydraulics, is a plus).
  • Experience substituted for education.

Job Title: Field Service Engineer-II

Location: U.S. Remote - prefer Central Midwest region

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:

The Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer plays a critical role in supporting, integrating, and optimizing Precision Fastening Tools, Controllers, and Connected Manufacturing solutions within customer production environments. This position serves as the technical liaison between customers, service teams, and engineering organizations, ensuring reliable operation, seamless system integration, and exceptional customer satisfaction.

The engineer will be responsible for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, and support of fastening systems and related manufacturing technologies. This includes integration with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), PLCs, industrial networks, and digital I/O interfaces.

Through direct customer engagement and hands-on technical expertise, the Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer helps drive operational excellence, product reliability, and continuous improvement while supporting Ingersoll Rand's commitment to making life better through innovative manufacturing solutions.

Responsibilities

Field Service & Customer Support

  • Travel to customer facilities to install, commission, maintain, and troubleshoot precision fastening systems, controllers, and software solutions.
  • Provide onsite and remote technical support for customers, distributors, and internal service teams.
  • Diagnose and resolve software, hardware, networking, and process-related issues in production environments.
  • Conduct equipment assessments and recommend corrective actions to improve system performance and uptime.
  • Deliver customer training on product operation, software functionality, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • Support production launch activities and ensure successful implementation of connected manufacturing solutions.
Connected Manufacturing & Systems Integration

  • Ensure reliable wired & wireless communication between fastening tools and controllers.
  • Support integration & troubleshooting of communication between IR products and plant MES systems using open protocols like Power Focus Open Protocol (PFOP) and ToolsNet, and proprietary protocols for Ford, Volkswagen, Toyota, Stellantis and more.
  • Verify traceability, production reporting, recipe management, and quality data collection requirements.
  • Collaborate with customer automation, IT, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure reliable system performance.
  • Support Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory initiatives through deployment of connected manufacturing solutions.
Digital I/O & Automation Support

  • Configure and troubleshoot digital I/O communications between fastening controllers, PLCs, conveyors, robots, and automation equipment.
  • Verify machine interlocks, cycle complete signals, fault outputs, part-present inputs, and process control functions.
  • Support industrial communication protocols including Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC-UA.
  • Assist with factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), and production startup support.
Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring field issues and provide feedback to engineering and product management teams.
  • Support the development of service procedures, technical documentation, and best practices.
  • Stay current on manufacturing technology trends, industrial automation, and connected factory solutions.
  • Mentor service technicians and junior engineers as needed.
Qualifications:

  • 5+ Years of experience with MES with power tools communicating with PFOP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Digital I/O configuration and troubleshooting
  • 5+ Years of experience with Fieldbus communications with Profinet or EthernetIP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Software installation and validation
  • 5+ Years of experience with Configuring devices for Wi-Fi communications & troubleshooting
Core Competencies: 

  • Strong customer-facing communication skills
  • Ability to characterize, diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Effective collaboration across engineering, service, and customer teams
  • Willingness to travel extensively to support customer operations
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Joints, fasteners, power tools
  • Must be very comfortable with customer interaction! Will have a sales incentive bonus.
  • Exposure to industrial automation with OPC-UA, MES and Fieldbus protocols
  • Experience with devices communicating over Zigbee or 802.15.4
  • Experience with mobile app communications with devices over BLE or USB
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 
  • Regular Travel by car and plane to our customer sites in the US and Canada. Must have a valid passport or ability to get one. You will be provided with a company vehicle. 
Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is Min - 97000 - Max - 125000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

job.description:
Job title: Service Technician
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM - 4:30 PM, occasional overtime.

Location:
Louisville, KY

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns.
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems. Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.
•This position may require occasional travel for training. 1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%).
•This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.

What We Offer
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best.

Job Overview:

Starting at $23.95 per hour, the Machine Operator 2 sets up and operates machining equipment to manufacture parts that support the assembly and testing of rotary positive blowers and gas pumps. This role maintains required tolerances, completes in-process inspections, documents production activity, and safely moves materials and tooling. Collective Bargaining Agreement language applies to this position.

Responsibilities:

  • Review manufacturing paperwork and work instructions for machining requirements; notify the supervisor of concerns related to material quality, piece counts, tooling, or operations.
  • Set up and operate one or more machines simultaneously to manufacture a variety of parts in support of production schedules.
  • Complete required machine, tooling, calibration, and adjustment changes to maintain design tolerances.
  • Perform and document visual and instrument inspections using the appropriate gauges and tools to verify tolerances and quality requirements.
  • Complete in-process quality checks and accurately maintain all associated quality and production documentation.
  • Accurately report labor transactions and material counts manually or electronically.
  • Safely operate overhead cranes, hoists, and handcarts; select appropriate rigging to transport or position parts, tooling, fixtures, supplies, and units.
  • Maintain a clean, orderly work area and follow all plant rules and safe work practices, including returning tools and equipment to storage and disposing of waste properly.

Requirements:

  • Ability to set priorities, manage multiple tasks, and support production needs effectively.
  • Willingness and ability to work any shift, including holidays, weekends, and overtime as required.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Moderate computer literacy and the ability to accurately enter labor and production information.

Core Competencies:

  • Safety awareness and consistent adherence to plant procedures.
  • Mechanical aptitude with strong attention to quality and detail.
  • Ability to follow manufacturing paperwork, machining directions, and inspection requirements.
  • Dependability, accountability, and effective communication with supervisors and team members.

Preferences:

  • Prior machine operation, machining, or manufacturing experience.
  • Experience using inspection gauges, measuring tools, overhead cranes, hoists, or rigging equipment.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This is a fully onsite, union position based in Connersville, Indiana. No regular travel is anticipated.

Job Title: Machinist
Location: 324 Leaside Avenue, Stoney Creek, Ontario, L8E 2N7
Rate of Pay: $32 - $36 per hour
Employment Type: Full-time | 2 Openings | Additional Headcount Due to Business Growth

About Us

Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Ingersoll Rand is a diverse and inclusive environment. For more information visit: www.irco.com.

Job Overview:

Fruitland Manufacturing is seeking an experienced CNC Machinist to join our growing team in Stoney Creek, Ontario. Due to increased production demands and additional work being brought into the facility, we are adding two Machinists to support our operations.

This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled machinist with strong CNC setup, troubleshooting, and programming experience. We are looking for professionals who can independently set up tooling, make programming adjustments, perform inspections, and ensure high-quality production while maintaining a safe and productive work environment.
The successful candidate will work primarily on CNC machining centers utilizing Fanuc controls and will play a key role in producing precision components that support mission-critical applications across multiple industries.
Please note: This position currently operates on a day shift schedule; however, candidates must be willing and able to transition to a future second-shift operation if business needs require it. A $2.00 per hour shift premium applies to second-shift assignments.

Responsibilities

  • Operate CNC horizontal, vertical, and multi-axis turning centers.
  • Perform machine setups, including tooling changes, fixture setup, program loading, and first-piece inspections.
  • Perform basic CNC programming and make adjustments directly at the machine controller.
  • Organize tooling requirements and verify fixture readiness for production jobs.
  • Troubleshoot CNC programming issues and machine fault codes.
  • Maintain precise tolerances and quality standards during production.
  • Follow all plant safety requirements and ISO procedures.
  • Log and track production activities using the GSS ERP system.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Collaborate with team members to achieve production and quality objectives.

Requirements

  • Operating CNC horizontal, vertical and multi-axis turning centers.
  • Performing basic CNC programming.
  • Setting up CNC machine including changing tools, fixtures, running programs, completing first off inspections
  • Identifying and resolving programming issues and CNC fault codes.
  • Maintaining sharp focus and attention to detail to ensure precision and quality in all operations.
  • Following all plant safety rules, ISO procedures
  • Logging and tracking time using GSS ERP system


Requirements:

  • Minimum 5+ years of CNC machining experience.
  • Strong CNC machine setup experience.
  • Experience operating CNC machining centers with Fanuc controls preferred.
  • Ability to perform basic CNC programming and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with tooling selection, fixture setup, and process optimization.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.

Qualifications:

  • Experience operating CNC horizontal, vertical, and multi-axis machining centers.
  • Strong understanding of CNC setup and production processes.
  • Ability to identify and resolve programming and machine issues.
  • Knowledge of precision measurement tools and inspection techniques.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide using whole numbers, fractions, and decimals.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities.

Preferred Qualifications: Red Seal certification in 429A General Machinist or 430A Tool and Die Maker.

job.description:

About Us

Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Ingersoll Rand is a diverse and inclusive environment. For more information visit: www.irco.com.

Job Summary

Reporting directly to the SVP – Human Resources, this position will provide high-quality HRBP leadership, coaching and support for the global PTL VPGM and the PTL leadership team members. This position will work intimately with leaders in PTL to not only sustain but also amplify the business’ growth. The focus will be on driving progress in key areas including Employee Engagement, Talent Development, Organizational Design, Compensation and bolstering Organizational Effectiveness. Leading a small global team of HR professionals, you will be responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality HR solutions that cater to the needs of leaders, managers, and associates, fostering an environment of growth and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Effectively partner with PTL leaders to drive positive, business-impacting change, aligning human resources programs and initiatives with strategic objectives and annual operating plans.
  • Serve as a credible coach and confidante to these leadership teams, as well as a strong employee advocate.
  • Develop and execute HR plans, processes, and programs aligned with business objectives, including organizational design, succession planning, talent management / talent acquisition, goal alignment, employee engagement and communications.
  • Lead all aspects of the Talent Review Excellence (TRX) process for the PTL team.
  • Foster positive employees relations across multiple facilities, and provide strategic leadership for issue escalations.
  • Serve as a performance coach for functional leaders to ensure each leadership team is highly-effective in improving organizational capability.
  • Partner with hiring managers and Talent Acquisition colleagues to attract, hire and onboard the best candidates as efficiently and effectively as possible.
  • Coach and advise on appropriate total rewards strategies, programs, and tools to enhance organizational performance and employee engagement.
  • Collaborate with other HR colleagues on sharing best practices and increasing the development and use of HR standard work.
  • Drive and enable cultural transformation to support Ingersoll Rand’s DE&I strategic objective.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field. Master’s degree (MBA, Master’s in HR, etc.) is preferred, but not required.
  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive Human Resources experience with increasing responsibility supporting business leaders and employee populations.
  • Minimum of 5 years as an HR Business Partner in a global environment.
  • Minimum of 5 years leading experienced HR Business Partners.
  • Demonstrated expertise in building talent, engaging teams, driving culture change and strategic growth of businesses and organizations.
  • Demonstrated success in creating an environment of trust with business partners where integrity is unquestioned.
  • Strong understanding of HR functions, including talent management, employee relations, performance management, and compliance.
  • Excellent interpersonal, influencing and communications skills.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

This will be a remote based position (unless near a major IR location), preferably located in Davidson with anticipated travel of up to 10%-20%.

Job title: CPS Service Technician – Centrifugal
Location: Remote, United States – must be located within 2 hours of a major airport.
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM - 4:30 PM (may vary based on customer and project needs)
Salary Range: $75,000 - $120,000 annually, based on experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, Ingersoll Rand offers a comprehensive benefits package, career development opportunities, and company-sponsored training.

About Us

Job Overview:
The Centrifugal Service Technician is a highly skilled field-based technical professional responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining Ingersoll Rand centrifugal and reciprocating compressor systems. This role primarily supports our Centac® and Turbo Air® product lines, along with dryers, cooling towers, filtration systems, and associated compressed air equipment.
As a trusted technical advisor, you will work directly with customers across a variety of industrial environments, providing hands-on service, start-up support, diagnostics, major overhauls, and technical training. Successful candidates possess strong mechanical and electrical aptitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced field service environment.

Responsibilities:
• Install, commission, inspect, troubleshoot, maintain, and repair centrifugal compressors, compressed air systems, and related equipment at customer locations nationwide.
• Perform advanced mechanical, electrical, and controls diagnostics using precision measuring instruments, technical drawings, wiring schematics, and OEM documentation.
• Lead equipment start-ups, major overhauls, upgrades, preventative maintenance, and corrective repairs to maximize equipment reliability and performance.
• Serve as a trusted technical advisor by providing customers with equipment assessments, operational recommendations, technical training, and exceptional service support.
• Accurately document service activities, technical findings, labor, parts usage, expenses, and recommendations while ensuring timely submission of all required reports and records.
• Maintain compliance with all safety standards and customer site requirements while effectively managing travel schedules, customer commitments, and ongoing technical training and development.

Requirements:
• High school diploma or GED required.
• Minimum 3 + years of experience troubleshooting and repairing industrial or commercial mechanical systems.
• Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and service manuals.
• Experience working independently in customer-facing service environments.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Proficiency using Microsoft Office applications, mobile devices, and digital reporting systems.
• Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Preferences:
• Associate degree or technical certification in Electrical Technology, Electronic Technology, HVAC, Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred.
• Experience servicing centrifugal compressors, rotary screw compressors, compressed air systems, industrial controls, PLCs, motor controls, refrigeration systems, cooling towers, and air treatment equipment.
• EPA 608 Certification or equivalent refrigeration certification preferred.
• Military mechanical, electrical, or technical experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to perform equipment startups, advanced troubleshooting, and major overhauls in an industrial field service environment.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, work safely around industrial machinery and energized systems, perform physical activities including standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing, work in varying environmental conditions, and travel extensively throughout the United States.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
• Monday – Friday travel, home for the weekends is typical.


Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $75,000 - $120,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

job.title: Service Technician
job.description:
Job title: Service Technician
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM - 4:30 PM
Hourly Range: $23.55 - $36.63, weekly pay, based on experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, Ingersoll Rand offers a comprehensive benefits package, career development opportunities, and company-sponsored training.

Locations:
Lee's Summit, MO
Aurora, CO

About Us
Cullum & Brown is an industry leading industrial equipment distributor and service company. With over 135 years of industry experience, Cullum & Brown is a reliable solutions provider with locations in Kansas City and Springfield. We are an authorized distributor of Gardner Denver, Elmo Rietschle, Hoffman, Lamson, Tuthill pumps, Crane Deming, Travaini vacuum pumps, Graco, Dean Pumps, Grundfos, PowerEx, and Great Lakes. Cullum & Brown is proud to offer 24/7 emergency customer service for not only the brands we sell, but all makes and models. Our 18 factory-trained and certified technicians are prepared and the best in the industry. Join our team!

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Cullum & Brown's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns.
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems. Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

Pay Range:
•The hourly pay range for this role is $23.55 - $36.63. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

What We Offer
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best.

TO APPLY: Please apply via our website https://careers.irco.com by 12/31/2026 in order to be considered for this position.

Job Title: Plant Controller
Location: Sidney, OH

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Job Overview
Lead Financial Performance. Help Shape What Comes Next. Join LeROI, an Ingersoll Rand Center of Excellence for gas compression technology, manufacturing compressors and packaged solutions for the Oil & Gas and Biogas industries. We’re seeking an experienced Plant Controller to lead all aspects of plant finance at our Sidney facility during a significant period of growth. With revenue expected to more than double, new product lines planned, and a proposed facility expansion, you’ll help guide growth while strengthening the existing operation.

In this highly visible, hands-on role, you’ll develop the finance team and partner directly with plant leadership, Operations, and Materials to strengthen financial discipline and improve manufacturing performance. You’ll go beyond reporting results to understand what drives them—and turn those insights into action. Strong accounting and manufacturing finance expertise, attention to detail, and sound business judgment will help you identify risks, challenge assumptions, and uphold GAAP, internal controls, and reporting standards. You’ll thrive here with intellectual curiosity, an ownership mindset, and the agility to learn quickly and navigate changing priorities. An experienced Finance Leader who previously held the role will provide hands-on transition guidance.

Help shape the financial direction of a growing manufacturing operation—and expand your leadership impact.

Responsibilities
Financial Leadership & Business Partnership:
  • Lead, develop, and manage the Sidney finance team.
  • Serve as the primary financial business partner to plant leadership, providing financial insight and recommendations to support operational and strategic decision-making.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Commercial, and other functions to drive business performance.
  • Provide clear and actionable analysis of financial results, risks, and opportunities.
  • Support and challenge the organization to achieve financial and operational commitments.
Accounting, Reporting & Controls:
  • Lead the monthly financial close and reporting process, ensuring timely and accurate results.
  • Oversee journal entries, account reconciliations, and balance sheet integrity.
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, company policies, and internal controls.
  • Lead and coordinate site activities related to internal and external audits.
  • Maintain strong financial controls and proactively identify opportunities to strengthen processes and reduce risk.
Planning & Financial Analysis:
  • Lead development of the facility's Annual Operating Plan (AOP), as well as monthly and quarterly forecasting processes.
  • Analyze financial and operational performance against plan, forecast, and prior periods.
  • Identify key drivers of performance, including manufacturing and plant variances, and partner with operational leaders to understand root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Provide financial modeling and analysis to support business decisions and continuous improvement initiatives.
Cost Accounting & Inventory:
  • Provide leadership and oversight of plant cost accounting activities.
  • Lead the annual standard cost process and ensure accurate product costing.
  • Establish standard costs for new parts and review proposed cost changes for existing products.
  • Monitor and analyze material, labor, overhead, purchase price, and other manufacturing variances.
  • Lead quarterly excess and obsolete inventory reviews and work with cross-functional teams to proactively manage inventory exposure.
Capital & Asset Management:
  • Provide financial oversight of capital expenditures, including business case analysis, spending controls, and project tracking.
  • Oversee fixed asset accounting and ensure appropriate capitalization and asset controls.
  • Partner with plant leadership to prioritize investments and evaluate financial returns.
Continuous Improvement:
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting, controls, and business intelligence.
  • Drive standardization, simplification, and automation where appropriate.
  • Support ad-hoc financial analysis and business initiatives as needed.

Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including increasing responsibility for month-end close, financial reporting, U.S. GAAP compliance, and internal controls.
  • 3+ years of accounting or finance experience in a plant or manufacturing environment, including direct partnership with Operations, Materials, Production, or Supply Chain.
  • 3+ years of experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and variance analysis, supported by advanced Microsoft Excel skills, such as PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, complex formulas, financial modeling, and analysis of large financial data sets.
  • 1+ year of practical manufacturing cost-accounting experience, including working knowledge of standard costs and manufacturing, production, inventory, or purchase price variances.
  • 1+ year of demonstrated leadership experience through direct supervision, people management, team leadership, or leadership of significant cross-functional initiatives.

Core Competencies
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Ability to communicate financial concepts to financial and non-financial audiences
  • Cross-functional relationship building and influence
  • Ability to manage competing priorities
  • Learning agility and comfort with ambiguity
  • Sound business judgment and professional courage
  • Ability to challenge business decisions appropriately when they conflict with U.S. GAAP or internal controls

Preferences:
  • Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Professional certification such as CPA or CMA.
  • Experience with SAP.
  • Experience with Hyperion (Forecasting sys) or similar financial consolidation and reporting systems.

Travel and Work Arrangements:
  • This position is based onsite in Sidney, OH.

The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment.
  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.
  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility.
  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.
  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner.
  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers.
  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus. While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies

  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years
  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards.
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc.
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner.
  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery.
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.

Preferences

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus. Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered.
  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).

  • This position may require occasional travel for training. 1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%).
  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.

•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner.

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.

•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure timely and accurate invoicing.
  • Order and receive parts for service jobs, monitor shipping and receiving, and coordinate warranty claims and factory returns.
  • Track service inventory and rental equipment, including location, availability, and repair status.

Job Overview:

The Project Engineer is a key member of the project management team and the primary technical point of contact for customers during execution of complex ETO centrifugal compressors. This role turns contractual and customer requirements into a clear, executable technical plan while coordinating engineering, manufacturing, quality, sourcing, vendors, and project management.

Success in this position requires strong technical judgment, disciplined follow-through, commercial awareness, and the ability to communicate complex information clearly. The Project Engineer maintains visibility to scope, schedule, documentation, risk, change, and project financial health throughout the contract lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead technical project execution:

  • Review purchase orders, customer specifications, clarifications, deviations, and internal order documentation to confirm that contract requirements are complete, accurate, and understood before execution.
  • Own the technical handoff from order acceptance through shipment, helping the project team translate scope into deliverables, decisions, actions, and milestones.
  • Monitor technical execution against the project schedule, identify risks or slippage early, and coordinate recovery actions with the Project Manager and functional teams.

Serve as the customer technical liaison:

  • Act as the primary technical contact for assigned projects and provide clear, timely communication on requirements, submittals, open items, decisions, and status.
  • Lead technical discussions to resolve questions, align expectations, and document decisions while maintaining awareness of contractual commitments.
  • Issue customer-facing technical documentation and provide regular schedule updates in coordination with the Project Manager.

Manage scope, change, and project risk:

  • Monitor scope throughout execution, including customer comments, specification changes, and drawing markups; identify potential scope growth and escalate it promptly.
  • Partner with the Project Manager to evaluate the technical, cost, and schedule impacts of customer change requests and support development of change orders.
  • Maintain accurate action, risk, and decision records so accountability and due dates remain clear.

Drive documentation, quality, and delivery readiness:

  • Coordinate the preparation, review, and transmittal of contract documents, including drawings, data sheets, test reports, manuals, and project-specific technical documentation.
  • Create and maintain the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP), coordinate customer witness and hold points, and support inspections and performance testing.
  • Partner with Quality on pre-shipment inspection and customer coordination.
  • Support revenue-recognition activities by helping confirm completion of applicable technical and contractual milestones.

Provide technical product support:

  • Apply working knowledge of centrifugal compressors and associated systems, including gearboxes, lubrication systems, intercoolers, controls, motors or drivers, and auxiliary equipment.
  • Review major buyout and supplier documentation for alignment with project requirements.
  • Provide technical support for proposals, field questions, troubleshooting, and post-shipment activities when needed.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering.
  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial, manufacturing, or engineered-to-order environment.

Core Competencies:

  • Understanding of engineering, manufacturing, inspection, testing, and supplier processes. General knowledge of centrifugal compressor systems is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple deliverables, priorities, interfaces, and deadlines in a technical project environment.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams; able to build trusted working relationships.
  • Accountable, organized, proactive, collaborative, and detail-oriented, with sound judgment and a commitment to quality.

Tools and systems:

  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications. Experience with scheduling, spreadsheet, collaboration, and document-control tools is expected.
  • Experience with ERP and business systems such as SAP or Oracle is preferred.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and specifications is required; 3D modeling or drafting experience is a plus.

How success is demonstrated:

  • Contract requirements are translated into complete, accurate, and actionable technical direction.
  • Customers and internal stakeholders receive timely, clear, and consistent communication.
  • Risks, scope changes, and schedule impacts are identified early and managed with documented ownership.
  • Project documentation, inspections, testing, and shipment activities are completed in alignment with contractual requirements.
  • Cross-functional teams can rely on the Project Engineer for technical leadership, follow-through, and informed decision support.


Travel Requirement:

· 10% domestic and international travel.

Pay Range
The pay range for this role is Min - 80000 - Max - 95000 . The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Overview:
Step into a Quality Engineer role with Gardner Denver – Industrial Technology and Services, LLC, a division of Ingersoll Rand, where your work directly impacts product performance, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence at our Sedalia operation. You’ll help ensure products meet exacting quality standards while supporting the transformation of metal castings and raw materials into high-performing products used around the world. In this highly collaborative role, you’ll serve as a key problem-solving partner across manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, customer service, warranty, and purchasing. Using the plant Quality Management System, you’ll respond to quality issues, lead root cause analysis, identify risks, and drive corrective and preventive actions that strengthen product reliability, reduce defects, and support continuous improvement across the plant.

Responsibilities:

  • Process Development and Improvement: Develop, implement, and document process improvements to ensure quality and reliability. Quality project lead representative, as assigned, for new product introductions. Identifies production concerns and take proactive steps to correct problems.
  • Documentation: Initiates and maintains documentation as needed to support process and manufacturing improvements (i.e. Process Control, Inspection logs, Visual Work Instructions, ECN's)
  • Quality: Develops and maintains all departmental procedures supporting and maintaining ISO certification. Participate in internal and external periodic plant audits. Support plant internal corrective actions.
  • Suppliers: Respond/ investigate quality related issues found on the production floor, or at the customer's location. Communicate with suppliers on non-conforming material, and issue/ manage supplier corrective actions as necessary.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned or directed.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of relevant progressive quality experience required in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • 3+ years of relevant quality experience within a manufacturing environment.
  • 2+ years experience with MS Office Suite, to include intermediate Excel skills
  • 1+ year of experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, JDE, or similar platforms.


Core Competencies:

  • Quality Systems & Compliance
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, maintain, and support quality procedures, documentation, and plant-level quality systems in alignment with ISO certification, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations.
  • Structured Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis
  • Ability to respond to quality issues as they occur, investigate non-conformances, apply root cause analysis tools, and drive corrective and preventive actions that improve product reliability and reduce defects.
  • Process Improvement & Manufacturing Support
  • Experience identifying production concerns, developing and documenting process improvements, and partnering with manufacturing teams to strengthen quality, reliability, and operational performance.
  • Cross-Functional & Supplier Collaboration
  • Ability to work effectively with manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, customer service, warranty, purchasing, and suppliers to resolve quality concerns, manage supplier corrective actions, and ensure customer quality requirements are met.
  • Documentation, Data & Systems Proficiency
  • Strong ability to create, maintain, and manage quality-related documentation, including process controls, inspection logs, visual work instructions, ECNs, and corrective action records, while utilizing MS Office, Excel, and ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, JDE, or similar platforms.


Preferences:

  • Bachelors Degree or some college with relevant quality engineering experience
  • Experience with Lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement initiatives
  • ASQ certification (e.g., CQT, CQE, CQM, or CRE)
  • Six Sigma Green Belt certification


Travel and Work Arrangements

  • This is based onsite in Sedalia, MO
  • Travel anticipated is less than 10%

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. 
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

Pay Range: 
•The pay range for this role is $25.00 - $40.00. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

  • Support installations, startups, and commissioning at customer sites
  • Perform compressor overhauls and equipment prep in the Schaumburg shop
  • Diagnose mechanical and electrical issues affecting performance
  • Read P&IDs, mechanical drawings, and electrical schematic
  • Complete service documentation and work orders

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to read mechanical/electrical drawings
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Comfortable working in shop and industrial field environments
Preferences

  • VFDs, industrial motors, or commissioning/startup experience

Job Overview
The Service Coordinator supports the Customer Center by coordinating service technicians and delivering responsive customer service to industrial customers with compressed-air equipment. This position schedules preventive maintenance and repairs, communicates service updates, and manages service orders from the initial request through invoicing.

Working closely with Service, Sales, and Operations, the Service Coordinator helps ensure technicians have the parts, information, and scheduling support needed to meet customer needs. This role also supports service inventory, rental equipment, warranty claims, and accurate documentation.

Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming service calls and schedule technicians for preventive maintenance and repairs, balancing customer needs, technician availability, and operating efficiency.
  • Communicate with customers, technicians, Sales, and management to provide timely updates and resolve service concerns.
  • Coordinate technical support and escalate issues to the appropriate resources.
  • Generate and follow up on service quotes, identifying additional customer needs and business opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate service requests, work orders, purchase orders, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure timely and accurate invoicing.
  • Order and receive parts for service jobs, monitor shipping and receiving, and coordinate warranty claims and factory returns.
  • Track service inventory and rental equipment, including location, availability, and repair status.
  • Follow environmental, health, safety, and operational requirements; support audits and Sarbanes-Oxley compliance.
  • Collaborate with teammates and share information to support consistent customer service and efficient operations.

Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED.

Core Competencies

  • Customer Service: Ability to understand customer needs, respond professionally, and follow through on commitments.
  • Organization and Time Management: Ability to manage a high volume of calls, service requests, schedules, and competing priorities.
  • Communication: Clear verbal and written communication with customers, technicians, and internal teams.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to evaluate service concerns, coordinate solutions, and recognize when to escalate.
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to maintain accurate orders, service records, parts information, and invoices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work with Service, Sales, Operations, and other teams to meet customer needs.
  • Initiative and Accountability: Ability to work independently, follow established processes, and complete tasks reliably.
  • Adaptability: Ability to respond to schedule changes and shifting customer priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferences

  • Two to three years of customer service or related experience.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree.
  • Customer-facing experience, including part-time work; candidates beginning their careers are encouraged to apply.
  • Experience coordinating service appointments, dispatching technicians, processing orders, or supporting parts and inventory operations.
  • Familiarity with mechanical or electrical systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and mobile devices.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar business systems.
  • Forklift certification. Certification and training can be provided after hire.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This position is onsite at the local Customer Center five days per week.
  • Typical working hours are Monday through Friday, 7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. local time.
  • Flexibility to work overtime or weekends may be needed based on business requirements.
  • Approximately 5%–10% travel may be required, primarily for training. Travel is infrequent, and approved business travel expenses are covered.
  • Duties include regular use of hands and fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling, along with regularly lifting or moving up to 10 pounds and occasionally lifting or moving 40 pounds or more.
  • Relocation assistance is not available.

Title: Assembler
Location: West Chester, PA (Zeks Compressed Air - 1302 Goshen Pkwy. West Chester, PA 19380)
Shift: 1st Shift (Monday-Friday 6am-2:30pm)


About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
We are looking for a skilled assembler to perform a variety of tasks as assigned in conjunction with the assembly of our product. You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform repetitive progressive line assembly of parts, and sub-assemblies on any line within the plant, in accordance with predetermined standard work. Assembles components by examining connections for correct fit; fastening parts and subassemblies.
  • Read, understand, and apply method sheets, assembly diagrams, and blueprints.
  • Detect quality defects and unsafe conditions.
  • Be knowledgeable and follow all applicable safety rules and procedures. Maintains safe and clean working environment by complying with procedures, rules, and regulations.
  • Read print drawings to determine dimensions, design, and materials for construction.
  • Operate power pneumatic and hand tools required for performing job duties. Effectively use measuring devices such as tape measures and levels.
  • Maintain and inspect tools and equipment and create work orders for tools/equipment to be repaired as needed. Perform general housekeeping of the work area.
  • Maintains supplies inventory by checking stock to determine inventory level; anticipating needed supplies; placing and expediting orders for supplies; verifying receipt of supplies. Loading and unloading onto conveyors and carts, operating fork trucks, and hoists.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 1+ years of experience in a manufacturing setting.
  • 1+ years of experience in Blueprint Reading

Core Competencies:

  • Knowledge of and willingness to comply with all general work rules, policies and procedures, including safety guidelines and procedures. • Able to rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. • Ability to learn to operate all equipment associated with the job; including, but not limited to, power hand tools, forklifts, skyjacks, cranes, and measuring devices.
  • Ability to identify routine problem causation, and correct routine problems, and willingness to learn.
  • Broad working knowledge and experience with standard work instructions.
  • Team oriented, must have the ability to work cohesively with others.
  • Must possess ability to work well in a manufacturing environment.
  • Must be detail-oriented and self-motivated.
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced, multi-tasked environment.
  • Tasks can include but are not limited to brazing, soldering, operating machines and presses, hanging and unhanging parts, and performing quality checks and tests.

Preferences:

  • 2+ years of experience in a manufacturing setting preferred.
  • Familiar with and ability to utilize all hand tools including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, and steel banding.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude to use equipment and maintain general understanding of business process.
  • Familiar with and can utilize power tools.
  • Knowledgeable of and able to utilize computer systems.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position will be based at our site in West Chester, PA no travel.

What we Offer:

At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

Job Title: Quality Engineer
Location:  Sedalia, MO (onsite)
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Step into a Quality Engineer role with Gardner Denver – Industrial Technology and Services, LLC, a division of Ingersoll Rand, where your work directly impacts product performance, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence at our Sedalia operation. You’ll help ensure products meet exacting quality standards while supporting the transformation of metal castings and raw materials into high-performing products used around the world.  In this highly collaborative role, you’ll serve as a key problem-solving partner across manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, customer service, warranty, and purchasing. Using the plant Quality Management System, you’ll respond to quality issues, lead root cause analysis, identify risks, and drive corrective and preventive actions that strengthen product reliability, reduce defects, and support continuous improvement across the plant.

Responsibilities: 
  • Process Development and Improvement: Develop, implement, and document process improvements to ensure quality and reliability. Quality project lead representative, as assigned, for new product introductions. Identifies production concerns and take proactive steps to correct problems. 
  • Documentation: Initiates and maintains documentation as needed to support process and manufacturing improvements (i.e. Process Control, Inspection logs, Visual Work Instructions, ECN's) 
  • Quality: Develops and maintains all departmental procedures supporting and maintaining ISO certification. Participate in internal and external periodic plant audits. Support plant internal corrective actions. 
  • Suppliers: Respond/ investigate quality related issues found on the production floor, or at the customer's location. Communicate with suppliers on non-conforming material, and issue/ manage supplier corrective actions as necessary. 
  • Other responsibilities as assigned or directed. 

Requirements:
  • 5+ years of relevant progressive quality experience required in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • 3+ years of relevant quality experience within a manufacturing environment.
  • 2+ years experience with MS Office Suite, to include intermediate Excel skills
  • 1+ year of experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, JDE, or similar platforms.

Core Competencies:
  • Quality Systems & Compliance
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, maintain, and support quality procedures, documentation, and plant-level quality systems in alignment with ISO certification, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations.
  • Structured Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis
  • Ability to respond to quality issues as they occur, investigate non-conformances, apply root cause analysis tools, and drive corrective and preventive actions that improve product reliability and reduce defects.
  • Process Improvement & Manufacturing Support
  • Experience identifying production concerns, developing and documenting process improvements, and partnering with manufacturing teams to strengthen quality, reliability, and operational performance.
  • Cross-Functional & Supplier Collaboration
  • Ability to work effectively with manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, customer service, warranty, purchasing, and suppliers to resolve quality concerns, manage supplier corrective actions, and ensure customer quality requirements are met.
  • Documentation, Data & Systems Proficiency
  • Strong ability to create, maintain, and manage quality-related documentation, including process controls, inspection logs, visual work instructions, ECNs, and corrective action records, while utilizing MS Office, Excel, and ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, JDE, or similar platforms.

Preferences:
  • Bachelors Degree or some college with relevant quality engineering experience
  • Experience with Lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement initiatives
  • ASQ certification (e.g., CQT, CQE, CQM, or CRE)
  • Six Sigma Green Belt certification

Travel and Work Arrangements 
  • This is based onsite in Sedalia, MO
  • Travel anticipated is less than 10%

What We Offer 
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond. 

Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

Location: Sedalia, MS

Job Overview:
The Manufacturing Engineering Manager leads the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes, equipment, and tooling to ensure the efficient, safe, and high-quality production of blowers and compressors. This role drives operational excellence by optimizing manufacturing performance, supporting new product introductions, and enhancing productivity, quality, and cost-effectiveness across production operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead a cohesive team of existing manufacturing engineers.
  • Develop the processes and requirements needed to implement new products and lead the team in executing these projects.
  • Provide design-for-manufacturing capability to support efficient, safe and quality production.
  • Ensure day-to-day production has capable and stable manufacturing processes, equipment, and tooling. The successful candidate should be a skilled and experienced engineer and manager with a successful track record of organizing and growing engineering teams.


Requirements:

  • Experience with precision machining processes performed on castings and forgings, including both CNC and manual machining.
  • Familiarity with sheet metal fabrication and weldments.
  • Experience with, cast iron, steel, aluminum alloys, and metallurgy.
  • Introducing new products and new processes into a production environment.
  • Understanding of GD&T inspection methods, and requirements
  • Designing for manufacturability.
  • Interfacing with manufacturing ERP software such as SAP.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Inventor and 2D layout experience, or similar software such as AutoCAD.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Core Competencies:

  • Ability to Design and cost mechanical equipment, fixtures, and tooling.
  • Ability to Create technical specifications for automated manufacturing equipment.
  • Ability to utilize project management tools to provide detailed schedules and budgeting.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced environment
  • Ability to lead mulitple groups of professionals
  • Ability to transition products from prototype to production.
  • Ability and knowledge of utilizing statistical process control (SPC).


Preferences:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or related field.
  • 5+ years of manager experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills, along with a strong work ethic.


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Fully site based
