Job Overview: 
Ingersoll Rand’s Compression Systems and Services Customer Center is hiring a General Line Account Manager to join their team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the Customer Center equipment sales and service activity for a specific territory. Traveling in a defined geographic area, this includes quoting, strategizing, prospecting, and developing relationships to achieve revenue targets, maximize profits, increase market share and maintain customer loyalty while achieving organizational goals. The position is a unique blend of supporting a major distributor and selling direct to customers. 

Responsibilities:

  • Generate Revenue - Responsible for generating sales of equipment, service contracts, and service offerings with our direct end users and partners selling to a defined customer base within a geographic area.  Develop existing customer base and secure new, competitive accounts to expand IR presence in the market. Provide and design compressed air solutions to fulfil industrial customer needs. Products include compressed air equipment, accessories, turnkey installations, service contracts, parts, service, rental equipment and energy audits. Keep current with all product knowledge, industry standards and training needed. Execute strategy for continuous improvement and exceeding customer satisfaction. Achieve all assigned sales targets.  
  • Develop People Capabilities - Provide selling skills and product/services training for dealer sales personnel (as required) as well as personnel within the Customer Center. Partner with services team to best understand products and services and satisfy and anticipate customer’s needs.  
  • Manage Cash - Ensure that all orders obtained are error-free with correct customer documentation. Ensure resolution of all customer disputes. Manage all costs associated with selling efforts, including travel and entertainment expenditures.   
  • Ensure adherence to safety rules (vehicle safety, customer site safety) in the field, as well as in the Customer Center.  
  • Earn customer loyalty by collaborating cross functionally. Leverage best support for customers by partnering with service team to help troubleshoot customer issues or offer unique solutions.   
  • Maintain Customer Relationship Management database including face-to-face customer interactions, assets, agreements, contacts, and opportunities in order management system. Record order follow-up activities (e.g. delivery), reporting requirements (email) and database requirements. Provide feedback on market conditions. Responsible for driving and tracking sales pipeline of all account activity and daily reporting.  

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • 2+ years of an industrial sales business setting or successful completion of the Ingersoll Rand Sales Development Program (SDP).

Core Competencies:

  • Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills, including verbal, written and presentation communication skills. 
  • Establishes and builds solid relationships with customers, key institutions and team members 
  • Honest, self-motivated and team oriented. 
  • Able to work within a team environment and independently. 
  • Mechanical and electrical expertise required. 
  • Ability to assess customer needs, analyze and interpret, perform basic equipment performance calculations, and to recommend technical solutions 
  • Tech savvy; knowledge of Salesforce or other CRM software is preferred 
  • Proven business and sales acumen, including the ability to prospect accounts, effectively navigate within a customer organization, value sell, and win competitive accounts 
  • Must have excellent prioritization and time management skills 

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, business or equivalent 
  • Knowledge of Salesforce 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

This position will be remote, and may travel within the territory about 50% of the time. A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided. Must possess a valid driver’s license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations included, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving, Multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

About Us

Job Overview:

The Inventory Analyst is responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy through cycle count administration, inventory analysis, discrepancy resolution, reporting, and materials planning support. This role partners with Warehouse, Production, Purchasing, Scheduling, and Supply Chain teams to ensure inventory records accurately reflect physical inventory and support operational needs.

The position serves as a key resource for investigating inventory variances, resolving discrepancies, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. This role combines analytical responsibilities with hands-on warehouse activities, including cycle counts, inventory audits, transaction reviews, and inventory research.


Responsibilities:
Inventory Control:

  • Maintain and administer the facility cycle count program, including daily, weekly, monthly, and annual count schedules.
  • Perform cycle counts, inventory audits, and inventory reconciliations in accordance with company policies and procedures.
  • Process inventory adjustments and reconciliation transactions within SAP.
  • Monitor inventory accuracy, analyze trends, and support annual physical inventory activities.
  • Maintain inventory records and ensure compliance with inventory control standards.
  • Assist in developing and improving inventory control policies and procedures.


Inventory Analysis & Investigation

  • Research inventory discrepancies, transaction errors, and variances to determine root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Conduct inventory audits and transaction reviews to validate inventory integrity.
  • Partner with warehouse, production, and planning teams to resolve inventory-related issues.
  • Analyze inventory movements and transaction history to identify process improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain documentation of inventory investigations and corrective actions.
  • Reporting & Data Analysis
  • Maintain inventory reports, dashboards, scorecards, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report inventory accuracy, cycle count completion, adjustment activity, and variance trends.
  • Provide inventory analysis to support operational and supply chain decision-making.
  • Communicate key inventory trends, risks, and concerns to management.


Materials Planning Support

  • Review and release MRP requisitions in SAP.
  • Support material planning, replenishment, and inventory-related master data maintenance.
  • Assist with item setup activities and ensure inventory data accuracy.
  • Collaborate with Purchasing and Planning teams to maintain material availability.


Continuous Improvement

  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve inventory processes, warehouse efficiency, and material flow.
  • Support inventory optimization, warehouse organization, and supply chain improvement initiatives.
  • Promote accountability and ownership of inventory accuracy across the organization.
  • Recommend process improvements based on inventory analysis and operational observations.


Requirements:

  • High school diploma required.
  • 2+ years of experience in inventory control, inventory management, warehouse operations, or supply chain functions.
  • Manufacturing environment experience preferred.
  • SAP experience required.


Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proven ability to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with operations, planning, purchasing, and warehouse teams.
  • Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset.


Preferences:

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or related field preferred.
  • Manufacturing, inventory control, materials planning, or warehouse experience preferred.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP.
  • Experience with SAP, MRP systems, and inventory management software.
  • Strong analytical skills with a focus on inventory accuracy, reporting, and process improvement.



Physical Requirements

  • Ability to frequently walk warehouse and production floor areas.
  • Ability to stand, bend, stoop, and perform inventory audits and cycle counts.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.
  • Must be able to work in both office and warehouse environments.

Work Environment

This position is a hybrid role that combines office-based analytical work with hands-on warehouse activities. The successful candidate will spend a significant portion of time utilizing SAP and Excel to analyze inventory data and generate reports, while also working directly within the warehouse to conduct cycle counts, perform inventory audits, investigate discrepancies, and support inventory accuracy initiatives.

Service Technician

This role is typically not eligible for relocation. If a position is not currently open in an area that you are seeking employment, we will reach out to qualified candidates once an opening is available. 

 

About Us  

Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems.? 

? 

Job Summary? 

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
    ? 

Responsibilities? 

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location.? 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment.? 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.? 

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility.??? 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.? 

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner.? 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers.? 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.? 

? 

Basic Qualifications? 

  • Desired applicants will have 2-5 years’ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus.? While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply.? 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.?? 

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus.???Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.? 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).? 

 

Physical Requirements 

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 

  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 

? 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements? 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training.  1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%).? 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.  

? 

Key Competencies? 

  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.? Working proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.? 

  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc.? 

  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 

  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 

?

Job Title:  Field Service Technician, Electromechanical
Location: Blandon, PA  (Hybrid with travel)

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. 

Job Overview:
Excelsior Blower Systems, a proud Ingersoll Rand brand, has been a powerhouse in engineered air solutions delivering decades of proven performance, reliability, and innovation. Backed by a legacy of excellence, we’re trusted across industries for systems that perform under pressure and consistently exceed expectations.  We’re looking for a hands-on Field Service Technician who thrives in the field and takes pride in keeping critical equipment running at peak performance. In this role, you’ll be the expert customers rely on—installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing Ingersoll Rand positive displacement (PD) blower systems, including controls and VFDs, directly at customer sites. You’ll play a vital role in delivering responsive, high-impact service that supports customers’ operational needs.  
Your work won’t stop in the field. You’ll also install controls and wiring for PD blower systems at our facility, applying your electromechanical expertise across the full equipment lifecycle. If you already bring PD blower experience, you’ll hit the ground running. If not, you bring a strong foundation in rotating equipment, motor and electrical troubleshooting, alignment, system-level diagnostics, and reading schematics and P&IDs—and the drive to master the rest. This is a role for someone who enjoys solving real-world problems, working independently, and making a visible impact every day. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Install, commission, and start up positive displacement (PD) blower packages, vacuum/pressure systems, and associated rotating equipment per OEM specifications and site requirements.

  • Configure, program, and troubleshoot variable frequency drives (VFDs) and soft starters (parameter setup, PID loops, accel/decel profiles, motor protection, fieldbus/communication interfaces such as Modbus/TCP, EtherNet/IP).

  • Diagnose and repair electrical controls including relays, contactors, motor starters, overloads, interlocks, safety circuits, and control transformers.

  • Perform control panel wiring and field terminations (24 VDC control, 120/480 VAC power, grounding/bonding, signal wiring, shielded cable practices); read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and P&IDs.

  • Install and integrate instrumentation (pressure, temperature, vibration, flow, differential pressure transmitters, proximity sensors, limit switches) and calibrate as required.

  • Execute mechanical service tasks (coupling alignment—laser or dial, belt tensioning, blower timing, bearing replacement, seal changes, lubrication, fastener torque verification).

  • Conduct vibration and performance checks; identify root cause of abnormal noise, heat, vibration, or amperage draw (airflow restrictions, leaks, misalignment, cavitation, resonance).

  • Troubleshoot system issues end-to-end across electrical, mechanical, and controls, including motor diagnostics (insulation resistance, megger testing, continuity), VFD/motor matching, and load-related faults.

  • Perform field measurements and documentation (voltage/current, phase balance, harmonics, airflow/pressure, vibration readings) and produce detailed service reports with parts lists and recommended follow-up.

Requirements:

  • High School diploma or GED
  • 5+ years of relevant / equivalent technical experience: millwright, maintenance, engineering, field service.
  • 2+ years of electromechanical experience
Core Competencies

  • Strong electromechanical troubleshooting skills, including rotating equipment such as motors, gearboxes, compressors, mixers, blowers, and pumps; electronic power conversion (AC to DC) and related faults/alarms (GF, OC, OV, UV, OL, OH); and PLC troubleshooting, including I/O, hardware, and software checks.
  • Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, employees, and Sales Representatives.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues, resolve conflicts, make sound decisions, and appropriately escalate problems in dynamic environments.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills with the ability to meet deadlines and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Valid driver’s license held for at least 12 months with a satisfactory driving record. No major or frequent violations, including DUI within the past 5 years, hit-and-run, license suspension, reckless/careless driving, or multiple minor violations/preventable collisions within the past 3 years.
Travel & Work Arrangements

  • Position is 40% onsite shop repairs and up to 60% travel for field work
  • Possible minimal travel to Canada, Puerto Rico, and/or Mexico
  • Paid travel time at full hourly rate
  • Company vehicle and gas provided
What We Offer
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Title: Material Handler
Location: Bentleyville Facility in Charleroi, PA (Gardner Denver Nash - 200 Simko Blvd. Charleroi, PA 15022) Shift: 1st Shift (5am - 130pm)

About Us:

Job Overview:
The Material Handler is responsible for ensuring materials are supplied where and when they are needed. The Material Handler is responsible for keeping workstations fully stocked with materials, ultimately contributing to higher overall productivity of other workers.

Responsibilities:

  • Receives, ships, loads, and unloads materials/parts from suppliers or carriers.? Material may be unloaded from trucks, pallets, trays, racks, and shelves by hand, with forklift, or other material handling device.
  • Visually inspects incoming pieces/parts for compliance and obvious damage; informing Quality if necessary.
  • Moves material/parts from warehouse or receiving area, to designated line or stock locations. (Ex: to proper stock location, to inspection area, to machine cell) while using barcode scanner and/or computers.
  • Uses computer and/or barcode scanner to properly identify stock locations to retrieve parts. Moving stock to release, consolidate, or change part locations.
  • Reads work order or follows oral instructions to determine materials to be transferred; informs inventory control to update computer system when necessary (Ex: quantity mismatch, mixed parts, wrong labels). Counts, weighs, and records number of units of materials received, moved, or shipped and reports inconsistencies to inventory control.
  • Operates forklift, hand truck, and/or other material handling equipment to assist in loading or moving any material.
  • Receives work orders from planners; picks parts to jobs for machine shop, assembly areas, staging for kits, and spare part sales orders using barcode scanner and/or computer.
  • Follows all ISO procedures and safety rules, including wearing personal safety equipment. Remove any debris found on shelves throughout the warehouse. Demonstrates excellence in completion of all other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 1+ years’ experience in manufacturing or distribution industry
  • Forklift Certified


Core Competencies:

  • Lifting: Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds occasionally with hoist to be used on objects over 40 pounds.
  • Standing: Standing is required in periods of up to three hours at a time.
  • Stooping: Would be required to lift objects off pallets
  • Hand Dexterity: Must be able to work with hand tools, screws and gauges, as well as operating buttons on controls.
  • Verbal Communication: Must be capable of clear communication between co-workers and supervisor.
  • Carrying: Capable of carrying 40 pounds for a distance of up to 25 feet.


Preferences:

  • Knowledge of inventory processes.
  • Process driven and systematic in their approach to completing their work
  • Ability to identify and solve problems.
  • Ability to pass certification for Powered Industrial Vehicle license.


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • This position will be based at our site in Bentleyville, PA no travel.

Job Title: Service Technician 

Location:  Shrewsbury, PA, Baltimore, MD - Washington DC area 


About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. 

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.

  • Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
  • Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
  • Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:

  • 2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
  • Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided.

Core Competencies: 

  • Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
  • Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
  • Basic vibration troubleshooting.
  • Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner.

Preferences:

  • Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
  • EPA Certification.
  • Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply. 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
  • A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.
  • Hybrid
Pay Range:

Starting pay will range between $25.00 - $40.00 per hour depending on multiple factors, including candidate qualifications and experience. It is not typical for candidates to be paid at the top of the range. This is a full-time, hourly position.

Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Service Technician  

Location: Multiple positions located at or near our East Customer Center Locations - Allentown, PA; Aston, PA; Edison, NJ; Marlborough, MA; Scarsborough, ME; Shrewsbury, PA; Richmond, VA; Greensboro, NC; Charlotte, NC. This role is typically not eligible for relocation. If a position is not currently open in an area that you are seeking employment, we will reach out to qualified candidates once an opening is available. 

 

About Us  

Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems.? 

? 

Job Summary? 

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
    ? 

Responsibilities? 

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location.? 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment.? 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.? 

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility.??? 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.? 

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner.? 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers.? 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.? 

? 

Basic Qualifications? 

  • Desired applicants will have 2-5 years’ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus.? While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply.? 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.?? 

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus.???Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.? 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).? 

 

Physical Requirements 

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 

  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 

? 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements? 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training.  1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%).? 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.  

? 

Key Competencies? 

  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.? Working proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.? 

  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc.? 

  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 

  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 

? 

What We Offer? 

At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.? 

The total pay range for this role, including incentive opportunities, is $45,000 - $120,000. The total pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed pay range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Ingersoll Rand, it is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.??

Job Title: Service Technician 

Location:  Shrewsbury, PA, Baltimore, MD - Washington DC area 


About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. 

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.

  • Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
  • Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
  • Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:

  • 2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
  • Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. 
  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided.

Core Competencies: 

  • Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
  • Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
  • Basic vibration troubleshooting.
  • Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner.

Preferences:

  • Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
  • EPA Certification.
  • Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply. 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
  • A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.
  • Hybrid
Pay Range:

Starting pay will range between $25.00 - $40.00 per hour depending on multiple factors, including candidate qualifications and experience. It is not typical for candidates to be paid at the top of the range. This is a full-time, hourly position.


What We Offer:
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

Job Title:  Field Service Technician, Electromechanical
Location: Blandon, PA  (Hybrid with travel)

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. 

Job Overview:
Excelsior Blower Systems, a proud Ingersoll Rand brand, has been a powerhouse in engineered air solutions delivering decades of proven performance, reliability, and innovation. Backed by a legacy of excellence, we’re trusted across industries for systems that perform under pressure and consistently exceed expectations.  We’re looking for a hands-on Field Service Technician who thrives in the field and takes pride in keeping critical equipment running at peak performance. In this role, you’ll be the expert customers rely on—installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing Ingersoll Rand positive displacement (PD) blower systems, including controls and VFDs, directly at customer sites. You’ll play a vital role in delivering responsive, high-impact service that supports customers’ operational needs.  
Your work won’t stop in the field. You’ll also install controls and wiring for PD blower systems at our facility, applying your electromechanical expertise across the full equipment lifecycle. If you already bring PD blower experience, you’ll hit the ground running. If not, you bring a strong foundation in rotating equipment, motor and electrical troubleshooting, alignment, system-level diagnostics, and reading schematics and P&IDs—and the drive to master the rest. This is a role for someone who enjoys solving real-world problems, working independently, and making a visible impact every day. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Install, commission, and start up positive displacement (PD) blower packages, vacuum/pressure systems, and associated rotating equipment per OEM specifications and site requirements.

  • Configure, program, and troubleshoot variable frequency drives (VFDs) and soft starters (parameter setup, PID loops, accel/decel profiles, motor protection, fieldbus/communication interfaces such as Modbus/TCP, EtherNet/IP).

  • Diagnose and repair electrical controls including relays, contactors, motor starters, overloads, interlocks, safety circuits, and control transformers.

  • Perform control panel wiring and field terminations (24 VDC control, 120/480 VAC power, grounding/bonding, signal wiring, shielded cable practices); read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and P&IDs.

  • Install and integrate instrumentation (pressure, temperature, vibration, flow, differential pressure transmitters, proximity sensors, limit switches) and calibrate as required.

  • Execute mechanical service tasks (coupling alignment—laser or dial, belt tensioning, blower timing, bearing replacement, seal changes, lubrication, fastener torque verification).

  • Conduct vibration and performance checks; identify root cause of abnormal noise, heat, vibration, or amperage draw (airflow restrictions, leaks, misalignment, cavitation, resonance).

  • Troubleshoot system issues end-to-end across electrical, mechanical, and controls, including motor diagnostics (insulation resistance, megger testing, continuity), VFD/motor matching, and load-related faults.

  • Perform field measurements and documentation (voltage/current, phase balance, harmonics, airflow/pressure, vibration readings) and produce detailed service reports with parts lists and recommended follow-up.

Requirements:

  • High School diploma or GED
  • 5+ years of relevant / equivalent technical experience: millwright, maintenance, engineering, field service.
  • 2+ years of electromechanical experience
Core Competencies

  • Strong electromechanical troubleshooting skills, including rotating equipment such as motors, gearboxes, compressors, mixers, blowers, and pumps; electronic power conversion (AC to DC) and related faults/alarms (GF, OC, OV, UV, OL, OH); and PLC troubleshooting, including I/O, hardware, and software checks.
  • Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, employees, and Sales Representatives.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues, resolve conflicts, make sound decisions, and appropriately escalate problems in dynamic environments.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills with the ability to meet deadlines and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Valid driver’s license held for at least 12 months with a satisfactory driving record. No major or frequent violations, including DUI within the past 5 years, hit-and-run, license suspension, reckless/careless driving, or multiple minor violations/preventable collisions within the past 3 years.
Travel & Work Arrangements

  • Position is 40% onsite shop repairs and up to 60% travel for field work
  • Possible minimal travel to Canada, Puerto Rico, and/or Mexico
  • Paid travel time at full hourly rate
  • Company vehicle and gas provided

Job Overview:
Are you a skilled machinist with a passion for precision and innovation? At Ingersoll Rand, we are seeking a talented and dedicated Manual Machinist to join our dynamic team. This is more than just a job — it’s an opportunity to be part of a company that values craftsmanship, excellence, safety, and collaboration. Join Ingersoll Rand and build your future with a company that recognizes your skills, experience, and contributions while providing opportunities to grow in a supportive and innovative environment.
 
 
Responsibilities:
  • Performs set ups of large Liquid Ring Vacuum Pump components and operations of large Vertical & Horizontal Lathes used to repair and overhaul Large Liquid Rind Vacuum Pumps & Compressors. 
  • Interprets blueprints/drawings to determine critical dimensions, etc. Ability to read Micrometers, Vernier Calipers, Dial Indicators & other precision measuring & test equipment as required. 
  • Able to maintain low tolerances as indicated by specifications or drawings as low as .0005” at times. 
  • Understands how to select appropriate cutting tools for various metals. Understands how to determine speeds and feeds to obtain proper surface finish.
  • Able to work overtime; typically, throughout the week and occasionally on weekends. 
  • Safe operation of Forklift within a Machine Shop environment. Safe Over Head Crane operation. Adheres to all company EH&S & QMS processes.
  • Lifting and rigging of heavy components of various configurations & weights. Assisting in the disassembly, reassembly, repair and rebuilding of Large Liquid Ring Vacuum Pumps.
  • Opportunities to cross train in different areas as necessary, such as: Fabrication, Assembly, Rotar Balancing, etc.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned
  Requirements:
  • Applicants will be required to demonstrate knowledge of machine setup, as well as usage of machine controls and capabilities. 
  • 3+ years of experience as a machine operator/Machinist.
  • 2+ or more years of experience reading and interpreting blueprints.  
  • 1+ years of experience operating King-style boring mills and/or vertical turning lathes (VTLs).
  • Ability to effectively and safely use a variety of tools and equipment, including but not limited to depth gauges, bore gauges, height gauges, feeler gauges, micrometers, calipers, deburring tools, die grinders, drill presses, and overhead lifting equipment.
  Core Competencies:
  • Proficiency with prioritizing and meeting multiple deadlines.
  • Ability to convert between metric and US standard units of measure.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several variables 
  • Ability to use standard problem-solving methods (i.e. 5 Whys) as trained 
  • Ability to effectively share information about job duties in one-on-one and small group situations to supervisor, customers, clients, and other employees of the organization. 
  Preferences: 
  • HS Diploma or GED preferred. Higher Education or certificate is a plus.
  • Experience with manual machining such as VTL/Boring Mill/ or Horizontal Lathe. Brands would include but not limited to Cincinnati and King brand.
  • Proven ability to set up and operate Manual Machines, work centers, specializing in tool changes and in-process offset adjustments. 
 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements: 
  • This position will be based 100% onsite at our Moody, AL facility

job.description:
Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. The pay range for this role is Min - 150,000 - Max - 185,000 . excluding incentive opportunities. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Business Unit: Power Tools & Lifting (PTL) Function: Product Management & Engineering

Reports To: Engineering Director

Location: Hampton, NJ

Travel: 15-25% Global

Position Summary

The Sr. Engineering Manager is responsible for leading the development of innovative cordless and connected power tool platforms from concept through production launch. The role provides technical and organizational leadership for a cross-functional team of mechanical, mechatronics, electrical, and design engineers supporting New Product Development (NPD), innovation, product enhancement, and cost optimization initiatives.

This leader will drive execution of strategic programs across the Power Tools portfolio, ensuring products meet customer requirements, quality expectations, regulatory standards, cost targets, and schedule commitments. The role serves as a key member of the engineering team and works closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Marketing, and global engineering centers.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead and develop a team of mechanical, electro-mechanical and product engineers.
  • Establish clear technical priorities, project ownership, and resource allocation.
  • Coach and mentor engineers to strengthen technical depth, innovation, and leadership capabilities.
  • Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

New Product Development

  • Lead engineering execution for cordless and connected power tool platforms.
  • Ensure adherence to IR product development processes, stage-gate reviews, and engineering best practices.
  • Drive successful execution of complex programs from concept through commercialization.
  • Balance innovation, customer requirements, manufacturability, reliability, and cost objectives.

Mechanical & Mechatronics Systems Development

  • Provide technical leadership in:
  • Gear trains and power transmission systems
  • Impact and clutch mechanisms
  • Motor integration
  • Battery-powered tool systems
  • Electromechanical assemblies
  • Sensors, controls, and connectivity
  • Tool calibration and measurement systems
  • Guide architecture decisions involving mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software integration.

Product Validation & Reliability

  • Ensure robust validation plans including:
  • DVP&R
  • Reliability testing
  • Environmental testing
  • EMC/EMI compliance
  • Product safety certification
  • Lead resolution of technical issues using structured root cause methodologies.

Project & Portfolio Management

  • Partner with Product Management to translate market opportunities into executable engineering programs.
  • Manage engineering budgets, project timelines, and resource plans.
  • Support executive reviews by providing status, risk assessments, mitigation plans, and recommendations.

Global Collaboration

  • Partner closely with engineering teams in North America, India, and Asia.
  • Support supplier qualification and technical reviews.
  • Drive consistency of engineering standards, tools, and processes across geographies.

Innovation & Technology Development

  • Lead technology roadmaps aligned with strategic business objectives.
  • Drive invention disclosures, patent generation, and advanced engineering initiatives.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies including:
  • Smart fastening
  • Connected tools
  • Battery technology
  • Motor control systems
  • IoT-enabled solutions

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of engineering experience in product development.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex electromechanical product development programs.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Mechanical system design
  • Design for Manufacturing (DFM)
  • GD&T
  • FMEA
  • Reliability engineering
  • Product validation processes
  • Experience with CAD platforms such as Creo or equivalent.
  • Proven track record of successfully launching products into production.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical, Electro-mechanical Engineering, or Engineering Management.
  • Experience in:
  • Cordless power tools
  • Assembly tools
  • Industrial equipment
  • Motion control products
  • Knowledge of:
  • Brushless DC motors
  • Battery management systems
  • Embedded controls
  • Wireless communication technologies
  • Global engineering leadership experience.
  • Patent development and innovation leadership experience.

Job Title: Manual Machinist (2nd Shift)
Shift: Monday – Thursday, 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM
Location: Moody, AL (On-site)

Hourly Rate: $32-$35
$3.00 per hour shift differential for 2nd shift employees.
$3,500 Retention bonus, $1,000 bonus, relocation assistance available

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  
 
Job Overview:
Are you a skilled machinist with a passion for precision and innovation? At Ingersoll Rand, we are seeking a talented and dedicated Manual Machinist to join our dynamic team. This is more than just a job — it’s an opportunity to be part of a company that values craftsmanship, excellence, safety, and collaboration. Join Ingersoll Rand and build your future with a company that recognizes your skills, experience, and contributions while providing opportunities to grow in a supportive and innovative environment.
 
 
Responsibilities:
  • Performs set ups of large Liquid Ring Vacuum Pump components and operations of large Vertical & Horizontal Lathes used to repair and overhaul Large Liquid Rind Vacuum Pumps & Compressors. 
  • Interprets blueprints/drawings to determine critical dimensions, etc. Ability to read Micrometers, Vernier Calipers, Dial Indicators & other precision measuring & test equipment as required. 
  • Able to maintain low tolerances as indicated by specifications or drawings as low as .0005” at times. 
  • Understands how to select appropriate cutting tools for various metals. Understands how to determine speeds and feeds to obtain proper surface finish.
  • Able to work overtime; typically, throughout the week and occasionally on weekends. 
  • Safe operation of Forklift within a Machine Shop environment. Safe Over Head Crane operation. Adheres to all company EH&S & QMS processes.
  • Lifting and rigging of heavy components of various configurations & weights. Assisting in the disassembly, reassembly, repair and rebuilding of Large Liquid Ring Vacuum Pumps.
  • Opportunities to cross train in different areas as necessary, such as: Fabrication, Assembly, Rotar Balancing, etc.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned
  Requirements:
  • Applicants will be required to demonstrate knowledge of machine setup, as well as usage of machine controls and capabilities. 
  • 3+ years of experience as a machine operator/Machinist.
  • 2+ or more years of experience reading and interpreting blueprints.  
  • 1+ years of experience operating King-style boring mills and/or vertical turning lathes (VTLs).
  • Ability to effectively and safely use a variety of tools and equipment, including but not limited to depth gauges, bore gauges, height gauges, feeler gauges, micrometers, calipers, deburring tools, die grinders, drill presses, and overhead lifting equipment.
  Core Competencies:
  • Proficiency with prioritizing and meeting multiple deadlines.
  • Ability to convert between metric and US standard units of measure.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several variables 
  • Ability to use standard problem-solving methods (i.e. 5 Whys) as trained 
  • Ability to effectively share information about job duties in one-on-one and small group situations to supervisor, customers, clients, and other employees of the organization. 
  Preferences: 
  • HS Diploma or GED preferred. Higher Education or certificate is a plus.
  • Experience with manual machining such as VTL/Boring Mill/ or Horizontal Lathe. Brands would include but not limited to Cincinnati and King brand.
  • Proven ability to set up and operate Manual Machines, work centers, specializing in tool changes and in-process offset adjustments. 
 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements: 
  • This position will be based 100% onsite at our Moody, AL facility

Job Title: Centrifugal Service Technician 
Locations: Phoenix, AZ

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview
The Centrifugal Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems & Services division serves customers by installing, trouble shooting, repairing and maintaining our centrifugal compressor product lines including Centac and Turbo Air models, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems, including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement. 
  • Read wiring schematics and diagrams for equipment, research complex technical issues, and find/implement solutions.  
  • Document service and installation activities by completing work orders for each job, performing maintenance checklists, and maintaining daily time sheets. 
  • Maintain rapport with customers by suggesting improved methods and techniques and recommending system improvements. Increase Ingersoll Rand customer’s awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services and solutions; such as Package CARE, preventative maintenance (PMs), diagnostics, air audits, and leak detection, can benefit their operations. 
  • Conduct safety assessments of a continuously changing work environment. Ensure proper operation of compressed air equipment by completing preventative maintenance requirements and 47-point inspections on a wide variety of compressors, refrigerated dryers, desiccant dryers and additional compressed air components.
  • Work with Service Coordinator and operations teams on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs.
  • Explain practices, procedures, and policies to reach agreement with suppliers and others outside of the job area. 
  • Conduct basic vibration and air quality troubleshooting. 
Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years of Centrifugal compressor experience.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.  
Core Competentcies
  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; speciality tools will be provided.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years. 
  • Ability to work in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling, and requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • Ability to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
  • Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation). 
  • Basic vibration troubleshooting. 
  • Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment). 
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. 
  • Proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases. 
  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills and customer service skills including conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
Preferences:

  • Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
  • EPA Certification.
  • Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply. 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • Daily travel to customer sites, occasional overtime, and occasional overnight stays required. 
  • A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided. 
Pay Range: Starting pay will range between $35.00 - $50.00 per hour depending on qualifications and experience. This is a full-time, hourly position

What We Offer

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

Responsibilities: 

HR Partnership & Support

Job Title: Centrifugal Service Technician 
Locations: Phoenix, AZ

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview
The Centrifugal Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems & Services division serves customers by installing, trouble shooting, repairing and maintaining our centrifugal compressor product lines including Centac and Turbo Air models, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems, including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement. 
  • Read wiring schematics and diagrams for equipment, research complex technical issues, and find/implement solutions.  
  • Document service and installation activities by completing work orders for each job, performing maintenance checklists, and maintaining daily time sheets. 
  • Maintain rapport with customers by suggesting improved methods and techniques and recommending system improvements. Increase Ingersoll Rand customer’s awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services and solutions; such as Package CARE, preventative maintenance (PMs), diagnostics, air audits, and leak detection, can benefit their operations. 
  • Conduct safety assessments of a continuously changing work environment. Ensure proper operation of compressed air equipment by completing preventative maintenance requirements and 47-point inspections on a wide variety of compressors, refrigerated dryers, desiccant dryers and additional compressed air components.
  • Work with Service Coordinator and operations teams on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs.
  • Explain practices, procedures, and policies to reach agreement with suppliers and others outside of the job area. 
  • Conduct basic vibration and air quality troubleshooting. 
Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years of Centrifugal compressor experience.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.  
Core Competentcies
  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; speciality tools will be provided.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years. 
  • Ability to work in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling, and requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • Ability to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
  • Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation). 
  • Basic vibration troubleshooting. 
  • Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment). 
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. 
  • Proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases. 
  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills and customer service skills including conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
Preferences:

  • Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
  • EPA Certification.
  • Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply. 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • Daily travel to customer sites, occasional overtime, and occasional overnight stays required. 
  • A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided. 
Pay Range: Starting pay will range between $35.00 - $50.00 per hour depending on qualifications and experience. This is a full-time, hourly position

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview
Help build the next generation of mission-critical power in a true ground-floor opportunity. The Mechanical Engineer – Power Generation Containerization will help design and launch a new line of large-scale, containerized power generation solutions supporting mission-critical data centers. Ingersoll Rand is building a new data center power generation vertical, and this engineer will help shape the mechanical architecture, product platform, and manufacturing strategy behind it. The role will translate existing product knowledge from Ingersoll Rand’s acquired Australian business and North American partners into in-house designs that can be manufactured efficiently and at scale in Sidney, Ohio.  

The Mechanical Engineer will own key aspects of the mechanical design and integration of these large generator systems, including structural assemblies, enclosures, cooling systems, fuel and base tanks, equipment layouts, and overall mechanical packaging. These are complex systems built around large diesel engines, alternators, radiators, fuel systems, controls, and serviceable layouts designed to provide critical backup power where uptime and cooling continuity are essential.  As an early member of this growing technical team, the engineer will have meaningful hands-on ownership from concept and CAD design through manufacturing readiness and commercialization. The role will work closely with electrical engineering, applications engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, project management, sales, and the Sidney plant to ensure solutions meet both customer requirements and manufacturing needs.

The ideal candidate brings mechanical design experience in power generation, large industrial equipment, modular systems, or complex packaged equipment. Experience with generator packaging or containerization, large diesel generators, 2MW+ systems, cooling systems, fuel tanks, enclosures, or applicable UL requirements is especially valuable. For an engineer who wants to do more than support an established product line, this is an opportunity to help build one from the ground up—with significant technical ownership, strong company investment, and meaningful growth potential.


Responsibilities: 
Mechanical Design & Engineering
  • Design containerized and modular power generation solutions for data center backup and prime power applications.
  • Develop 3D models, detailed drawings, assemblies, fabrication packages, and engineering documentation using CAD software.
  • Design and integrate:
    • Generator enclosures and power modules
    • ISO container-based power systems
    • Structural support systems and equipment skids
    • Fuel storage and fuel delivery systems
    • Air intake and exhaust systems
    • Ventilation and cooling systems
    • Acoustic attenuation systems
    • Fire protection interfaces
    • Service access and maintenance provisions
  • Perform engineering calculations related to structural integrity, airflow, cooling performance, vibration, noise attenuation, and equipment support.

Data Center Solutions Engineering
  • Design power generation enclosures and modules to support mission-critical data center applications.
  • Ensure equipment layouts support uptime, maintainability, safe operations, and rapid serviceability.
  • Collaborate with customers and internal teams to develop custom solutions that meet data center site constraints and operational requirements.
  • Support designs for N, N+1, and 2N redundancy architectures.
  • Evaluate and optimize designs for deployment within hyperscale and colocation environments.

Thermal Management & Cooling
  • Develop cooling and ventilation solutions for high-performance generator systems.
  • Perform airflow analysis and thermal assessments to ensure proper equipment operation across varying environmental conditions.
  • Support integration of HVAC equipment, engine cooling packages, and auxiliary thermal management systems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve cooling efficiency and reduce energy consumption.

Product Development & Standardization
  • Support development of standardized containerized power generation platforms.
  • Drive design improvements focused on reliability, manufacturability, quality, cost, and serviceability.
  • Participate in design reviews, failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA), and root cause investigations.
  • Evaluate new technologies, materials, and manufacturing methods to improve product performance.

Manufacturing & Testing Support
  • Provide engineering support for prototype builds and production manufacturing.
  • Resolve mechanical design issues during fabrication, assembly, and field deployment.
  • Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), validation testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Review supplier drawings and support qualification of mechanical components and assemblies.

Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Collaborate with electrical, controls, acoustics, and thermal engineering teams to ensure complete system integration.
  • Participate in technical reviews with customers, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
  • Support sales and project teams with technical evaluations, proposals, and feasibility assessments.
  • Assist field service organizations with troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements 
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • 3+ years of progressive mechanical development design experience ideally in power generation, industrial equipment, modular systems, heavy equipment, or related industries.
  • 2+ years experience with 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, Inventor, or similar platforms, with bility to develop engineering documentation and manufacturing drawings.
  • 2+ years of demonstrated knowledge in:
    • Structural design
    • Sheet metal fabrication
    • Welded assemblies
    • Airflow and ventilation systems
    • Thermal management principles
    • Mechanical packaging concepts

    Core Competencies 
    • Power generation equipment packaging
    • Containerized power solutions
    • Structural and mechanical design
    • Thermal management systems
    • Airflow and ventilation engineering
    • Acoustic engineering and noise reduction
    • Fuel system integration
    • Vibration isolation
    • Design for manufacturability (DFM)
    • Reliability and maintainability engineering
    • Data center infrastructure requirements
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

    Preferences:
    • 5+ years of experience in power generation, mission-critical infrastructure, modular construction, or data center industries.
    • Experience designing:
      • Generator enclosures
      • Containerized equipment packages
      • Cooling systems
      • Fuel systems
      • Acoustic attenuation solutions
    • Familiarity with finite element analysis (FEA) and computational fluid dynamics (CFD).
    • Knowledge of ISO container standards and transportation requirements.
    • Experience supporting hyperscale data center customers.
    • Understanding of engine cooling systems, exhaust systems, and vibration isolation.
    • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification.

    Travel & Work Arrangements
    • Position is based onsite in Sidney, OH
    • Relocation assistance available
    • Standard work hours 8:00 am - 5:00 pm

    The base pay range for this role is $100,000 - $130,000 annually. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.
