Job Title: Electrical Engineer, Power Generation Containerization                
Location:  Sidney, OH
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Help build the next generation of mission-critical power in this true ground-floor opportunity. The Electrical Design Engineer, Power Generation Containerization will help design, integrate, and launch a new line of large-scale, containerized power generation solutions supporting mission-critical data centers. Ingersoll Rand is building a new data center power generation vertical, and this engineer will help shape the electrical architecture, system integration, and manufacturing strategy behind it. The role will translate existing product knowledge from Ingersoll Rand’s acquired Australian business and North American partners into in-house designs that can be manufactured efficiently and at scale in Sidney, Ohio.

The Electrical Design Engineer will own key aspects of the electrical design and integration of large generator systems, including generator enclosures, power connections, controls access, electrical equipment layout, and overall packaged-system integration. These are not small commercial generators, but large-scale diesel generator systems designed to provide critical backup power for data center environments where reliability, uptime, and continuity are essential.  As an early member of this growing technical team, the engineer will have meaningful hands-on ownership from design and integration through validation, manufacturing readiness, and commercialization. The role will partner closely with the Mechanical Engineer, applications engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, suppliers, project management, and the Sidney plant to ensure the complete packaged solution meets both customer requirements and manufacturing needs.

The ideal candidate brings electrical design experience in power generation, large generator systems, data center electrical infrastructure, mission-critical backup power, industrial equipment, or modular/containerized power systems. Experience with generator packaging or containerization, 2MW+ systems, diesel generator sets, and environments where code compliance, serviceability, and reliability are critical is especially valuable. For an engineer who wants to do more than support an established product line, this is an opportunity to help build one from the ground up—with significant technical ownership, strong company investment, and meaningful growth potential.

Responsibilities:
Electrical System Design
  • Design electrical systems for containerized and modular power generation packages supporting data center applications.
  • Develop electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring drawings, cable schedules, panel layouts, and system architecture documentation.
  • Design and integrate:
    • Diesel and natural gas generator systems
    • Generator paralleling systems
    • Switchgear and switchboards
    • Medium- and low-voltage distribution equipment
    • Automatic transfer switches (ATS)
    • UPS interfaces
    • Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
    • Auxiliary systems including HVAC, lighting, monitoring, and fire protection
  • Perform electrical calculations including:
    • Load flow analysis
    • Equipment sizing
    • Short-circuit studies
    • Voltage drop calculations
    • Protective device coordination
Data Center Power Solutions
  • Develop solutions that support mission-critical data center reliability requirements including N, N+1, and 2N architectures.
  • Support integration with customer electrical infrastructure and utility interconnection requirements.
  • Design systems to meet data center expectations for uptime, maintainability, scalability, and serviceability.
  • Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to evaluate custom power generation and backup power solutions.
  • Support electrical integration for modular and prefabricated power systems used in hyperscale and colocation data centers.
Product Development & Standardization
  • Drive development of standardized containerized power generation platforms for data center markets.
  • Create and maintain engineering specifications, design standards, and best practices.
  • Conduct design reviews and support FMEA, reliability analysis, and risk assessments.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies including hybrid power systems, energy storage, microgrids, and renewable energy integrations.
Testing, Validation & Commissioning
  • Support prototype development, testing, and validation activities.
  • Develop and review Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) procedures and Site Acceptance Test (SAT) protocols.
  • Participate in commissioning and startup activities for customer projects.
  • Troubleshoot electrical integration issues during manufacturing, deployment, and field operation.
Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work directly with data center customers, consultants, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
  • Provide technical leadership during project execution and customer design reviews.
  • Support sales and business development teams with technical proposals and engineering evaluations.
  • Coordinate with manufacturing and sourcing teams to ensure successful product implementation.

Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline. 
  • 3+ years of progressive electrical design experience ideally in power generation, critical facilities, industrial systems, modular infrastructure, or related industries. 
  • 3+ years experience interpreting electrical specifications and customer technical requirements.
  • 2+ years experience designing power distribution systems and power generation equipment.
  • 2+ years of proficienct experience in AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical, or similar design platforms.
  • 2+ years of demonstrated knowledge in: 
    • Generator systems 
    • Electrical protection and coordination 
    • Low-voltage and medium-voltage power distribution 
    • Electrical codes and standards


Core Competencies:
  • Emergency and standby power systems
  • Generator controls and synchronization
  • Utility interconnection
  • Switchgear and switchboards
  • Protective relaying and system coordination
  • Medium-voltage distribution systems
  • Containerized power solutions
  • Energy storage integration
  • Mission-critical infrastructure
  • Data center electrical architecture

Preferences: 
  • 5+ years of experience supporting data center, mission-critical, or power generation industries.
  • Experience with:
    • Data center electrical infrastructure
    • Generator paralleling systems
    • Medium-voltage switchgear
    • Microgrid applications
    • Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
  • Knowledge of data center design practices and redundancy architectures.
  • Familiarity with PLC controls, SCADA systems, and power monitoring systems.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification.
  • Experience supporting hyperscale data center customers such as Microsoft, AWS, Google, Meta, or other colocation providers.
 

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • Position is based onsite in Sidney, OH
  • Standard work hours 8:00 am - 5:00 pm
  • Open to relocation assistance

Pay Range - The base pay range for this role is $100,000 - $130,000 annually. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Overview: 

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for the development, optimization, troubleshooting, and long-term support of manufacturing test systems used in end-of-line (EOL) testing of pumps, compressors, motors, and related products. The position also supports laboratory instrumentation including pressure, temperature, flow, and electrical measurement systems and provides electrical and controls engineering support to plant maintenance and manufacturing teams. This role partners closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, and Operations teams to improve product validation processes, increase test system reliability, enhance data collection capabilities, and ensure products consistently meet customer and quality requirements. 

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain electrical and automated end-of-line test systems used to validate product performance, safety, and quality requirements prior to shipment.
  • Develop and support LabVIEW, National Instruments, PLC-based, and data acquisition systems used for manufacturing and laboratory testing.
  • Troubleshoot and improve electrical test equipment, instrumentation, sensors, controls, drives, and data collection systems to maximize uptime and test accuracy.
  • Support pressure, temperature, flow, electrical, vibration, and performance measurement systems used in manufacturing and product qualification testing.
  • Partner with Quality and Manufacturing teams to investigate test failures, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to improve product quality and first-pass yield.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on test automation, process capability, cycle-time reduction, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Support new product introductions by developing test methodologies, validation plans, fixtures, work instructions, and production support processes.
  • Provide electrical engineering support to plant operations, maintenance, and capital projects, including equipment upgrades and modernization initiatives. 
 

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in manufacturing, automation, controls, or test/industrial electrical engineering, including hands-on development, maintenance, or troubleshooting of automated test equipment and electrical measurement systems.
  • 3+ years with LabVIEW and National Instruments hardware/software platforms, with hands-on exposure to industrial instrumentation (pressure, temperature, flow, vibration, power measurement)
  • 1+ years supporting end-of-line testing in a high-volume manufacturing environment

Core Competencies:  

  • Manufacturing Test System Expertise
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Root Cause Analysis and Problem Solving
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Customer and Quality Focus 
 

Preferences: 

  • Experience supporting end-of-line testing in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and cross-functional communication skills. 
  • Knowledge of electrical controls, PLCs, VFDs, motors, sensors, industrial communications, and data acquisition systems.
  • Experience with pumps, compressors, rotating equipment, or industrial machinery.
  • Knowledge of electrical safety standards, risk assessments, system validation, and design verification testing.
 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This position is fully site-based at the Monroe, Louisiana manufacturing facility.
    • Occasional travel may be required to support equipment suppliers, training activities, customer requirements, or other business needs.

Title: CNC Machinist
Location: Mocksville, NC (Onsite) (338 Valley Rd. Mocksville, NC 27028)
Shift: 3rd Shift (Monday - Friday 11PM - 7AM) - Full-time Direct Hire

About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Job Overview:
We are looking for a skilled CNC Machinist to perform a variety of tasks as assigned in conjunction with the assembly of our product. You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands.

You must have desired technical knowledge and possess great manual dexterity. Ability to interpret instructions represented in manuals, drawings, schematics etc. and follow them with precision.

Responsibilities:

  • Uses blueprints, sketches, drawings, and/or job instruction sheets to produce dimensions and tolerances of finished work-piece and setup requirements.
  • Cutting tools, attachments, accessories, and materials on machines such as mills, lathes, grinders, machining centers, drill presses, and drill machines.
  • Enters commands to retrieve, input, or edit control information for CNC machines.
  • Sets up, operates, and monitors machine operation to detect malfunctions or out-of-tolerance machining, and adjusts machine controls or control media as required.
  • Utilizes a variety of measurement tools and methods to evaluate finished parts against specifications.
  • Reworks parts that don't meet specifications.
  • Confers with supervisor, engineers, and production personnel to resolve machining problems.
  • Follows all ISO procedures and safety rules, including wearing personal safety equipment and performing hoist inspections.
  • Routes completed parts to next machine according to the routing sequence.
  • Performs data entry on the computer to update part locations.
  • Updates work order cover sheets, daily production sheets, status sheets, and quality records.
  • Participates in regular communication among peers and Team Leads to maintain productivity and solve problems as they arise.
  • Operates with the close attention to detail required to meet print specifications, down to 0.0002in tolerances.
  • Maintains 5S standards of organization and housekeeping of work area.
  • Participates in improvement efforts for cell layout, process efficiencies, etc.
  • Attends monthly departmental meetings and quarterly town hall meetings.
  • Other assigned duties


Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • 2+ years of CNC machining experience


Key Competencies:

  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, blueprints, memos, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to effectively share information about job duties in one-on-one and small group situations to supervisor, customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.
  • Ability to perform basic calculations with numbers between 0.0001 and 0.1
  • Ability to convert between metric and US standard units of measure.
  • Ability to understand and carry out detailed written or oral instructions.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several variables
  • Ability to use standard problem-solving methods (ie. 5 Whys) as trained
  • Ability to stand and walk up to 8 hours continuously during a shift.
  • Ability to lift up to 35 lbs alone, or 70 lbs with assistance, repeatedly over an 8 hour shift
  • Ability to push or pull up to 35 lbs.
  • Ability to see or have vision corrected with glasses/contacts to an evaluated level of no worse than 20/35.


Preferences:

  • Associates degree, or training certification
  • Ability to effectively use tools such as the following: depth gages, bore gages, height gages, feeler gages, micrometers, calipers, deburring tools, die grinders, drill presses, overhead lifting equipment, etc.


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position will be based at our site in Mocksville, NC, with no anticipated travel.

Job Overview:
The Territory Sales Manager - Responsible for sales growth and business development of Gardner Denver branded compressed air equipment and components through authorized Gardner Denver distributors in the U.S. We are seeking a motivated and results-driven professional to develop and execute business strategies aimed at increasing sales revenue and asset attachment, with a focus on key strategic initiatives. This role involves the successful implementation of commercial business programs and requires expertise in rotating equipment or air compressor products, services, and solutions. As the primary point of contact for assigned distributors, you will build strong relationships with business owners, sales teams, and service leaders to drive growth and collaboration. The role emphasizes territory management, distributor business development, and revenue growth through active customer engagement.


The ideal candidate must be willing to travel overnight as needed to achieve business objectives and foster distributor and customer relationships.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage Gardner Denver branded air compression sales and growth through the distribution channel, developing penetration plans to increase market share and increase recurring revenue through service programs at end-user accounts.
  • Build, maintain, and strengthen distributor relationships at all levels, resolving channel conflicts and ensuring high distributor capability to serve and develop customers.
  • Provide technical expertise and customer support by leveraging Gardner Denver resources to ensure consistent service quality and product knowledge.
  • Collaborate with other business units on pricing, service contract growth, strategy, and warranty concerns to align sales execution with company goals.
  • Measure distributor performance, implement improvement programs, and drive revenue growth across aftermarket parts, service offerings, and support new product sales.
  • Manage commercial programs ensuring alignment with organizational objectives while optimizing results through the distribution network.
  • Gather, analyze, and report monthly on regional activities, competitive strategies, and market trends.
  • Maintain accurate data in CRM systems (CC360 – Salesforce).
  • Pursue continuous training, while coaching and assessing distributor personnel to enhance their technical and commercial competencies in Gardner Denver products and services.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or international equivalent).
  • 3+ years of experience in mechanical sales, with increasing responsibility within the sales hierarchy.

Core Competencies:

  • A wide variety of creativity and communication is required to motivate the sales force.
  • Strong interpersonal abilities along with excellent communication skills will assist the incumbent in being successful.
  • Proficient with various sales concepts, practices, and procedures.

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or international equivalent) in Business, Engineering, Marketing, Management or related areas.
  • Experience with service contracts and aftermarket sales for mechanical equipment is highly preferred.
  • Familiarity with rotating equipment with an emphasis on after-sales services is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite & Salesforce tracking software.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • This is a remote based position that is to be located near a major airport in the U.S.
  • Travel to distribution and customer sites expected up to 50% of the time.

  • 3+ years with LabVIEW and National Instruments hardware/software platforms, with hands-on exposure to industrial instrumentation (pressure, temperature, flow, vibration, power measurement)
  • 1+ years supporting end-of-line testing in a high-volume manufacturing environment

Core Competencies:  

  • Manufacturing Test System Expertise
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Root Cause Analysis and Problem Solving
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Customer and Quality Focus 
 

Preferences: 

  • Experience supporting end-of-line testing in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and cross-functional communication skills. 
  • Knowledge of electrical controls, PLCs, VFDs, motors, sensors, industrial communications, and data acquisition systems.
  • Experience with pumps, compressors, rotating equipment, or industrial machinery.
  • Knowledge of electrical safety standards, risk assessments, system validation, and design verification testing.
 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This position is fully site-based at the Monroe, Louisiana manufacturing facility.

Location: Pomona or San Diego, CA  (Hybrid, with travel)
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Lead the team, solve the tough technical challenges, and keep industry moving in a highly visible service leadership role supporting some of the region’s most critical industrial operations. The Field Service Manager, is a supervisory position that is is a highly visible leadership role supporting Ingersoll Rand’s – Plant Air Centrifugal (PAC) compressed air business across California and Arizona. Working with major manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, and defense customers, this leader becomes a trusted resource when equipment reliability, uptime, and fast technical decisions matter most.

You’ll lead and develop a team of PAC Field Service Technicians responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing sophisticated centrifugal compressed air systems. Just as importantly, you’ll help build the next generation of the regional service team through recruiting, hands-on coaching, technical training, and technician development. This is not a desk-only leadership role. The right candidate brings technical credibility, strong people leadership, and confidence in front of customers. You’ll work alongside technicians, ask the right diagnostic questions, guide complex troubleshooting, and help identify safe, practical solutions when standard parts or factory support cannot meet a customer’s timeline. 

Direct centrifugal-compressor experience is preferred, but we also welcome candidates with strong backgrounds in industrial electrical systems, switchgear, automation, controls, PLCs, or microprocessor-based equipment who are ready to expand their technical expertise.  Based from Pomona, California, this hybrid position includes approximately 50% regional travel, with some overnight stays. You’ll have the backing of an established global OEM, factory training and certification opportunities, strong engineering and technical resources, and a safety-first culture—along with the opportunity to build a high-performing service team and make a direct impact on some of the region’s most demanding industrial operations.

Responsibilities:
  • Effectively attract, coach, counsel, train, develop, and retain all service employees. Drive continuous improvement through company performance management process and technical product training programs available. Develop employee skill levels, including customer service, process improvement, and technical skills to the highest degree possible.  
  • Collaborate with the service coordination function to respond efficiently to customers, ensure technicians’ training and skill level is appropriately matched to service customers, and ensure resources are effectively leveraged across the service area to maximize Service Technician utilization. This includes balancing customer requests for emergency repair, regular maintenance contracts, scheduled work and upgrades, installations, replacement components, and long-term service agreements.  
  • Collaborate with the sales function to consult on service agreements; attend customer meetings to win new and grow existing; service business; provide service support for installations; and drive new service business through Service Technician generated leads, quotes, and requests for proposals.    
  • Maximize cash flow by ensuring invoices are generated immediately upon completion of work and warranty claims are filed accurately and timely, managing expense budgets, and increasing utilization of the service team. Ensure that standard service work processes are created and followed. Improve transactional processes impacting the customer experience and increase overall customer satisfaction.  
  • Effectively manage service team inventory to maintain accuracy, reduce year-end write-offs, and maintain SOX compliance through detailed reporting and regular cycle counts.   
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance within service team. Provide training to all employees to ensure all service personnel follow and maintain safe and productive work habits in the shop, as well as at the customer site.  
  • Other duties as assigned to support the service business and ensure customer satisfaction.  

Requirements
  • High School diploma or GED with relavant experience.
  • 5+ years’ experience in an industrial sales business setting. 
  • 3+ years’ experience in supervising / managing teams of people, such as a combination of relevant experience coaching, training and mentoring as a peer-leader.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving, or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Core Competencies 
  • Advanced operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.
  • Proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Advanced customer service skills including conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Strong customer communication and the ability to credibly explain technical findings, action plans, timing, and alternatives to sophisticated industrial customers.
  • Resourcefulness, forward planning, safety orientation, and ability to source alternate parts, suppliers, rental equipment, and repair paths.

Preferences: 
  • Associates or Bachelors degree in engineering, engineering technology, business  
  • Management of processes and budgets
  • Spanish-English bilingual capability; helpful for Mexico coverage 
  • Direct centrifugal-compressor/PAC experience 
  • Experience with PLCs, controls, microprocessors, event-log retrieval, software revisions, switchgear, or intermediate/high-voltage environments
  • Experience supporting large automotive, aerospace/defense, or other high-value industrial facilities

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • Travel up to 50% with overnight stays; Company vehicle and gas card is provided. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • Ability to work in diverse conditions at times requiring interpretation or deviation from standard processes including but not limited to outdoor environments, mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards.

The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Job Title: Regional Sales Manager
Location: Remote - Territory - CA, AZ, UT, MT, NV, NM, ID, OR, WA)

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) role within its Industrial Technologies and Services (ITS) Business Unit will be responsible for sales growth and business development activities for air treatment solutions, to include air dryers, process chillers, nitrogen generators, oil-water separators, both new sales and rentals in the Southwestern US. The Regional Sales Manager will utilize their technical expertise in how the equipment is utilized in the market and will work closely with channel partners to cultivate, foster, and grow the presence of our products in the marketplace. Establishing and growing the distributor and OEM business relationships, growing revenue and market share for the portfolio, and maintaining profit margins are key for this role. Join us in making the ITS division of Ingersoll Rand an outstanding place to work where both our team and our company thrive! 

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies to expand market presence and achieve sales targets in the Southwest region.
  • Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape to identify new business opportunities and areas for growth.
  • Follow established visitation frequencies for channel partners and achieve a cadence structure for reporting new opportunities, forecasting, revenue progress, etc.
  • Regularly track sales performance and key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess progress towards targets and identify areas for improvement.
  • Identify and recruit new distribution/channel partners and acquire new distribution/channel partners to expand market reach and penetration. This includes establishing and growing synergistic channel partners throughout the region.
  • Oversee the Distribution/Channel Partner network in the Southwest territory: act as the main point of contact for distributors, including business owners, sales teams, and service leaders and guide their activities and priorities. 
  • Partner with the ITS Support teams (manufacturing, service and warranty, customer service, e-commerce, etc.) to improve collaboration, establish best practices, and grow the channel partner and organizations market share.
  • Develop, mentor and coach channel partner sales team in fostering customer relationships, train distribution personnel, and assess their proficiency in supporting products and services.
  • Establish performance benchmarks for individual product lines to gauge distributor effectiveness and drive sales outcomes.
  • Identify underserved areas and geographies, devising business plans to expand coverage.
  • Spot gaps in market/industry coverage and competition and emerging market trends and refocus existing or new channels to address these gaps.
  • Resolve conflicts within the channel and region.
  • Maintain ongoing distribution engagement that supports consistent, high-impact activities.
  • Develop and manage an active opportunity pipeline with all partner organizations, collecting regular feedback to monitor progress.
  • Actively pursue and support competitive conversion opportunities identified in the pipeline.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Enablement & Product Management to capitalize on pricing, product specifications, and new product potential.
  • Provide hands-on feedback to sales team, sharing insights on trends, competition, economics, and other factors to help identify and prioritize strategic opportunities.
  • Lead, motivate, and work with other members of the sales team and channel partners to meet revenue targets, ensure high level of new customer activity, and focus resources to achieve strategic account penetration.
  • Seek and communicate the voice of the customer (VOC) to build strong customer relationships, understand their needs, and communicate risks and opportunities to the ITS leadership team.
  • Collaborate with marketing & product management to establish market pricing and develop sales strategies to realize sales of existing and new products to meet or exceed revenue and profit targets.
  • Establish sales forecasts, plans & objectives for your region and by product line and provide weekly / monthly / yearly forecasting to update the business on short and long-term trends.
  • Track regional metrics to communicate key performance indicators relating to sales, profitability, market share and competitor activities.

Requirements:

  • High school Diploma or Equivalent 
  • 5+ years of industrial sales ideally in industrial equipment, compressed air, air treatment solutions (dryers, filtration, condensate management) or related sectors.

Core Competencies:

  • Formulate a clear and compelling regional sales strategy that aligns with the overall business objectives. This includes identifying market opportunities, defining target customer segments, and outlining a roadmap to achieve sales goals.
  • Optimizing the sales process, including following best practices, implementing sales methodologies, and continuously improving workflows through standard operating procedures. 
  • Ability to gather, interpret and effectively communicate product information in a clear, concise, way, using multiple communication channels (verbal, written, email, chat) to various internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical specifications, product technical literature, construction plans/drawings, commercial terms and conditions, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries from internal or external customers or suppliers.
  • Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of practical problems.
  • Uses technical knowledge to assess the potential application of company products, recommending solutions that meet customer needs, and advance the sales process.

Preferences:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, engineering technology, or business
  • Experience with air compressors and/or air dryers preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience using data to drive distributors behavior and success.
  • Understanding of principles of air compression and/or air treatment, and applications.
  • Understanding of commercial terms including payment terms, receivables, shipping terms, and contract terms and conditions review.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

Remote with the ability to travel up to 50% within the West region.

Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $90,000 - $110,000. The total pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. About Us

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. Job Overview: 

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for the development, optimization, troubleshooting, and long-term support of manufacturing test systems used in end-of-line (EOL) testing of pumps, compressors, motors, and related products. The position also supports laboratory instrumentation including pressure, temperature, flow, and electrical measurement systems and provides electrical and controls engineering support to plant maintenance and manufacturing teams. This role partners closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, and Operations teams to improve product validation processes, increase test system reliability, enhance data collection capabilities, and ensure products consistently meet customer and quality requirements. 

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain electrical and automated end-of-line test systems used to validate product performance, safety, and quality requirements prior to shipment.
  • Develop and support LabVIEW, National Instruments, PLC-based, and data acquisition systems used for manufacturing and laboratory testing.
  • Troubleshoot and improve electrical test equipment, instrumentation, sensors, controls, drives, and data collection systems to maximize uptime and test accuracy.
  • Support pressure, temperature, flow, electrical, vibration, and performance measurement systems used in manufacturing and product qualification testing.
  • Partner with Quality and Manufacturing teams to investigate test failures, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to improve product quality and first-pass yield.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on test automation, process capability, cycle-time reduction, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Support new product introductions by developing test methodologies, validation plans, fixtures, work instructions, and production support processes.
  • Provide electrical engineering support to plant operations, maintenance, and capital projects, including equipment upgrades and modernization initiatives. 
 

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in manufacturing, automation, controls, or test/industrial electrical engineering, including hands-on development, maintenance, or troubleshooting of automated test equipment and electrical measurement systems.
  • 3+ years with LabVIEW and National Instruments hardware/software platforms, with hands-on exposure to industrial instrumentation (pressure, temperature, flow, vibration, power measurement)
  • 1+ years supporting end-of-line testing in a high-volume manufacturing environment

Core Competencies:  

  • Manufacturing Test System Expertise
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Root Cause Analysis and Problem Solving
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Customer and Quality Focus 
 

Preferences: 

  • Experience supporting end-of-line testing in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and cross-functional communication skills. 
  • Knowledge of electrical controls, PLCs, VFDs, motors, sensors, industrial communications, and data acquisition systems.
  • Experience with pumps, compressors, rotating equipment, or industrial machinery.
  • Knowledge of electrical safety standards, risk assessments, system validation, and design verification testing.
 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

  • This position is fully site-based at the Monroe, Louisiana manufacturing facility.
    • Occasional travel may be required to support equipment suppliers, training activities, customer requirements, or other business needs.

Job Title: Field Service Manager, Industrial Compressors & Controls              
Location: Pomona or San Diego, CA  (Hybrid, with travel)
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Lead the team, solve the tough technical challenges, and keep industry moving in a highly visible service leadership role supporting some of the region’s most critical industrial operations. The Field Service Manager, is a supervisory position that is is a highly visible leadership role supporting Ingersoll Rand’s – Plant Air Centrifugal (PAC) compressed air business across California and Arizona. Working with major manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, and defense customers, this leader becomes a trusted resource when equipment reliability, uptime, and fast technical decisions matter most.

You’ll lead and develop a team of PAC Field Service Technicians responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing sophisticated centrifugal compressed air systems. Just as importantly, you’ll help build the next generation of the regional service team through recruiting, hands-on coaching, technical training, and technician development. This is not a desk-only leadership role. The right candidate brings technical credibility, strong people leadership, and confidence in front of customers. You’ll work alongside technicians, ask the right diagnostic questions, guide complex troubleshooting, and help identify safe, practical solutions when standard parts or factory support cannot meet a customer’s timeline. 

Direct centrifugal-compressor experience is preferred, but we also welcome candidates with strong backgrounds in industrial electrical systems, switchgear, automation, controls, PLCs, or microprocessor-based equipment who are ready to expand their technical expertise.  Based from Pomona, California, this hybrid position includes approximately 50% regional travel, with some overnight stays. You’ll have the backing of an established global OEM, factory training and certification opportunities, strong engineering and technical resources, and a safety-first culture—along with the opportunity to build a high-performing service team and make a direct impact on some of the region’s most demanding industrial operations.

Responsibilities:
  • Effectively attract, coach, counsel, train, develop, and retain all service employees. Drive continuous improvement through company performance management process and technical product training programs available. Develop employee skill levels, including customer service, process improvement, and technical skills to the highest degree possible.  
  • Collaborate with the service coordination function to respond efficiently to customers, ensure technicians’ training and skill level is appropriately matched to service customers, and ensure resources are effectively leveraged across the service area to maximize Service Technician utilization. This includes balancing customer requests for emergency repair, regular maintenance contracts, scheduled work and upgrades, installations, replacement components, and long-term service agreements.  
  • Collaborate with the sales function to consult on service agreements; attend customer meetings to win new and grow existing; service business; provide service support for installations; and drive new service business through Service Technician generated leads, quotes, and requests for proposals.    
  • Maximize cash flow by ensuring invoices are generated immediately upon completion of work and warranty claims are filed accurately and timely, managing expense budgets, and increasing utilization of the service team. Ensure that standard service work processes are created and followed. Improve transactional processes impacting the customer experience and increase overall customer satisfaction.  
  • Effectively manage service team inventory to maintain accuracy, reduce year-end write-offs, and maintain SOX compliance through detailed reporting and regular cycle counts.   
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance within service team. Provide training to all employees to ensure all service personnel follow and maintain safe and productive work habits in the shop, as well as at the customer site.  
  • Other duties as assigned to support the service business and ensure customer satisfaction.  

Requirements
  • High School diploma or GED with relavant experience.
  • 5+ years’ experience in an industrial sales business setting. 
  • 3+ years’ experience in supervising / managing teams of people, such as a combination of relevant experience coaching, training and mentoring as a peer-leader.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving, or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Core Competencies 
  • Advanced operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.
  • Proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Advanced customer service skills including conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Strong customer communication and the ability to credibly explain technical findings, action plans, timing, and alternatives to sophisticated industrial customers.
  • Resourcefulness, forward planning, safety orientation, and ability to source alternate parts, suppliers, rental equipment, and repair paths.

Preferences: 
  • Associates or Bachelors degree in engineering, engineering technology, business  
  • Management of processes and budgets
  • Spanish-English bilingual capability; helpful for Mexico coverage 
  • Direct centrifugal-compressor/PAC experience 
  • Experience with PLCs, controls, microprocessors, event-log retrieval, software revisions, switchgear, or intermediate/high-voltage environments
  • Experience supporting large automotive, aerospace/defense, or other high-value industrial facilities

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • Travel up to 50% with overnight stays; Company vehicle and gas card is provided. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • Ability to work in diverse conditions at times requiring interpretation or deviation from standard processes including but not limited to outdoor environments, mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards.

Pay Range: Total pay range for this role, including incentive opportunities, is $125,000 - $160000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Job Title: Regional Sales Manager
Location: Remote - Territory - CA, AZ, UT, MT, NV, NM, ID, OR, WA)

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) role within its Industrial Technologies and Services (ITS) Business Unit will be responsible for sales growth and business development activities for air treatment solutions, to include air dryers, process chillers, nitrogen generators, oil-water separators, both new sales and rentals in the Southwestern US. The Regional Sales Manager will utilize their technical expertise in how the equipment is utilized in the market and will work closely with channel partners to cultivate, foster, and grow the presence of our products in the marketplace. Establishing and growing the distributor and OEM business relationships, growing revenue and market share for the portfolio, and maintaining profit margins are key for this role. Join us in making the ITS division of Ingersoll Rand an outstanding place to work where both our team and our company thrive! 

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies to expand market presence and achieve sales targets in the Southwest region.
  • Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape to identify new business opportunities and areas for growth.
  • Follow established visitation frequencies for channel partners and achieve a cadence structure for reporting new opportunities, forecasting, revenue progress, etc.
  • Regularly track sales performance and key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess progress towards targets and identify areas for improvement.
  • Identify and recruit new distribution/channel partners and acquire new distribution/channel partners to expand market reach and penetration. This includes establishing and growing synergistic channel partners throughout the region.
  • Oversee the Distribution/Channel Partner network in the Southwest territory: act as the main point of contact for distributors, including business owners, sales teams, and service leaders and guide their activities and priorities. 
  • Partner with the ITS Support teams (manufacturing, service and warranty, customer service, e-commerce, etc.) to improve collaboration, establish best practices, and grow the channel partner and organizations market share.
  • Develop, mentor and coach channel partner sales team in fostering customer relationships, train distribution personnel, and assess their proficiency in supporting products and services.
  • Establish performance benchmarks for individual product lines to gauge distributor effectiveness and drive sales outcomes.
  • Identify underserved areas and geographies, devising business plans to expand coverage.
  • Spot gaps in market/industry coverage and competition and emerging market trends and refocus existing or new channels to address these gaps.
  • Resolve conflicts within the channel and region.
  • Maintain ongoing distribution engagement that supports consistent, high-impact activities.
  • Develop and manage an active opportunity pipeline with all partner organizations, collecting regular feedback to monitor progress.
  • Actively pursue and support competitive conversion opportunities identified in the pipeline.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Enablement & Product Management to capitalize on pricing, product specifications, and new product potential.
  • Provide hands-on feedback to sales team, sharing insights on trends, competition, economics, and other factors to help identify and prioritize strategic opportunities.
  • Lead, motivate, and work with other members of the sales team and channel partners to meet revenue targets, ensure high level of new customer activity, and focus resources to achieve strategic account penetration.
  • Seek and communicate the voice of the customer (VOC) to build strong customer relationships, understand their needs, and communicate risks and opportunities to the ITS leadership team.
  • Collaborate with marketing & product management to establish market pricing and develop sales strategies to realize sales of existing and new products to meet or exceed revenue and profit targets.
  • Establish sales forecasts, plans & objectives for your region and by product line and provide weekly / monthly / yearly forecasting to update the business on short and long-term trends.
  • Track regional metrics to communicate key performance indicators relating to sales, profitability, market share and competitor activities.

Requirements:

  • High school Diploma or Equivalent 
  • 5+ years of industrial sales ideally in industrial equipment, compressed air, air treatment solutions (dryers, filtration, condensate management) or related sectors.

Core Competencies:

  • Formulate a clear and compelling regional sales strategy that aligns with the overall business objectives. This includes identifying market opportunities, defining target customer segments, and outlining a roadmap to achieve sales goals.
  • Optimizing the sales process, including following best practices, implementing sales methodologies, and continuously improving workflows through standard operating procedures. 
  • Ability to gather, interpret and effectively communicate product information in a clear, concise, way, using multiple communication channels (verbal, written, email, chat) to various internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical specifications, product technical literature, construction plans/drawings, commercial terms and conditions, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries from internal or external customers or suppliers.
  • Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of practical problems.
  • Uses technical knowledge to assess the potential application of company products, recommending solutions that meet customer needs, and advance the sales process.

Preferences:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, engineering technology, or business
  • Experience with air compressors and/or air dryers preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience using data to drive distributors behavior and success.
  • Understanding of principles of air compression and/or air treatment, and applications.
  • Understanding of commercial terms including payment terms, receivables, shipping terms, and contract terms and conditions review.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

Remote with the ability to travel up to 50% within the West region.

Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $90,000 - $110,000. The total pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. Job Overview:

  • Own standard work for VOC process and host trainings, drive team adherence and create centralized customer insight database

  • Create structure to evaluate projects and deliverables that will be executed by the IRETC

  • IP strategy, product rationalization
  • At TG1, identify intellectual property opportunities, technology blocks, to feed patent strategy

Preferred Qualifications:

Job Title: Field Service Manager, Industrial Compressors & Controls              
Location: Ponoma, CA  (Hybrid, with travel)
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Lead the team, solve the tough technical challenges, and keep industry moving in a highly visible service leadership role supporting some of the region’s most critical industrial operations. The Field Service Manager, is a supervisory position that is is a highly visible leadership role supporting Ingersoll Rand’s – Plant Air Centrifugal (PAC) compressed air business across California and Arizona. Working with major manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, and defense customers, this leader becomes a trusted resource when equipment reliability, uptime, and fast technical decisions matter most.

You’ll lead and develop a team of PAC Field Service Technicians responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing sophisticated centrifugal compressed air systems. Just as importantly, you’ll help build the next generation of the regional service team through recruiting, hands-on coaching, technical training, and technician development. This is not a desk-only leadership role. The right candidate brings technical credibility, strong people leadership, and confidence in front of customers. You’ll work alongside technicians, ask the right diagnostic questions, guide complex troubleshooting, and help identify safe, practical solutions when standard parts or factory support cannot meet a customer’s timeline. 

Direct centrifugal-compressor experience is preferred, but we also welcome candidates with strong backgrounds in industrial electrical systems, switchgear, automation, controls, PLCs, or microprocessor-based equipment who are ready to expand their technical expertise.  Based from Pomona, California, this hybrid position includes approximately 50% regional travel, with some overnight stays. You’ll have the backing of an established global OEM, factory training and certification opportunities, strong engineering and technical resources, and a safety-first culture—along with the opportunity to build a high-performing service team and make a direct impact on some of the region’s most demanding industrial operations.

Responsibilities:
  • Effectively attract, coach, counsel, train, develop, and retain all service employees. Drive continuous improvement through company performance management process and technical product training programs available. Develop employee skill levels, including customer service, process improvement, and technical skills to the highest degree possible.  
  • Collaborate with the service coordination function to respond efficiently to customers, ensure technicians’ training and skill level is appropriately matched to service customers, and ensure resources are effectively leveraged across the service area to maximize Service Technician utilization. This includes balancing customer requests for emergency repair, regular maintenance contracts, scheduled work and upgrades, installations, replacement components, and long-term service agreements.  
  • Collaborate with the sales function to consult on service agreements; attend customer meetings to win new and grow existing; service business; provide service support for installations; and drive new service business through Service Technician generated leads, quotes, and requests for proposals.    
  • Maximize cash flow by ensuring invoices are generated immediately upon completion of work and warranty claims are filed accurately and timely, managing expense budgets, and increasing utilization of the service team. Ensure that standard service work processes are created and followed. Improve transactional processes impacting the customer experience and increase overall customer satisfaction.  
  • Effectively manage service team inventory to maintain accuracy, reduce year-end write-offs, and maintain SOX compliance through detailed reporting and regular cycle counts.   
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance within service team. Provide training to all employees to ensure all service personnel follow and maintain safe and productive work habits in the shop, as well as at the customer site.  
  • Other duties as assigned to support the service business and ensure customer satisfaction.  

Requirements
  • High School diploma or GED with relavant experience.
  • 5+ years’ experience in an industrial sales business setting. 
  • 3+ years’ experience in supervising / managing teams of people, such as a combination of relevant experience coaching, training and mentoring as a peer-leader.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving, or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Core Competencies 
  • Advanced operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.
  • Proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Advanced customer service skills including conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Strong customer communication and the ability to credibly explain technical findings, action plans, timing, and alternatives to sophisticated industrial customers.
  • Resourcefulness, forward planning, safety orientation, and ability to source alternate parts, suppliers, rental equipment, and repair paths.

Preferences: 
  • Associates or Bachelors degree in engineering, engineering technology, business  
  • Management of processes and budgets
  • Spanish-English bilingual capability; helpful for Mexico coverage 
  • Direct centrifugal-compressor/PAC experience 
  • Experience with PLCs, controls, microprocessors, event-log retrieval, software revisions, switchgear, or intermediate/high-voltage environments
  • Experience supporting large automotive, aerospace/defense, or other high-value industrial facilities

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • Travel up to 50% with overnight stays; Company vehicle and gas card is provided. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling. It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
  • Ability to work in diverse conditions at times requiring interpretation or deviation from standard processes including but not limited to outdoor environments, mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards.

Pay Range: Total pay range for this role, including incentive opportunities, is $125,000 - $160000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Job Overview:
In this role as a Manufacturing Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of production processes. The Manufacturing Engineer is tasked with designing and refining manufacturing methods to boost productivity while maintaining high-quality standards and ensuring safety protocols. They work closely with various departments, such as design, quality, and operations, to implement improvements that reduce costs and streamline workflows. 

Responsibilities:

  • Suggests, evaluates, implements & manages multiple manufacturing projects from beginning to end
  • Evaluates, develops and implements machining processes on current or future assets
  • Implements capital equipment including evaluation, selection, run-offs, and implementation
  • Maintains manufacturing best practices including precision machining, lean manufacturing, and machine tool / tooling technologies
  • Evaluates non-conforming material and provides proper disposition
  • Leads special projects including NPD, insourcing, productivity and capital procurement
  • Designs tooling, gages and fixtures using 3D modeling software
  • Develops manufacturing routings internal and sub-con operations
  • Leads machine tool installations throughout the entire process
  • Supports production efforts through troubleshooting manufacturing issues
  • Ensures compliance with ISO 9001:2015 standards
  • Supports safety and environmental practices
  • Performs other duties assigned by immediate supervisor

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in manufacturing, Industrial or Mechanical engineering. 
  • 4+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering.

Core Competencies:

  • Technical Expertise: knowledge of manufacturing processes and technologies. 
  • Problem-Solving: Analytical skills to develop effective solutions. 
  • Project Management: Ability to manage projects from start to finish efficiently. 
  • Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional teams. 
  • Continuous Improvement: Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma.   
  • Attention to Detail: To ensure quality and compliance. 
  • Innovation: Creative thinking to introduce new manufacturing solutions. 
  • Leadership: Ability to train and guide production staff. 
  • Safety Awareness: Strong understanding of and commitment to safety protocols. 
  • Strong analytical ability to solve issues such as: manufacturing problems and dimensional or calculation errors.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical assembly and machining processes and overall business operations.
  • Fluent using inspection tools, techniques and their application to the engineering requirements.
  • Comprehensive understanding of machine tool operations.
  • In-depth knowledge of CNC Programming, CAD / CAM / CAE, MS Office Software, and MS Project.
  • Competent in advanced engineering drawings including GD&T and tolerance analysis.

Preferences:

  • Ability to prioritize tasks, and carry out root cause analysis.
  • Ability to communicate at all levels internally, customers and suppliers.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing Techniques and ability to create standard work.
  • Fluent using inspection tools, techniques and their application to the engineering requirements.
  • Proficient in gear or helical grinding.
  • Understanding of rotary screw compressors and/or centrifugal compressors.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Onsite with up to 15% travel.

About Us 

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Summary 

  • The Centrifugal Service Technician – Compression Technologies and Services serves customers by installing, trouble shooting, repairing and maintaining our centrifugal compressor product lines including Centac and Turbo Air models, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 

Responsibilities 

  • Provide technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems, including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement. 

  • Read wiring schematics and diagrams for equipment, research complex technical issues, and find/implement solutions.  

  • Document service and installation activities by completing work orders for each job, performing maintenance checklists, and maintaining daily time sheets. 

  • Maintain rapport with customers by suggesting improved methods and techniques and recommending system improvements. Increase Ingersoll Rand customer’s awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services and solutions; such as Package CARE, Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits, and Leak Detection, can benefit their operations. 

  • Conduct safety assessments of a continuously changing work environment. Ensure proper operation of compressed air equipment by completing preventative maintenance requirements and 47-point inspections on a wide variety of compressors, refrigerated dryers, desiccant dryers and additional compressed air components. 

  • Work with Service Coordinator and operations teams on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. 

  • Explain practices, procedures, and policies to reach agreement with suppliers and others outside of the job area. 

  • Conduct basic vibration and air quality troubleshooting. 

Requirements

  • Minimum of 3 years of Centrifugal compressor experience. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.  
     

Core Competencies 

  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.? Proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases. 
  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills and customer service skills including conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 5 years. 
  • Ability to work in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards.
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling, and requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements

Job Summary:
The GCMS Laboratory Technician plays a critical role in the accurate, timely, and reliable analysis of compressed air and gas samples using GC-MS technologies. This position is responsible for executing quantitative chemical analyses, verifying, maintaining, and troubleshooting laboratory instrumentation, and ensuring full compliance with ISO 17025 quality standards. The technician collaborates closely with cross Functional laboratory teams to support daily operations, uphold data integrity, and contribute to the continuous improvement of laboratory processes. This role requires strong technical expertise, disciplined adherence to SOPs, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast paced, production focused laboratory environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform daily hands-on operations in the GC-MS lab, including building calibration curves, sample prep and loading, and parts and consumables inventory management
  • Plan and execute instrument maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair in a high-volume production environment
  • Coordinate effectively with other laboratory teams to ensure timely and accurate completion of testing and reporting of results
  • Identify deviations, investigate root causes, and effectively communicate any analysis issues that may affect the integrity of results
  • Adhere strictly to standard operating procedures and quality control requirements
  • Design method improvements and validate new processes, software, and equipment
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and audit-ready work environment
  • Other related duties as assigned


Basic Qualifications:

  • B.S. degree in Chemistry or Biochemistry
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience performing GC-MS maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational support


Key Competencies:

  • Working knowledge of statistical principles and data evaluation methods used in analytical chemistry
  • Strong technical communication skills, including the ability to document findings and convey complex information clearly
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives


Preferences:

  • Experience with GC-MS for both gas and liquid phase analyses and chemical extraction techniques
  • Proficiency with chromatographic data systems (ChemStation, Open Lab)
  • 5 years’ experience in an ISO 17025 regulated commercial laboratory
  • Experience working in high-volume, production-focused laboratories with strict turnarounds times
  • Familiarity with root cause analysis tools (fishbone diagrams, 5 whys)

This position will be based at our site in Austin, TX no travel.

job.description:

Responsibilities

  • Partner with global, regional, and business-unit leadership to provide strategic legal advice on commercial priorities, enterprise initiatives, and complex matters.
  • Lead the drafting, review, negotiation, and management of commercial agreements, including sales, supply, distribution, services, technology, confidentiality, procurement, and other strategic arrangements.
  • Advise on mergers and acquisitions, investments, integrations, restructurings, and other corporate transactions, coordinating due diligence, documentation, approvals, and post-close legal activities as needed.
  • Provide guidance on corporate governance, entity management, board and secretarial matters, intercompany arrangements, delegations of authority, and related enterprise requirements.
  • Monitor legal and regulatory developments across relevant jurisdictions and partner with Compliance, Finance, Tax, Human Resources, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Trade Compliance, Supply Chain, and other functions to translate requirements into practical business actions.
  • Manage litigation, investigations, claims, and external legal inquiries, including the selection, direction, budgeting, and performance management of outside counsel.
  • Develop and improve legal templates, playbooks, policies, training, and operating processes that increase consistency, cycle time, risk visibility, knowledge sharing, and compliance across the enterprise.
  • Build strong relationships across the global Legal team and broader organization, sharing expertise, supporting regional colleagues, and contributing to enterprise-wide legal priorities and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

  • J.D. degree and license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • Demonstrated expertise in commercial and contract law, including significant experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements.
  • Broad legal capability across corporate, transactional, regulatory, compliance, governance, privacy, dispute, and risk-management matters, with the judgment to engage specialist counsel when appropriate.
  • Exceptional written communication, legal drafting, negotiation, and executive advisory skills.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, influence across cultures and functions, and deliver pragmatic solutions in a fast-paced global organization.

Core Competencies

Ownership Mindset: Takes accountability, follows through, and acts in the best interests of the enterprise.

Global Perspective: Works effectively across cultures, jurisdictions, functions, and business models.

Commercial Judgment: Balances legal risk with practical, customer-focused business solutions.

Integrity and Courage: Applies sound judgment, protects trust, and raises concerns constructively.

Collaboration and Influence: Builds durable relationships and aligns stakeholders without relying on authority.

Execution Excellence: Brings discipline, responsiveness, and clarity to complex, high-priority work.

Preferences

  • Experience in an in-house legal department supporting a global industrial, manufacturing, technology, or other complex matrixed organization.
  • Experience advising senior leaders and boards on corporate governance, compliance, and enterprise risk matters globally.
  • Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, integration, or other strategic corporate transactions across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience in Life Sciences businesses including understanding of FDA and related regulations for medical equipment

The Advanced Manufacturing Engineer will support the development and execution of manufacturing strategies by optimizing production capabilities, implementing new technologies, and improving operational efficiency. This onsite role partners closely with cross-functional teams to drive manufacturing readiness, support new product introductions, manage capital investments, and deliver scalable, cost-effective production solutions. The position plays a key role in advancing site technology roadmaps, improving productivity, and ensuring successful implementation of complex manufacturing projects.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop technology road map for manufacturing location to maximize machine utilization and productivity while minimizing cost.
  • Assist in Make vs Buy decision on product introduction, i2v, and footprint plans with the goal of fixed overhead rationalization and leverage of core competencies.
  • Provide technical input on capital expense needs tied to manufacturing startup of project future state and processes.
  • Lead manufacturing project development and implementation activities through IRPX program gates.
  • Procure tooling, machines, and equipment necessary to support approved site capacity and capability roadmap and deliver capable and well documented manufacturing processes.
  • Ensure operator and maintenance training for new production equipment meets standards and final sign-off requirements.
  • Serve in a highly cross-functional environment with engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, product management, and suppliers to optimize cost competitiveness and manufacturability.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor Degree in Engineering required.
  • 10+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in a similar capital intensive, highly engineered product business.

Preferences:

  • Self-starter capabilities with strong technical and leadership skills.
  • Excellent communication, project management, and analytical skills with the ability to develop and deliver technical information to team members, suppliers, and stakeholders.

Responsibilities:  

  • Designs and coordinates standard manufacturing processes.
  • Plans or improves production methods including flow, tooling, assembly methods and production equipment.
